subclasses.name: Alchemist
subclasses.description: An Alchemist is an expert in magical chemistry, combining reagents to produce mystical effects. Alchemists use their potions and elixirs to menyembuhkan allies and hinder foes.

features.name: Tool Proficiency
features.description: You mendapatkan keahlian with alchemist's supplies. If you already have this keahlian, kamu mendapatkan keahlian dengan another type of artisan's tools of your choice.
features.summary: Gain keahlian with alchemist's supplies. (permanent).

features.name: Experimental Elixir
features.description: Whenever you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang, kamu dapat produce a number of experimental elixirs equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1). You can use aksi bonus to drink one of your elixirs or administer it to another creature. The elixir produces one of the following effects (your choice): Healing (memulihkan kembali 2d4 + Intelligence modifier poin kesehatan), Swiftness (speed increases by 10 feet for 1 hour), or Resilience (mendapatkan a +1 bonus to AC for 10 minutes).
features.summary: Whenever you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang, kamu dapat produce a number of experimental elixirs equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of 1).

features.name: Alchemical Savant
features.description: When you cast sihir using your alchemist's supplies as the spellcasting focus, kamu dapat menambahkan Intelligence modifier to one roll of acid, fire, necrotic, or poison kerusakan.
features.summary: Can add your Intelligence modifier to one roll of acid, fire, necrotic, or poison kerusakan. (action).

features.name: Restorative Reagents
features.description: You can cast the lesser restoration sihir without expending slot sihir or requiring material components. You can do so a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Can do so a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang. (action).

features.name: Chemical Mastery
features.description: You mendapatkan resistance to acid and poison kerusakan, and kamu memiliki keuntungan pada saving throw melawan being poisoned.
features.summary: Gain resistance to acid and poison kerusakan, and kamu memiliki keuntungan pada saving throw melawan being poisoned.

subclasses.name: Armorer
subclasses.description: An Armorer uses their artificer magic to empower a suit of armor, turning it into a powerful magical protection. The Armorer can transform their armor into different modes for combat or stealth.

features.name: Tools of the Trade
features.description: You mendapatkan keahlian with heavy armor and smith's tools.
features.summary: Gain keahlian with heavy armor and smith's tools.

features.name: Arcane Armor
features.description: Your armor becomes magical. You can don or doff armormu as aksi, and it can't be removed against your will. While wearing armormu, kamu mendapatkan the following benefits: You have a +1 bonus to AC, kamu dapat menggunakan your Intelligence modifier instead of Strength for attack and kerusakan rolls with weapons, and kamu dapat menggunakan armormu as a spellcasting focus.
features.summary: Can don or doff armormu as aksi, and it can't be removed against your will. (action).

features.name: Armor Model
features.description: You can customize armormu for combat or stealth. When you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang, kamu dapat change armormu model. Choose one of the following: Guardian (kamu memiliki keuntungan pada Charisma (Intimidation) checks, and ketika kamu take the Attack action on giliranmu, kamu dapat membuat an additional melee attack from the armor's thunder gauntlets) or Infiltrator (kamu memiliki keuntungan pada Charisma (Stealth) checks, and armormu's lightning launcher deals an extra 1d6 lightning kerusakan).
features.summary: Choose one of the following: Guardian (kamu memiliki keuntungan pada Charisma (Intimidation) checks, and ketika kamu take the Attack action on giliranmu, kamu dapat membuat an additional melee attack.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, setiap kali kamu take the Attack action on giliranmu.
features.requirement: Only when taking the Attack action
features.scaling: Three attacks at level 11, four attacks at level 20
features.summary: Can attack twice, instead of once, setiap kali kamu take the Attack action on giliranmu. (only when taking the attack action, permanent, scales).

features.name: Armor Modifications
features.description: You learn 2 additional artificer infusions, and kamu dapat menerapkan them to armormu. You can have hingga 4 infusions active on armormu at a time.
features.summary: Learn 2 additional artificer infusions, and kamu dapat menerapkan them to armormu.

features.name: Perfected Armor
features.description: Your armor's power increases. While wearing armormu, kamu mendapatkan the following benefits based on armormu model: Guardian (when makhluk dalam 5 feet of you hits you with an attack, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to deal 1d6 thunder kerusakan to that creature) or Infiltrator (ketika kamu hit makhluk with an attack, kamu dapat deal an additional 1d6 lightning kerusakan).
features.summary: Gain the following benefits based on armormu model: Guardian.

subclasses.name: Artillerist
subclasses.description: An Artillerist specializes in harnessing the power of magic to create destructive energy. They can conjure a magical cannon that unleashes powerful blasts of elemental energy.

features.name: Tool Proficiency
features.description: You mendapatkan keahlian with woodcarver's tools.
features.summary: Gain keahlian with woodcarver's tools. (permanent).

features.name: Eldritch Cannon
features.description: You can use woodcarver's tools and 10 gp worth of raw materials to create a Small eldritch cannon in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you. The cannon has AC 18 and poin kesehatan equal to five times your artificer level. You can have only one cannon at a time. As aksi, kamu dapat command the cannon to move hingga 15 feet. You can use aksi bonus to activate the cannon, causing it to produce one of the following effects: Flamethrower (15-foot cone, 2d8 fire kerusakan, Dexterity saving throw), Force Ballista (ranged sihir attack, 2d8 force kerusakan, push 5 feet), or Protector (10-foot radius, 1d8 + Intelligence modifier poin kesehatan sementara).
features.summary: Can use woodcarver's tools and 10 gp worth of raw materials to create a Small eldritch cannon in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you. (bonus action).

features.name: Arcane Firearm
features.description: You can use a wand, staff, or rod as a spellcasting focus. When you cast an artificer sihir through this focus, kamu dapat melempar a d8 and add it to one kerusakan roll of sihir itu.
features.summary: Can roll a d8 and add it to one kerusakan roll of sihir itu. (action).

features.name: Explosive Cannon
features.description: Your cannon's kerusakan increases by 1d8. In addition, kamu dapat detonate your cannon as aksi. Each creature within 20 feet of the cannon must make a Dexterity saving throw against your sihir save DC, taking 3d8 force kerusakan on a failed save, or half as much kerusakan on a successful one.
features.summary: Each creature within 20 feet of the cannon must make a Dexterity saving throw against your sihir save DC, taking 3d8 force kerusakan on a failed save, or half.

features.name: Fortified Position
features.description: You and your allies have half cover while within 10 feet of your cannon. In addition, kamu dapat have two cannons at a time, and kamu dapat activate both with the same bonus action.
features.summary: And your allies have half cover while within 10 feet of your cannon. (bonus action).

subclasses.name: Battle Smith
subclasses.description: A Battle Smith is a master of combat and magic, combining martial prowess with magical tinkering. They can create a powerful steel defender that fights alongside them.

features.name: Tool Proficiency
features.description: You mendapatkan keahlian with smith's tools and heavy armor.
features.summary: Gain keahlian with smith's tools and heavy armor. (permanent).

features.name: Battle Ready
features.description: You are proficient with martial weapons. When you attack with a magic weapon, kamu dapat menggunakan your Intelligence modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity for the attack and kerusakan rolls.
features.summary: Can use your Intelligence modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity for the attack and kerusakan rolls. (action).

features.name: Steel Defender
features.description: You can use smith's tools and 10 gp worth of raw materials to create a steel defender in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you. The defender has AC 15 + bonus keahlianmu and poin kesehatan equal to 2 + your Intelligence modifier + five times your artificer level. It is friendly to you and your companions, and it obeys your commands. In combat, the defender shares your initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours.
features.summary: Can use smith's tools and 10 gp worth of raw materials to create a steel defender in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you. (action).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, setiap kali kamu take the Attack action on giliranmu.
features.requirement: Only when taking the Attack action
features.scaling: Three attacks at level 11, four attacks at level 20
features.summary: Can attack twice, instead of once, setiap kali kamu take the Attack action on giliranmu. (only when taking the attack action, permanent, scales).

features.name: Arcane Jolt
features.description: When you hit makhluk with a magic weapon, kamu dapat channel a burst of arcane energy into the target. The target takes an additional 2d6 force kerusakan, and if the target is a construct, it takes an additional 2d6 force kerusakan. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: The target takes an additional 2d6 force kerusakan, and if the target is a construct, it takes an additional 2d6 force kerusakan. (action).

features.name: Improved Defender
features.description: Your Arcane Jolt and steel defender become more powerful. The extra kerusakan of Arcane Jolt increases to 4d6. In addition, when your steel defender uses its Deflect Attack feature, the attacker takes force kerusakan equal to 1d4 + your Intelligence modifier.
features.summary: In addition, when your steel defender uses its Deflect Attack feature, the attacker takes force kerusakan equal to 1d4 + your Intelligence modifier. (action).

subclasses.name: Ancestral Guardian
subclasses.description: Some barbarians hail from cultures that revere their ancestors. These tribes teach that the warriors of the past linger in the world as mighty spirits, who can guide and protect the living. When barbarians who follow this path rage, they channel these protective spirits, using them to guard their allies and enemies.

features.name: Ancestral Protectors
features.description: Starting ketika kamu choose this path at 3rd level, spectral warriors appear ketika kamu enter your rage. While you're raging, the first creature you hit with an attack on giliranmu has kerugian on any attack target that isn't you or the warrior. Additionally, if the target tries to make an attack while within 5 feet of you, it must first make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target must choose a different target or the attack fails. On a successful save, the target can make its attack as normal. This effect lasts until the start of giliranmu selanjutnya.
features.summary: Additionally, if the target tries to make an attack while within 5 feet of you, it must first make a Wisdom saving throw. (action).

features.name: Spirit Shield
features.description: Beginning at 6th level, the guardian spirits that aid kamu dapat provide protection to those you defend. If makhluk yang kamu lihat takes kerusakan while within 30 feet of you, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to reduce that kerusakan by 2d6. You can reduce the kerusakan by an additional 1d6 at 10th level (3d6) and at 14th level (4d6).
features.summary: Can use reaksimu to reduce that kerusakan by 2d6. (reaction).

features.name: Consult the Spirits
features.description: At 10th level, you cast the augury or clairvoyance sihir, without requiring slot sihir or material components, and kamu memulihkan kembali the ability to cast it this way ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these sihir.
features.summary: At 10th level, you cast the augury or clairvoyance sihir, without requiring slot sihir or material components, and kamu memulihkan kembali the ability to cast it this way ketika kamu.

features.name: Vengeful Ancestors
features.description: At 14th level, your ancestral spirits can hinder your foes even more. When you use your Spirit Shield to reduce the kerusakan of an attack, the attacker takes an amount of force kerusakan equal to the kerusakan your Spirit Shield prevents.
features.summary: The attacker takes an amount of force kerusakan equal to the kerusakan your Spirit Shield prevents. (action).

subclasses.name: Berserker
subclasses.description: For some barbarians, rage is a means to an end--that end being violence. The Path of the Berserker is a path of untrammeled fury, slick with blood. As you enter the berserker's rage, you thrill in the chaos of battle, heedless of your own health or well-being.

features.name: Frenzy
features.description: Starting ketika kamu choose this path at 3rd level, kamu dapat go into a frenzy ketika kamu rage. If you do so, for the duration of your rage kamu dapat membuat a single melee weapon attack as aksi bonus on each of your turns after this one. When your rage ends, you suffer one level of exhaustion (as described in appendix A).
features.summary: For the duration of your rage kamu dapat membuat a single melee weapon attack as aksi bonus on each of your turns after this one. (bonus action).

features.name: Mindless Rage
features.description: Beginning at 6th level, kamu tidak bisa charmed or frightened while raging. If kamu adalah charmed or frightened ketika kamu enter your rage, the effect is suspended for the duration of the rage.
features.summary: The effect is suspended for the duration of the rage. (action).

features.name: Intimidating Presence
features.description:
Beginning at 10th level, kamu dapat menggunakan aksimu to frighten someone with your menacing presence. When you do so, choose satu makhluk that kamu bisa melihat within 30 feet of you. If the creature can see or hear you, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC equal to 8 + bonus keahlianmu + your Charisma modifier) or be frightened of you until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya. On subsequent turns, kamu dapat menggunakan aksimu to extend the duration of this effect on the frightened creature until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya. This effect ends if the creature ends its turn out of line of sight or more than 60 feet away from you.
 If the creature succeeds on its saving throw, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan this feature on that creature again for 24 hours.
features.summary: Can't use this feature on that creature again for 24 hours. (action).

features.name: Retaliation
features.description: Starting at 14th level, ketika kamu take kerusakan from makhluk that is within 5 feet of you, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to make a melee weapon Attack against that creature.
features.summary: Starting at 14th level, ketika kamu take kerusakan from makhluk that is within 5 feet of you, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to make a melee weapon Attack against.

subclasses.name: Path of the Beast
subclasses.description: Barbarians who walk the Path of the Beast draw their power from a primal animal spark within their souls. When they rage, that spark manifests as a physical transformation, granting them natural weapons and bestial traits in battle.

features.name: Form of the Beast
features.summary: Manifest a natural weapon (Bite, Claws, or Tail) when entering rage.
features.description: When you enter your rage, kamu dapat transform, revealing the bestial power within you. Until the rage ends, you manifest a natural weapon. It counts as a simple melee weapon for you, and you add your Strength modifier to the attack and kerusakan rolls ketika kamu attack with it. You choose the weapon each time you rage: Bite (1d8 piercing, menyembuhkan PB poin kesehatan once per turn when below half HP), Claws (1d6 slashing, make an additional claw attack once per turn when taking the Attack action), or Tail (1d8 piercing with reach, reaction to add 1d8 to AC-mu against an attack that would hit you).

features.name: Bestial Soul
features.summary: Natural weapons count as magical; adapt movement with climbing, swimming, or jumping.
features.description: The feral spirit within you grows stronger, altering your physical form. The natural weapons you manifest with Form of the Beast now count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and kerusakan. In addition, ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat singkat atau panjang, kamu dapat memilih one of the following benefits until your next rest: Swimming (mendapatkan swimming speed equal to walking speed and can breathe underwater), Climbing (mendapatkan climbing speed equal to walking speed and climb difficult surfaces without checks), or Jumping (extend your jump distance by rolling an Athletics check and adding the total to the distance in feet).

features.name: Infectious Fury
features.summary: Curse makhluk you strike with natural weapons to deal 2d12 psychic kerusakan or strike an ally.
features.description: When you hit makhluk with your natural weapons while raging, the beast within kamu dapat curse your target with rabid fury. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + bonus keahlianmu + your Constitution modifier) or suffer one of the following effects (your choice): the target must use its reaction to make a melee attack against another creature of your choice that kamu bisa melihat, or the target takes 2d12 psychic kerusakan. You can use this feature a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu, regaining all uses upon finishing istirahat panjang.

features.name: Call the Hunt
features.summary: Rally your pack to mendapatkan 5 temp HP per ally and grant allies +1d6 kerusakan on attacks.
features.description: The beast within you grows so powerful that kamu dapat spread its ferocity to your companions and be sustained by their presence. When you enter your rage, kamu dapat memilih a number of willing creatures kamu bisa melihat within 30 feet of you equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of one). You mendapatkan 5 poin kesehatan sementara for setiap makhluk that accepts this feature. Until the rage ends, the chosen creatures each mendapatkan an extra 1d6 kerusakan on their melee weapon kerusakan rolls once per turn. You can use this feature a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu, regaining all uses upon istirahat panjang.

subclasses.name: Path of Wild Magic
subclasses.description: Many places in the multiverse abound with beauty, intense emotion, and rampant magic; the Feywild and Upper Planes are among them. Barbarians influenced by these realms burst into magical chaos when their rage begins.

features.name: Magic Awareness
features.summary: Sense the presence of any sihir or magic item within 60 feet.
features.description: As aksi, kamu dapat open your awareness to the presence of concentrated magic. Until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya, you know the location of any sihir or magic item within 60 feet of you that isn't behind total cover. When you sense sihir, you learn its school of magic. You can use this feature a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu, and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.

features.name: Wild Magic Surge
features.summary: Roll a d8 on the Wild Magic table upon raging to produce a chaotic magical surge.
features.description: Magical energy roils inside you. Whenever you enter your rage, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table to determine the magical effect produced: 1: Each creature of your choice within 30 feet takes 1d12 necrotic kerusakan and kamu mendapatkan 1d12 temp HP. 2: Teleport hingga 30 feet as aksi bonus each turn. 3: Summon an intangible spirit within 30 feet that explodes for 1d6 force kerusakan on hit. 4: A magic light infuses senjatamu, dealing +1d6 force kerusakan and gaining the light and thrown properties. 5: Retaliate against attackers with 1d6 force kerusakan when struck. 6: Gain a +1 AC protective aura for yourself and allies within 10 feet. 7: The ground within 15 feet of you turns difficult terrain for enemies. 8: Shoot a beam of radiant light hingga 30 feet blinding the target and dealing 1d6 radiant kerusakan.

features.name: Bolstering Presence
features.summary: Bolster an ally to give +1d3 on attack rolls/ability checks or memulihkan a 1st-3rd level sihir slot.
features.description: You can harness your wild magic to bolster yourself or a companion. As aksi, kamu dapat touch makhluk (which can be yourself) and confer one of the following benefits: For 10 minutes, the creature can add a 1d3 roll to any attack roll or ability check it makes. Or, roll a 1d3 to memulihkan one expended sihir slot to the creature of a level equal to or lower than the rolled number. Once you confer either benefit, kamu tidak bisa do so again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang, unless you expend a use of your rage to do so.

features.name: Unstable Backlash
features.summary: Reroll your Wild Magic Surge table effect when taking kerusakan or failing a saving throw.
features.description: When kamu adalah imperiled during your rage, the magic within kamu dapat lash out. Immediately after you take kerusakan or fail a saving throw while raging, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to roll on the Wild Magic table and immediately produce the new effect, replacing your current surge effect.

features.name: Controlled Surge
features.summary: Roll twice on the Wild Magic Surge table and choose which effect manifests.
features.description: Whenever you roll on the Wild Magic table, kamu dapat melempar the die twice and choose which of the two effects to produce. If you roll the same number on both dice, kamu dapat mengabaikan the number and choose any effect on the table.

subclasses.name: Storm Herald
subclasses.description: All barbarians harbor a fury within. Their rage grants them superior strength, durability, and speed. Barbarians who follow the Path of the Storm Herald learn to transform that rage into a mantle of primal magic, which swirls around them. When in a fury, a barbarian of this path can protect their allies and harm their foes with the power of the elements.

features.name: Storm Aura
features.description:
Starting at 3rd level, you emanate a stormy, magical aura while you rage. The aura extends 10 feet from you in every direction, but not through total cover. Your aura has a different effect depending on the environment you choose ketika kamu enter your rage: Desert, Sea, or Tundra.

Desert: When this effect is activated, all other creatures of your choice in your aura take 2 fire kerusakan each. The kerusakan increases to 3 at 5th level, 4 at 10th level, 5 at 15th level, and 6 at 20th level.

Sea: When this effect is activated, kamu dapat memilih one other creature kamu bisa melihat in your aura. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw. The target takes 1d6 lightning kerusakan on a failed save, or half as much kerusakan on a successful one. The kerusakan increases to 2d6 at 10th level, 3d6 at 15th level, and 4d6 at 20th level.

Tundra: When this effect is activated, setiap makhluk pilihanmu in your aura mendapatkan 2 poin kesehatan sementara, which last until your rage ends. The poin kesehatan sementara increase to 3 at 5th level, 4 at 10th level, 5 at 15th level, and 6 at 20th level.
features.summary: The target takes 1d6 lightning kerusakan on a failed save, or half as much kerusakan on a successful one. (action).

features.name: Storm Soul
features.description:
At 6th level, the storm grants you benefits even when your rage isn't active. You mendapatkan resistance to the tipe kerusakan associated with your chosen environment: fire (Desert), lightning (Sea), or cold (Tundra).

In addition, as aksi, kamu dapat create a bolt of lightning or a wave of freezing cold. If you chose Desert, kamu dapat menyalurkan the produce flame cantrip, requiring no material components. If you chose Sea, kamu dapat menyalurkan the create or destroy water sihir, requiring no material components. If you chose Tundra, kamu dapat menyalurkan the fog cloud sihir, requiring no material components. You can cast these sihir without expending slot sihir, and kamu memulihkan kembali the ability to cast them this way ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Gain resistance to the tipe kerusakan associated with your chosen environment: fire (Desert), lightning (Sea), or cold (Tundra). (action).

features.name: Shielding Storm
features.description: At 10th level, the storm you channel grows powerful enough to resist magical effects. Each creature of your choice that kamu bisa melihat in your aura has keuntungan on saving throws against sihir and other magical effects.
features.summary: Each creature of your choice that kamu bisa melihat in your aura has keuntungan on saving throws against sihir and other magical effects.

features.name: Raging Storm
features.description:
At 14th level, the storm you channel responds to your fury. When you use your Storm Aura, kamu dapat memilih one additional effect based on your chosen environment:

Desert: When makhluk starts its turn in your aura, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to force it to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has kerugian on attack rolls until the start of its next turn.

Sea: When makhluk hits you with a melee attack, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to deal lightning kerusakan to the attacker equal to your rage kerusakan bonus.

Tundra: When makhluk starts its turn in your aura, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to force it to make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, its speed is reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn.
features.summary: On a failed save, the creature has kerugian on attack rolls until the start of its next turn. (reaction).

subclasses.name: Totem Warrior
subclasses.description:
The Path of the Totem Warrior is a spiritual journey, as the barbarian accepts a spirit animal as guide, protector, and inspiration. In battle, your totem spirit fills you with supernatural might, adding magical fuel to your barbarian rage.

Most barbarian tribes consider a totem animal to be kin to the members of the tribe. It is rare for an individual to have more than one totem animal spirit in a lifetime, though exceptions exist.

features.name: Spirit Seeker
features.description: Yours is a path that seeks attunement with the natural world, granting you a kinship with beasts. At 3rd level ketika kamu adopt this path, kamu mendapatkan the ability to cast the beast sense and speak with animals sihir, but only as rituals.
features.summary: Yours is a path that seeks attunement with the natural world, granting you a kinship with beasts.

features.name: Totem Spirit
features.description: At 3rd level, ketika kamu adopt this path, you choose a totem spirit and mendapatkan a totem feature. You must make or acquire a physical totem object — an amulet or similar adornment — that incorporates fur or feathers, claws, teeth, or bones of the animal you choose. At your option, you also mendapatkan minor physical attributes from your totem animal. Your choices and the associated benefits are: Bear. While raging, kamu memiliki ketahanan terhadap all kerusakan except psychic kerusakan. Eagle. While raging, other creatures have kerugian on opportunity attacks against you, and kamu dapat menggunakan the Dash action as aksi bonus on giliranmu. Wolf. While raging, your friends have keuntungan on melee attack rolls against any creature within 5 feet of you that is hostile to you.
features.summary: Your friends have keuntungan on melee attack rolls against any creature within 5 feet of you that is hostile to you. (bonus action).

features.name: Aspect of the Beast
features.description: At 6th level, kamu mendapatkan a magical benefit based on the totem animal you choose. You can choose the same animal you chose at 3rd level or a different one. Bear. You mendapatkan the might of a bear. Your carrying capacity (including load, lift, and push) is doubled, and kamu memiliki keuntungan pada Strength checks made to push, pull, lift, or break objects. Eagle. You mendapatkan the eyesight of an eagle. You can see hingga 1 mile away with no difficulty, able to discern even fine details as though looking at something no more than 100 feet away from you. Additionally, dim light doesn't impose kerugian on your Wisdom (Perception) checks. Wolf. You mendapatkan the hunting sensibilities of a wolf. You can track other creatures while traveling at a brisk pace, and kamu dapat bergerak stealthily while traveling at a normal pace.
features.summary: Your carrying capacity (including load, lift, and push) is doubled, and kamu memiliki keuntungan pada Strength checks made to push, pull, lift, or break objects. (action).

features.name: Spirit Walker
features.description: At 10th level, kamu dapat menyalurkan the commune with nature sihir, but only as a ritual. When you do so, a spiritual version of one of the animals you chose for Totem Spirit or Aspect of the Beast makes itself known to you and appears somewhere on the land kamu adalah in.
features.summary: A spiritual version of one of the animals you chose for Totem Spirit or Aspect of the Beast makes itself known to you and appears somewhere on the land you.

features.name: Totemic Attunement
features.description: At 14th level, kamu mendapatkan a magical benefit based on a totem animal you choose. You can choose the same animal you chose at 3rd level or a different one. Bear. While raging, any creature within 5 feet of you that's hostile to you has kerugian on attack rolls against targets other than you or another character with this feature. An enemy is immune to this effect if it can't see or hear you or if it can't be frightened. Eagle. While raging, kamu memiliki a flying speed equal to your current speed. This benefit works only in short bursts; you fall jika kamu end giliranmu in the air and nothing else is holding you aloft. Wolf. While raging, kamu dapat menggunakan aksi bonus on giliranmu to knock a Large or smaller creature prone ketika kamu hit it with a melee weapon attack.
features.summary: Any creature within 5 feet of you that's hostile to you has kerugian on attack rolls against targets other than you or another character with this feature. (bonus action).

subclasses.name: Zealot
subclasses.description: Some deities inspire their followers to channel unrelenting ferocity. These barbarians are zealots—warriors who channel their rage into powerful displays of divine might.

features.name: Divine Fury
features.description: Starting ketika kamu choose this path at 3rd level, kamu dapat channel divine power to fuel your attacks. If you hit makhluk with a melee weapon attack while raging, kamu dapat melempar one additional kerusakan die and add it to the kerusakan of the attack. The kerusakan is of the same type as the attack's normal tipe kerusakan. At 14th level, you roll two additional dadu kerusakan instead of one.
features.summary: The kerusakan is of the same type as the attack's normal tipe kerusakan. (action).

features.name: Warrior of the Gods
features.description: At 6th level, the divine power that fuels your rage allows you to shrug off fatal blows. When you would drop to 0 poin kesehatan as a result of taking kerusakan, kamu dapat membuat a Charisma saving throw (DC 5 + the kerusakan taken). On a success, you drop to 1 poin kesehatan instead. After the saving throw succeeds, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan this feature again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Can make a Charisma saving throw (DC 5 + the kerusakan taken). (action).

features.name: Fanatical Focus
features.description: At 10th level, the divine power that fuels your rage can help you push through harm. If you fail a saving throw while raging, kamu dapat reroll it, and kamu harus use the new roll. You can use this ability only once per rage.
features.summary: At 10th level, the divine power that fuels your rage can help you push through harm. (action).

features.name: Zealous Presence
features.description: At 14th level, you learn to channel divine power to inspire zealotry in others. As aksi bonus, you unleash a battle cry infused with divine energy. Up to ten creatures of your choice within 60 feet of you that can hear kamu memiliki keuntungan pada serangan and saving throws until the start of giliranmu selanjutnya. Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Up to ten creatures of your choice within 60 feet of you that can hear kamu memiliki keuntungan pada serangan and saving throws until the start of your next.

subclasses.name: College of Creation
subclasses.description: Bards of the College of Creation believe that the cosmos was drawn into existence through the Song of Creation, and that fragments of that primordial music still resound in every particle of matter.

features.name: Mote of Potential
features.summary: Bardic Inspiration creates a dancing mote of potential granting extra effects on checks, attacks, and saves.
features.description: Whenever you give makhluk a Bardic Inspiration die, kamu dapat utter a note from the Song of Creation to create a Tiny mote of potential, which orbits the creature within 5 feet. When the creature uses the die, the mote provides an additional effect: Ability Check (roll twice and pick highest), Attack Roll (explodes with thunder kerusakan equal to inspiration roll to target and creatures within 5 ft), or Saving Throw (mendapatkan temp HP equal to the roll plus your Charisma modifier).

features.name: Performance of Creation
features.summary: Magically create one nonmagical item worth hingga 20 times your bard level in gold.
features.description: As aksi, kamu dapat channel the magic of the Song of Creation to create one nonmagical item of your choice in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of you. The item must be of a size no larger than Medium, and its value can be no more than 20 times your bard level in gp. The item glistens faintly and lasts for a number of hours equal to bonus keahlianmu. You can use this feature once per long rest, or by expending a 2nd-level or higher sihir slot.

features.name: Animating Performance
features.summary: Animate a Large or smaller nonmagical object into a friendly Dancing Item construct.
features.description: As aksi, kamu dapat animate one Large or smaller nonmagical item within 30 feet of you. The item uses the Dancing Item stat block, is friendly to you and your companions, and obeys your mental commands as aksi bonus. It has an aura of 10 feet that increases ally movement and slows enemies. It remains animated for 1 hour, until reduced to 0 HP, or until you die. You can use this feature once per long rest, or by expending a 3rd-level or higher sihir slot.

features.name: Creative Crescendo
features.summary: Create multiple items with Performance of Creation, with no gold cost limit and hingga Huge size.
features.description: When you use your Performance of Creation feature, kamu dapat now create more than one item at a time. The number of items equals your Charisma modifier (minimum of two). One of the items can be Huge, and the gp limit on the items' value no longer applies.

subclasses.name: College of Eloquence
subclasses.description: Adherents of the College of Eloquence master the art of oratory. Persuasion is elevated to an art form, and their silver tongues can turn foes into friends and unravel the resolve of their adversaries.

features.name: Silver Tongue
features.summary: Treat any roll of 9 or lower on the d20 as a 10 for Persuasion and Deception checks.
features.description: You are a master at saying the right thing at the right time. When you make a Charisma (Persuasion) or Charisma (Deception) check, kamu dapat memperlakukan a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

features.name: Unsettling Words
features.summary: Expend a Bardic Inspiration die to subtract the roll from a target's next saving throw.
features.description: You can spin words laced with magic that unsettle makhluk and cause it to doubt itself. As aksi bonus, kamu dapat menghabiskan one use of your Bardic Inspiration and choose satu makhluk yang kamu lihat within 60 feet of you. Roll the Bardic Inspiration die. The creature must subtract the number rolled from the next saving throw it makes before the start of giliranmu selanjutnya.

features.name: Unfailing Inspiration
features.summary: A creature does not lose its Bardic Inspiration die if it fails the roll.
features.description: Your inspiring words are so persuasive that others feel driven to succeed. When makhluk adds one of your Bardic Inspiration dice to its ability check, attack roll, or saving throw and the roll fails, the creature can keep the Bardic Inspiration die to use again on a future roll.

features.name: Universal Speech
features.summary: Make your speech completely understandable to any creatures regardless of language.
features.description: You have didapatkan the ability to make your speech intelligible to any creature. As aksi, choose one or more creatures within 60 feet of you, hingga a number equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one). The chosen creatures can magically understand you, regardless of the language you speak, for 1 hour. You can use this feature once per long rest, or by expending slot sihir.

features.name: Infectious Inspiration
features.summary: Inspire another creature without expending a die when an ally succeeds using inspiration.
features.description: When you successfully inspire someone, the power of your eloquence can spread to someone else. When makhluk dalam 60 feet of you adds one of your Bardic Inspiration dice to its roll and the roll succeeds, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to grant another creature within 60 feet a Bardic Inspiration die without expending any of your Bardic Inspiration uses.

subclasses.name: College of Glamour
subclasses.description: The College of Glamour is the home of bards who mastered their craft in the vibrant realm of the Feywild or under the tutelage of someone who dwelled there. Tutored by satyrs, eladrin, and other fey creatures, these bards learn to use their magic to delight and captivate others.

features.name: Mantle of Inspiration
features.description: When you join the College of Glamour at 3rd level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to weave a song of fey magic that imbues your allies with vigor and speed. As aksi bonus, kamu dapat menghabiskan one use of your Bardic Inspiration to grant yourself a wondrous appearance. When you do so, choose hingga five creatures of your choice within 60 feet of you. Each target mendapatkan 5 poin kesehatan sementara and can use its reaction to move hingga its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
features.summary: Gain the ability to weave a song of fey magic that imbues your allies with vigor and speed. (bonus action).

features.name: Enthralling Performance
features.description: Starting at 6th level, kamu dapat menggunakan musical or oratorial performance to weave a song of fey magic that charms your listeners. If you perform for at least 1 minute, kamu dapat then choose a number of humanoids within 60 feet of you who watched or listened to your performance, hingga a number equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one). Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your sihir save DC or be charmed by you. While charmed, the target idolates you and hinders anyone attempting to harm you, but it will not obey your orders. This effect ends on a target after 1 hour, if it takes kerusakan, jika kamu attack it, or if it witnesses you attacking its allies. Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat singkat atau panjang.
features.summary: Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your sihir save DC or be charmed by you. (action).

features.name: Mantle of Majesty
features.description: At 14th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to cloak yourself in a fey majesty. As aksi bonus, you cast command, requiring no sihir slot or material components, and you take on an appearance of unearthly beauty (as the alter self sihir, but only affecting your appearance). The sihir lasts for 1 minute. During that time, kamu dapat menyalurkan command as aksi bonus on each of your turns, without expending slot sihir. Any creature charmed by you automatically fails its saving throw against the command sihir you cast with this feature. Once you use this bonus action, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang, unless you expend slot sihir of 3rd level or higher to use it again.
features.summary: Any creature charmed by you automatically fails its saving throw against the command sihir you cast with this feature. (bonus action).

subclasses.name: College of Spirits
subclasses.description: Bards of the College of Spirits seek to tell the stories of those who have passed on, using their magic to channel the spirits of the dead. These bards are often found in graveyards, haunted houses, and other places where the dead linger.

features.name: Spiritual Focus
features.description: You employ tools that aid you in channeling spirits, such as a candle, crystal, or totem. When you cast a bard sihir that deals kerusakan or memulihkan poin kesehatan while holding your spiritual focus, kamu dapat melempar a d6 and add it to the roll. You can use this feature a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu, and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: When you cast a bard sihir that deals kerusakan or memulihkan Hit Points while holding your spiritual focus, roll a d6 and add it to the kerusakan or penyembuhan roll.

features.name: Tales from Beyond
features.description: You can reach out to the spirits of the dead to tell you stories. As aksi bonus, kamu dapat melempar a d6 and add it to your next ability check, attack roll, or saving throw. You can use this feature a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu, and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Can roll a d6 and add it to your next ability check, attack roll, or saving throw. (bonus action).

features.name: Spiritual Focus (Improved)
features.description: Your spiritual focus becomes more powerful. When you cast a bard sihir that deals kerusakan or memulihkan poin kesehatan while holding your spiritual focus, kamu dapat melempar a d8 instead of a d6 and add it to the roll.
features.summary: Can roll a d8 instead of a d6 and add it to the roll. (action).

features.name: Spirit Session
features.description: You can cast the speak with dead sihir at will, without expending slot sihir. When you cast sihir itu in this way, kamu dapat ask the corpse hingga seven questions, rather than five.
features.summary: Can cast the speak with dead sihir at will, without expending slot sihir. (action).

features.name: Mystical Connection
features.description: You can use your Tales from Beyond feature without expending a use of it. When you do so, you roll a d8 instead of a d6.
features.summary: Use Tales from Beyond without expending a use. When you do so, roll a d8 instead of a d6.

subclasses.name: College of Swords
subclasses.description: Bards of the College of Swords are called blades, and they entertain through daring feats of weapon prowess. They perform stunts such as sword swallowing, knife throwing, and juggling. Though they use their weapons to entertain, they are highly trained and skilled warriors.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: When you join the College of Swords at 3rd level, kamu mendapatkan keahlian dengan armor medium, scimitars, and the performer's kit.
features.summary: Gain keahlian with medium armor, scimitars, and the performer's kit.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: At 3rd level, you adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one of the following options: Dueling, Two-Weapon Fighting, or Great Weapon Fighting. You can't take a Fighting Style option more than once, even jika kamu get to choose again.

choices.name: Dueling
choices.description: When kamu adalah wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, kamu mendapatkan a +2 bonus to kerusakan rolls with that weapon.

choices.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
choices.description: When you engage in two-weapon fighting, kamu dapat menambahkan ability modifier to the kerusakan of the second attack.

choices.name: Great Weapon Fighting
choices.description: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a kerusakan die for an attack you make with a melee weapon that kamu adalah wielding with two hands, kamu dapat reroll the die and must use the new roll.

features.summary: Can't take a Fighting Style option more than once, even jika kamu get to choose again. (permanent).

features.name: Blade Flourish
features.description: At 3rd level, you learn to perform impressive displays of martial prowess and speed. Whenever you take the Attack action on giliranmu, kamu dapat menggunakan aksi bonus to use one of the following flourishes: Defensive Flourish, Slashing Flourish, or Mobile Flourish. Defensive Flourish: You can expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration to add the number you roll to AC-mu until the start of giliranmu selanjutnya. Slashing Flourish: You can expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration to deal extra kerusakan to the target you hit and to any other creature of your choice within 5 feet of you. Mobile Flourish: You can expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration to push the target you hit hingga 15 feet away from you, plus a number of feet equal to the number you roll on the Bardic Inspiration die. The target is pushed to an unoccupied space of your choice.
features.summary: Slashing Flourish: You can expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration to deal extra kerusakan to the target you hit and to any other creature of your choice within 5.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Starting at 6th level, kamu dapat attack twice, instead of once, setiap kali kamu take the Attack action on giliranmu.
features.requirement: Only when taking the Attack action
features.scaling: Three attacks at level 11, four attacks at level 20
features.summary: Starting at 6th level, kamu dapat attack twice, instead of once, setiap kali kamu take the Attack action on giliranmu. (only when taking the attack action, permanent, scales).

features.name: Master Flourish
features.description: Starting at 14th level, setiap kali kamu use a Blade Flourish option, kamu dapat melempar a d6 and use it instead of expending a Bardic Inspiration die.
features.summary: Starting at 14th level, setiap kali kamu use a Blade Flourish option, kamu dapat melempar a d6 and use it instead of expending a Bardic Inspiration die. (action).

subclasses.name: College of Whispers
subclasses.description: Most bards share their tales with a wide audience. The bards of the College of Whispers, however, use their knowledge to uncover secrets and turn them against others through dread and fear.

features.name: Psychic Blades
features.description: When you join the College of Whispers at 3rd level, you learn to make senjatamu attacks especially deadly. When you hit makhluk with a weapon attack, kamu dapat menghabiskan one use of your Bardic Inspiration to deal an extra 2d6 psychic kerusakan to that target. The kerusakan increases to 3d6 at 5th level, 5d6 at 10th level, 8d6 at 15th level, and 10d6 at 20th level.
features.summary: Can expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration to deal an extra 2d6 psychic kerusakan to that target. (action).

features.name: Words of Terror
features.description: At 6th level, kamu dapat weave words of dread to frighten makhluk. If you speak to a humanoid alone for at least 1 minute, kamu dapat then attempt to seed paranoia in its mind. At the end of the conversation, the target must make a Wisdom saving throw against your sihir save DC. On a failed save, the target is frightened of you or another creature of your choice. The frightened condition lasts for 1 hour, until the target is attacked or damaged, or until the target witnesses its allies being attacked or damaged. If the target succeeds on the saving throw, the target doesn't suspect that you tried to frighten it. Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat singkat atau panjang.
features.summary: At the end of the conversation, the target must make a Wisdom saving throw against your sihir save DC. (action).

features.name: Mantle of Whispers
features.description: At 14th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to adopt a humanoid's persona. When a humanoid dies within 30 feet of you, kamu dapat magically capture its shadow using reaksimu. You retain this shadow until you use it or menyelesaikan istirahat panjang. You can use the shadow as a disguise, as the disguise self sihir, but it affects only your appearance. You can also use the shadow to mendapatkan information about the creature, as the speak with dead sihir, but kamu dapat only ask one question. Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat singkat atau panjang.
features.summary: Can magically capture its shadow using reaksimu. (reaction).

subclasses.name: Lore
subclasses.description: Bards of the College of Lore know something about most things, collecting bits of knowledge from sources as diverse as scholarly tomes and peasant tales. Whether singing folk ballads in taverns or elaborate compositions in royal courts, these bards use their gifts to hold audiences spellbound. When the applause dies down, the audience members might find themselves questioning everything they held to be true, from their faith in the priesthood of the local temple to their loyalty to the king. The loyalty of these bards lies in the pursuit of beauty and truth, not in fealty to a monarch or following the tenets of a deity. A noble who keeps such a bard as a herald or advisor knows that the bard would rather be honest than politic. The college's members gather in libraries and sometimes in actual colleges, complete with classrooms and dormitories, to share their lore with one another. They also meet at festivals or affairs of state, where they can expose corruption, unravel lies, and poke fun at self-important figures of authority.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: When you join the College of Lore at 3rd level, kamu mendapatkan keahlian dengan three skills of your choice.
features.summary: Gain keahlian with three skills of your choice.

features.name: Cutting Words
features.description:
Also at 3rd level, you learn how to use your wit to distract, confuse, and otherwise sap the confidence and competence of others.
When makhluk that kamu bisa melihat within 60 feet of you makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a kerusakan roll, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to expend one of your uses of Bardic Inspiration, rolling a Bardic Inspiration die and subtracting the number rolled from the creature's roll.
You can choose to use this feature after the creature makes its roll, but before the GM determines whether the attack roll or ability check succeeds or fails, or before the creature deals its kerusakan. The creature is immune if it can't hear you or if it's immune to being charmed.
features.summary: When makhluk dalam 60 feet makes an attack roll, ability check, or kerusakan roll, use reaksimu to expend one Bardic Inspiration use and subtract the Bardic Inspiration die roll from the creature's roll. Must be used before the GM determines the outcome.

features.name: Additional Magical Secrets
features.description: At 6th level, you learn two sihir of your choice from any class. A sihir you choose must be of a level kamu dapat menyalurkan, as shown on the Bard table, or a cantrip. The chosen sihir count as bard sihir for you but don't count against the number of bard sihir you know.

choices.name: spell1
choices.description: Choose one sihir from any class

choices.name: spell2
choices.description: Choose another sihir from any class

features.summary: The chosen sihir count as bard sihir for you but don't count against the number of bard sihir you know. (action).

features.name: Peerless Skill
features.description: Starting at 14th level, ketika kamu make an ability check, kamu dapat menghabiskan one use of Bardic Inspiration. Roll a Bardic Inspiration die and add the number rolled to keampuanmu check. You can choose to do so after you roll the die for the ability check, but before the GM tells you whether you succeed or fail.
features.summary: Starting at 14th level, ketika kamu make an ability check, kamu dapat menghabiskan one use of Bardic Inspiration. (action).

subclasses.name: Valor
subclasses.description:
Bards of the College of Valor are daring skalds, telling tales of great heroes and performing deeds worthy of song. They wander the land to witness great events firsthand and see the deeds of legendary heroes.

As they travel from place to place, these bards inspire others with songs and stories of past glories, stirring their audiences to greatness and spurring them to action. The college's members gather to share their lore with one another and celebrate their common bond.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: When you join the College of Lore at 3rd level, kamu mendapatkan keahlian dengan three skills of your choice.
features.summary: Gain keahlian with three skills of your choice.

features.name: Combat Inspiration
features.description: Also at 3rd level, you learn to inspire others in combat. A creature that has a Bardic Inspiration die from kamu dapat melempar that die and add the number rolled to a weapon kerusakan roll it just made. Alternatively, when an attack roll is made against the creature, it can use its reaction to roll the Bardic Inspiration die and add the number rolled to its AC against that attack, after seeing the roll but before knowing whether it hits or misses.
features.summary: Alternatively, when an attack roll is made against the creature, it can use its reaction to roll the Bardic Inspiration die and add the number rolled to its AC against.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Beginning at 5th level, kamu dapat attack twice, instead of once, setiap kali kamu take the Attack action on giliranmu.
features.requirement: Only when taking the Attack action
features.scaling: Three attacks at level 11, four attacks at level 20
features.summary: Beginning at 5th level, kamu dapat attack twice, instead of once, setiap kali kamu take the Attack action on giliranmu. (only when taking the attack action, permanent, scales).

features.name: Battle Magic
features.description: At 14th level, kamu memiliki mastered the art of weaving spellcasting and weapon use together. When you use aksimu to cast a bard sihir, kamu dapat membuat one weapon attack as aksi bonus.
features.summary: Can make one weapon attack as aksi bonus. (bonus action).

subclasses.name: Arcana Domain
subclasses.description: Magic is an energy that suffuses the multiverse. Clerics of the Arcana Domain revere the deities of magic, knowing that arcane magic and divine devotion can weave together in sublime mystery.

features.name: Arcane Initiate
features.summary: Gain keahlian in Arcana and learn two wizard cantrip that count as cleric cantrip.
features.description: When you choose this domain at 1st level, kamu mendapatkan keahlian dalam the Arcana skill, and kamu mendapatkan two cantrip of your choice from the wizard sihir list. For you, these cantrip count as cleric cantrip.

features.name: Arcana Domain Spells
features.summary: Gain domain sihir at levels 1, 3, 5, 7, and 9.
features.description: 1st: Detect Magic, Magic Missile; 3rd: Magic Weapon, Nondetection; 5th: Dispel Magic, Magic Circle; 7th: Arcane Eye, Leomund's Secret Chest; 9th: Planar Binding, Teleportation Circle.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Arcane Abjuration
features.summary: Turn or banish celestial, elemental, fey, or fiend creatures within 30 feet.
features.description: As aksi, you present your holy symbol and one celestial, elemental, fey, or fiend within 30 feet must succeed on a Wisdom save or be turned for 1 minute. Starting at 5th level, turned creatures of low CR are banished to their home plane instead.

features.name: Spell Breaker
features.summary: When you menyembuhkan an ally with sihir, end one sihir of equal or lower level on that ally.
features.description: Starting at 6th level, ketika kamu memulihkan poin kesehatan to an ally with sihir of 1st level or higher, kamu dapat also end one sihir of your choice on that creature. The level of sihir itu you end must be equal to or lower than the level of sihir itu slot you used to cast the penyembuhan sihir.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.summary: Add Wisdom modifier to cleric cantrip kerusakan.
features.description: Starting at 8th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to the kerusakan you deal with any cleric cantrip.

features.name: Arcane Mastery
features.summary: Learn four wizard sihir (one each of 6th, 7th, 8th, and 9th level) as domain sihir.
features.description: At 17th level, you choose four sihir from the wizard sihir list, one from each of the following levels: 6th, 7th, 8th, and 9th. You add them to your domain sihir, always prepared and casting them as cleric sihir.

subclasses.name: Death Domain
subclasses.description: The Death domain is concerned with the forces that cause death, as well as the negative energy that powers undead creatures. Clerics of death are feared necromancers and heralds of finality.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.summary: Gain keahlian with martial weapons.
features.description: At 1st level, kamu mendapatkan keahlian dengan martial weapons.

features.name: Reaper
features.summary: Target two adjacent creatures with necromancy cantrip that normally target one.
features.description: At 1st level, when the cleric casts a necromancy cantrip that normally targets only satu makhluk, sihir itu can instead target two creatures within range and within 5 feet of each other.

features.name: Death Domain Spells
features.summary: Gain domain sihir at levels 1, 3, 5, 7, and 9.
features.description: 1st: False Life, Ray of Sickness; 3rd: Blindness/Deafness, Ray of Enfeeblement; 5th: Animate Dead, Vampiric Touch; 7th: Blight, Death Ward; 9th: Antilife Shell, Cloudkill.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Touch of Death
features.summary: Add 5 + (2 x cleric level) necrotic kerusakan to a successful melee attack.
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, when the cleric hits makhluk with a melee attack, the cleric can use Channel Divinity to deal extra necrotic kerusakan to the target equal to 5 + twice his or her cleric level.

features.name: Inescapable Destruction
features.summary: Necrotic kerusakan dealt by your cleric sihir and Channel Divinity ignores resistance to necrotic kerusakan.
features.description: Starting at 6th level, the cleric's ability to channel negative energy becomes more potent. Necrotic kerusakan dealt by the character's cleric sihir and Channel Divinity options ignores resistance to necrotic kerusakan.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.summary: Once on each turn, deal extra 1d8 necrotic kerusakan on a weapon hit (2d8 at 14th).
features.description: At 8th level, the cleric mendapatkan the ability to infuse his or her weapon strikes with necrotic energy. Once on each of the cleric's turns when he or she hits makhluk with a weapon attack, the cleric can cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 necrotic kerusakan. At 14th level, this increases to 2d8.

features.name: Improved Reaper
features.summary: Target two adjacent creatures with 1st through 5th level necromancy sihir.
features.description: Starting at 17th level, when the cleric casts a necromancy sihir of 1st through 5th level that targets only satu makhluk, sihir itu can instead target two creatures within range and within 5 feet of each other.

subclasses.name: Forge Domain
subclasses.description: The gods of the forge are patrons of artisans who work with metal, from a humble blacksmith to an elven smith who mithral. The gods of the forge teach that, with patience and hard work, even the most intractable metal can be transformed from a lump of iron into a beautiful object. Clerics of the forge domain are the divine embodiment of the power of the forge.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: When you choose this domain at 1st level, kamu mendapatkan keahlian dengan armor berat and smith's tools.
features.summary: Gain keahlian with heavy armor and smith's tools. (action).

features.name: Blessing of the Forge
features.description: At 1st level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to imbue magic into a weapon or armor. At the end of istirahat panjang, kamu dapat touch one nonmagical object that is a suit of armor or a simple or martial weapon. Until the end of your next long rest or until you die, the object becomes a magic item, granting a +1 bonus to AC (armor) or a +1 bonus to attack and kerusakan rolls (weapon). Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Gain the ability to imbue magic into a weapon or armor.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Artisan's Blessing
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, kamu dapat menggunakan your Channel Divinity to create a nonmagical item that is worth no more than 100 gp. The item must be made of metal, and kamu harus spend 10 minutes in prayer and work to create it. The item can be a suit of armor, a weapon, a set of tools, or another object. The object appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you. If you create a weapon, it is a simple or martial weapon of your choice. If you create a suit of armor, it is light, medium, or heavy armor of your choice. If you create a set of tools, they are artisan's tools of your choice.
features.summary: The item must be made of metal, and kamu harus spend 10 minutes in prayer and work to create it. (action).

features.name: Soul of the Forge
features.description: Starting at 6th level, your mastery of the forge grants you special resistances. You mendapatkan resistance to fire kerusakan. In addition, while kamu adalah wearing heavy armor, kamu memiliki a +1 bonus to AC.
features.summary: Gain resistance to fire kerusakan. While wearing heavy armor, mendapatkan a +1 bonus to AC.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: At 8th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to infuse senjatamu strikes with divine energy. Once on each of your turns ketika kamu hit makhluk with a weapon attack, kamu dapat cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 fire kerusakan. When you reach 14th level, the extra kerusakan increases to 2d8.
features.summary: Once on each of your turns ketika kamu hit makhluk with a weapon attack, kamu dapat cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 fire kerusakan. (action).

features.name: Saint of Forge and Fire
features.description: At 17th level, your blessed affinity with the forge mendapatkan divine benefits. You mendapatkan immunity to fire kerusakan. In addition, while kamu adalah wearing heavy armor, kamu memiliki ketahanan terhadap bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing kerusakan from nonmagical weapons.
features.summary: Gain immunity to fire kerusakan. While wearing heavy armor, mendapatkan resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing kerusakan from nonmagical weapons.

subclasses.name: Grave Domain
subclasses.description: Gods of the grave watch over the line between life and death. To these deities, death and the afterlife are a foundational part of the multiverse. To desecrate the peace of the dead is an abomination. Deities of the grave include Kelemvor, Wee Jas, and the ancestors of many cultures.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: When you choose this domain at 1st level, kamu mendapatkan keahlian dengan armor berat.
features.summary: Gain keahlian with heavy armor.

features.name: Circle of Mortality
features.description: At 1st level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to manipulate the line between life and death. When you would normally roll one or more dice to memulihkan poin kesehatan to makhluk at 0 poin kesehatan, you instead use the highest number possible for each die. In addition, you learn the spare the dying cantrip, which doesn't count against your number of cantrip known. For you, it has a range of 30 feet, and kamu dapat menyalurkannya as aksi bonus.
features.summary: Instead use the highest number possible for each die. (bonus action).

features.name: Eyes of the Grave
features.description: At 1st level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to sense the presence of the undead. As aksi, kamu dapat open your awareness to magically detect undead. Until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya, you know the location of any undead within 60 feet of you that isn't behind total cover and that isn't protected from divination magic. This sense doesn't tell you anything about the creature's capabilities or identity. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya, you know the location of any undead within 60 feet of you that isn't behind total cover and that isn't protected from divination.

features.name: Path to the Grave
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, kamu dapat menggunakan your Channel Divinity to mark makhluk close to death for destruction. As aksi, you choose satu makhluk yang kamu lihat within 30 feet of you, cursing it until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya. The next time you or an ally of yours hits the cursed creature with an attack, the creature has vulnerability to all kerusakan from that attack, and then the curse ends.
features.summary: Choose satu makhluk yang kamu lihat within 30 feet of you, cursing it until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya. (action).

features.name: Sentinel at Death's Door
features.description: At 6th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to impede death's progress. When you or makhluk dalam 30 feet of you succeeds on a death saving throw or succeeds on a saving throw against a disease or effect that causes the poisoned condition, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to cancel the effect. Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat singkat atau panjang.
features.summary: Can use reaksimu to cancel the effect. (reaction).

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: At 8th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to infuse senjatamu strikes with divine energy. Once on each of your turns ketika kamu hit makhluk with a weapon attack, kamu dapat cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 necrotic kerusakan. When you reach 14th level, the extra extra kerusakan increases to 2d8.
features.summary: Once on each of your turns ketika kamu hit makhluk with a weapon attack, kamu dapat cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 necrotic kerusakan. (action).

features.name: Keeper of Souls
features.description: Starting at 17th level, kamu dapat seize a trace of vitality from a soul that has recently passed on. When makhluk yang kamu lihat dies within 60 feet of you, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to make a Charisma check (DC 10). On a success, you steal some of the creature's life force, and kamu dapat memilih satu makhluk yang kamu lihat within 30 feet of you. That creature mendapatkan poin kesehatan sementara equal to the result of the check. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once), and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Can use reaksimu to make a Charisma check (DC 10). (reaction).

subclasses.name: Knowledge
subclasses.description:
The Knowledge domain represents the pursuit of knowledge and understanding of the world and the gods. Its clerics are scholars, sages, and seekers of truth, using their divine gifts to uncover secrets and illuminate the mysteries of existence.

Gods of knowledge—including Oghma, Boccob, Gilean, and Aureon—value learning and understanding above all. Some teach that knowledge is to be gathered and shared in libraries and universities, while others believe it should be kept secret and used only by the worthy.

features.name: Blessings of Knowledge
features.description: At 1st level, you learn two languages of your choice and mendapatkan two skills of your choice.
features.summary: At 1st level, you learn two languages of your choice and mendapatkan two skills of your choice.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Knowledge of the Ages
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, kamu dapat menggunakan your Channel Divinity to tap into a reservoir of knowledge. As aksi, kamu menjadi ahli in one skill or tool of your choice until you menyelesaikan istirahat singkat atau panjang. You can use this feature again setelah istirahat singkat atau panjang.
features.summary: Can use this feature again setelah istirahat singkat atau panjang. (action).

features.name: Channel Divinity: Read Thoughts
features.description: At 6th level, kamu dapat menggunakan your Channel Divinity to read makhluk's thoughts. You can then use your access to the creature's mind to command it, probe it, or probe its memories.
features.summary: At 6th level, kamu dapat menggunakan your Channel Divinity to read makhluk's thoughts. (action).

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.description: Starting at 8th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to the kerusakan rolls of your cleric sihir.
features.summary: Starting at 8th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to the kerusakan rolls of your cleric sihir. (action).

features.name: Visions of the Past
features.description: Starting at 17th level, kamu dapat call upon your deity to reveal visions of the past. You can receive visions of the past by spending at least 1 minute in meditation and prayer, and kamu dapat receive visions of the past of a specific object, creature, or location.
features.summary: Starting at 17th level, kamu dapat call upon your deity to reveal visions of the past. (action).

subclasses.name: Life
subclasses.description: The Life domain focuses on the vibrant positive energy--one of the fundamental forces of the universe--that sustains all life. The gods of life promote vitality and health through penyembuhan the sick and wounded, caring for those in need, and driving away the forces of death and undeath. Almost any non-evil deity can claim influence over this domain, particularly agricultural deities, sun gods, gods of penyembuhan or endurance, and gods of home and community.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: When you choose this domain at 1st level, kamu mendapatkan keahlian dengan armor berat.
features.summary: Gain keahlian with heavy armor. (action).

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.description: Also starting at 1st level, your penyembuhan sihir are more effective. Whenever you use sihir of 1st level or higher to memulihkan poin kesehatan to makhluk, the creature memulihkan kembali additional poin kesehatan equal to 2 + sihir itu's level.
features.summary: Whenever you use sihir of 1st level or higher to memulihkan poin kesehatan to makhluk, the creature memulihkan kembali additional poin kesehatan equal to 2 + sihir itu's.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Preserve Life
features.description:
Starting at 2nd level, kamu dapat menggunakan your Channel Divinity to menyembuhkan the badly injured.
As aksi, you present your holy symbol and evoke penyembuhan energy that can memulihkan a number of poin kesehatan equal to five times your cleric level.
Choose any creatures within 30 feet of you, and divide those poin kesehatan among them. This feature can memulihkan makhluk to no more than half of its poin kesehatan maximum. You can't use this feature on an undead or a construct.
features.summary: Choose any creatures within 30 feet of you, and divide those poin kesehatan among them. (action).

features.name: Blessed Healer
features.description: Beginning at 6th level, the penyembuhan sihir you cast on others menyembuhkan you as well. When you cast sihir of 1st level or higher that memulihkan poin kesehatan to makhluk other than you, kamu memulihkan kembali poin kesehatan equal to 2 + sihir itu's level.
features.summary: Regain poin kesehatan equal to 2 + sihir itu's level.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: At 8th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to infuse senjatamu strikes with divine energy. Once on each of your turns ketika kamu hit makhluk with a weapon attack, kamu dapat cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 radiant kerusakan to the target. When you reach 14th level, the extra kerusakan increases to 2d8.
features.summary: Once on each of your turns ketika kamu hit makhluk with a weapon attack, kamu dapat cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 radiant kerusakan.

features.name: Supreme Healing
features.description: Starting at 17th level, ketika kamu would normally roll one or more dice to memulihkan poin kesehatan with sihir, you instead use the highest number possible for each die. For example, instead of restoring 2d6 poin kesehatan to makhluk, you memulihkan 12.
features.summary: Instead of restoring 2d6 poin kesehatan to makhluk, you memulihkan 12. (action).

subclasses.name: Light
subclasses.description:
The Light domain represents the power of light, fire, and revelation. Its clerics are beacons of hope and clarity, using radiant energy to burn away darkness, undeath, and deception.

Gods of light—including Lathander, Pelor, Ra, and Apollo—promote the ideals of rebirth and renewal, truth, vigilance, and beauty, often using the symbol of the sun. Gods of the Light domain are often associated with fire as a symbol of purity and truth.

features.name: Bonus Cantrip
features.description: When you choose this circle at 2nd level, you learn one additional druid cantrip of your choice.
features.summary: Learn one additional druid cantrip of your choice. (action).

features.name: Warding Flare
features.description: At 1st level, kamu dapat interpose divine light between yourself and an enemy. When kamu adalah attacked by makhluk dalam 30 feet of you that kamu bisa melihat, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to impose kerugian on the attack roll, causing light to flare before the attacker. An attacker can't benefit from this feature if it can't see or is immune to being blinded. You can use this number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Can use reaksimu to impose kerugian on the attack roll, causing light to flare before the attacker. (reaction).

features.name: Channel Divinity: Radiance of the Dawn
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, kamu dapat menggunakan your Channel Divinity to flood an area with radiant energy.
features.summary: Starting at 2nd level, kamu dapat menggunakan your Channel Divinity to flood an area with radiant energy. (action).

features.name: Improved Flare
features.description: Starting at 6th level, kamu dapat menyalurkan the fireball sihir once per long rest.
features.summary: Starting at 6th level, kamu dapat menyalurkan the fireball sihir once per long rest.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.description: Starting at 8th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to the kerusakan rolls of your cleric sihir.
features.summary: Starting at 8th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to the kerusakan rolls of your cleric sihir. (action).

features.name: Corona of Light
features.description: Starting at 17th level, kamu dapat menggunakan aksimu to emanate a bright light. For 1 minute, bright light shines from you in a 30-foot radius, and dim light shines 30 feet beyond that. Creatures of your choice in the bright light have kerugian on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and on saving throws against sihir that deal fire or radiant kerusakan. You can end this effect on yourself early by using aksi bonus to dismiss it.
features.summary: Creatures of your choice in the bright light have kerugian on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and on saving throws against sihir that deal fire or radiant kerusakan. (bonus action).

subclasses.name: Nature
subclasses.description:
The Nature domain represents the power of the natural world. Its clerics are guardians of the wild, calling upon the primal forces of nature to protect the land and all its creatures.

Gods of nature—including Silvanus, Mielikki, and the Oak Father—revere the natural world and protect it from those who would do it harm. They teach that all living things are connected and that the balance of nature must be maintained.

features.name: Acolyte of Nature
features.description: At 1st level, you learn one druid cantrip of your choice.
features.summary: At 1st level, you learn one druid cantrip of your choice.

features.name: Charm Animals and Plants
features.description: Starting at 1st level, kamu dapat menggunakan aksimu to charm one beast or plant creature within 30 feet of you that can see or hear you. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for 1 minute or until you or your allies kerusakan it.
features.summary: Starting at 1st level, kamu dapat menggunakan aksimu to charm one beast or plant creature within 30 feet of you that can see or hear you. (action).

features.name: Channel Divinity: Charm Animals and Plants
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, kamu dapat menggunakan your Channel Divinity to charm animals and plants. As aksi, you touch a beast or plant creature within 30 feet of you that can see or hear you. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for 1 minute or until you or your allies kerusakan it.
features.summary: Touch a beast or plant creature within 30 feet of you that can see or hear you. (action).

features.name: Dampen Elements
features.description: Starting at 6th level, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to reduce kerusakan. When you or makhluk dalam 30 feet of you takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder kerusakan, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to grant resistance to the creature against that instance of kerusakan.
features.summary: Cold, fire, lightning, or thunder kerusakan, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to grant resistance to the creature against that instance of kerusakan. (reaction).
