features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.description: Starting at 8th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to the kerusakan rolls of your cleric sihir.
features.summary: Starting at 8th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to the kerusakan rolls of your cleric sihir. (action).

features.name: Master of Nature
features.description: Starting at 17th level, kamu dapat menggunakan aksimu to charm beasts and plants. When you use your Channel Divinity to charm animals and plants, the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for 10 minutes or until you or your allies kerusakan it.
features.summary: The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for 10 minutes or until you or your allies kerusakan it. (action).

subclasses.name: Order Domain
subclasses.description: The Order Domain represents devotion to discipline, law, and structure. Clerics of Order strive to establish stability, harmony, and righteous command over chaos and wickedness.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.summary: Gain keahlian with heavy armor and your choice of Intimidation or Persuasion.
features.description: You mendapatkan keahlian with heavy armor. You also mendapatkan keahlian dalam the Intimidation or Persuasion skill (your choice).

features.name: Voice of Authority
features.summary: When you cast a 1st-level or higher sihir targeting an ally, that ally can make a weapon attack as reaksi.
features.description: You can invoke the power of law to drive an ally to strike. Whenever you cast sihir of 1st level or higher that targets an ally, kamu dapat direct that ally to use its reaction immediately after sihir itu to make one weapon attack against makhluk pilihanmu that kamu bisa melihat. If sihir itu targets more than one ally, you choose the ally who can make the attack.

features.name: Order Domain Spells
features.summary: Gain domain sihir at levels 1, 3, 5, 7, and 9.
features.description: You mendapatkan domain sihir at the cleric levels listed in the Order Domain Spells table: 1st: Command, Heroism; 3rd: Hold Person, Zone of Truth; 5th: Mass Healing Word, Slow; 7th: Compulsion, Locate Creature; 9th: Commune, Dominate Person.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Order's Demand
features.summary: Charm creatures within 30 feet and force them to immediately drop weapons they are holding.
features.description: As aksi, you present your holy symbol, and setiap makhluk pilihanmu that can see or hear you within 30 feet must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya or until it takes kerusakan. You can also cause any of the charmed creatures to drop what they are holding when they fail the saving throw.

features.name: Embodiment of the Law
features.summary: Cast an enchantment sihir of 1st level or higher with a casting time of 1 action as aksi bonus.
features.description: You have become remarkably adept at channeling order. If you cast sihir of the enchantment school using slot sihir of 1st level or higher, kamu dapat change sihir itu's casting time to 1 bonus action for this casting, provided sihir itu's normal casting time is 1 action. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.summary: Once on each of your turns, deal an extra 1d8 psychic kerusakan on a weapon hit (2d8 at 14th).
features.description: At 8th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to infuse senjatamu strikes with divine energy. Once on each of your turns ketika kamu hit makhluk with a weapon attack, kamu dapat cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 psychic kerusakan to the target. When you reach 14th level, the extra kerusakan increases to 2d8.

features.name: Order's Wrath
features.summary: Enemies you strike with Divine Strike take an extra 2d8 psychic kerusakan the next time an ally hits them.
features.description: Starting at 17th level, enemies you strike are cursed by your divine authority. When you deal your Divine Strike kerusakan to makhluk, you curse that creature until the start of giliranmu selanjutnya. The next time one of your allies hits the cursed creature with an attack, the target takes an extra 2d8 psychic kerusakan, and the curse ends.

subclasses.name: Peace Domain
subclasses.description: The balm of peace thrives at the heart of healthy communities. Clerics of the Peace Domain act as peacemakers, forging bonds between individuals and penyembuhan physical and emotional wounds.

features.name: Implement of Peace
features.summary: Gain keahlian in Insight, Performance, or Persuasion.
features.description: You mendapatkan keahlian dalam the Insight, Performance, or Persuasion skill (your choice).

features.name: Emboldening Bond
features.summary: Forge a magical bond between allies, adding 1d4 to one attack, check, or saving throw each turn.
features.description: You can forge an empowering bond between allies. As aksi, you choose a number of willing creatures within 30 feet of you (which can include yourself) equal to bonus keahlianmu. For 10 minutes, while any bonded creature is within 30 feet of another, the creature can roll a 1d4 and add the number rolled to an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw it makes once per turn. You can use this feature a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu per long rest.

features.name: Peace Domain Spells
features.summary: Gain domain sihir at levels 1, 3, 5, 7, and 9.
features.description: You mendapatkan domain sihir at the cleric levels listed in the Peace Domain Spells table: 1st: Heroism, Sanctuary; 3rd: Aid, Warding Bond; 5th: Beacon of Hope, Sending; 7th: Aura of Purity, Otiluke's Resilient Sphere; 9th: Greater Restoration, Rary's Telepathic Bond.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Balm of Peace
features.summary: Move hingga kecepatanmu without provoking opportunity attacks and menyembuhkan passed creatures 2d6 + Wis.
features.description: As aksi, kamu dapat menggunakan your Channel Divinity to move hingga kecepatan berjalanmu, without provoking opportunity attacks. When you move within 5 feet of any other creature during this action, kamu dapat memulihkan 2d6 + your Wisdom modifier poin kesehatan to that creature. A creature can receive this penyembuhan only once setiap kali kamu take this action.

features.name: Protective Bond
features.summary: Bonded creatures within 30 feet can teleport to take kerusakan in place of one another.
features.description: The bond you forge between people helps them protect each other. When makhluk affected by your Emboldening Bond feature is about to take kerusakan, a second bonded creature within 30 feet of the first can use its reaction to teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the first creature. The second creature then takes all the kerusakan instead.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.summary: Add your Wisdom modifier to the kerusakan you deal with any cleric cantrip.
features.description: Starting at 8th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to the kerusakan you deal with any cleric cantrip.

features.name: Expansive Bond
features.summary: Protective Bond range increases to 60 feet, and the teleporting creature mendapatkan resistance to the kerusakan.
features.description: The benefits of your Emboldening Bond and Protective Bond features now apply when the creatures are within 60 feet of each other. Moreover, when makhluk uses Protective Bond to take someone else's kerusakan, that creature mendapatkan resistance to that kerusakan.

subclasses.name: Tempest
subclasses.description:
The Tempest domain represents the power of storms and the sea. Its clerics are fierce warriors who call upon the fury of thunder and lightning to smite their enemies and protect the innocent.

Gods of the Tempest domain—including Talos, Umberlee, and Zeus—embrace the destructive power of nature and teach that only through conflict and struggle can strength be didapatkan. They are often patrons of sailors and those who make their living on the sea.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: When you join the College of Lore at 3rd level, kamu mendapatkan keahlian dengan three skills of your choice.
features.summary: Gain keahlian with three skills of your choice.

features.name: Wrath of the Storm
features.description: Also at 1st level, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to deal lightning kerusakan to makhluk dalam 5 feet of you that kamu bisa melihat. When makhluk dalam 5 feet of you that kamu bisa melihat hits you with an attack, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to deal 2d8 lightning kerusakan to the attacker. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Also at 1st level, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to deal lightning kerusakan to makhluk dalam 5 feet of you that kamu bisa melihat. (reaction).

features.name: Channel Divinity: Destructive Wrath
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, kamu dapat menggunakan your Channel Divinity to maximize the kerusakan of your lightning or thunder sihir.
features.summary: Starting at 2nd level, kamu dapat menggunakan your Channel Divinity to maximize the kerusakan of your lightning or thunder sihir. (action).

features.name: Thunderbolt Strike
features.description: Starting at 6th level, ketika kamu deal lightning kerusakan to makhluk, kamu dapat push it hingga 10 feet away.
features.summary: Starting at 6th level, ketika kamu deal lightning kerusakan to makhluk, kamu dapat push it hingga 10 feet away.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.description: Starting at 8th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to the kerusakan rolls of your cleric sihir.
features.summary: Starting at 8th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to the kerusakan rolls of your cleric sihir. (action).

features.name: Stormborn
features.description: Starting at 17th level, kamu mendapatkan resistance to lightning and thunder kerusakan. Additionally, setiap kali kamu cast sihir of 1st level or higher that deals lightning or thunder kerusakan, kamu dapat fly hingga 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.
features.summary: Additionally, setiap kali kamu cast sihir of 1st level or higher that deals lightning or thunder kerusakan, kamu dapat fly hingga 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

subclasses.name: Trickery
subclasses.description:
The Trickery domain represents the power of deception and illusion. Its clerics are cunning and resourceful, using their divine gifts to confuse and misdirect their enemies.

Gods of trickery—including Olidammara, the Traveler, and Loki—are patrons of thieves, scoundrels, and tricksters. They teach that one must be clever to survive in a world full of dangers and that sometimes the best way to defeat an enemy is through cunning rather than force.

features.name: Blessing of the Trickster
features.description: At 1st level, kamu dapat menggunakan aksimu to touch a willing creature to give it keuntungan on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
features.summary: At 1st level, kamu dapat menggunakan aksimu to touch a willing creature to give it keuntungan on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. (action).

features.name: Channel Divinity: Invoke Duplicity
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, kamu dapat menggunakan your Channel Divinity to create an illusory duplicate of yourself. As aksi, you create a perfect illusion of yourself that lasts for 1 minute, or until you lose konsentrasi (as jika kamu were concentrating on sihir). You can use aksimu to move the illusion hingga 30 feet to a space kamu bisa melihat. The illusion is intangible and can't attack or take kerusakan.
features.summary: Can use aksimu to move the illusion hingga 30 feet to a space kamu bisa melihat. (action).

features.name: Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows
features.description: At 6th level, kamu dapat menggunakan your Channel Divinity to become invisible. As aksi, you become invisible until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya, or until you attack or force makhluk to make a saving throw.
features.summary: Become invisible until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya, or until you attack or force makhluk to make a saving throw. (action).

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.description: Starting at 8th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to the kerusakan rolls of your cleric sihir.
features.summary: Starting at 8th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to the kerusakan rolls of your cleric sihir. (action).

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: At 8th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to infuse senjatamu strikes with divine energy. Once on each of your turns ketika kamu hit makhluk with a weapon attack, kamu dapat cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 radiant kerusakan to the target. When you reach 14th level, the extra kerusakan increases to 2d8.
features.summary: Once on each of your turns ketika kamu hit makhluk with a weapon attack, kamu dapat cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 radiant kerusakan.

features.name: Improved Duplicity
features.description: At 17th level, kamu dapat create hingga four illusory duplicates of yourself instead of one. You can use aksimu to move any number of them hingga 30 feet, to spaces kamu bisa melihat.
features.summary: Can use aksimu to move any number of them hingga 30 feet, to spaces kamu bisa melihat. (action).

subclasses.name: Twilight Domain
subclasses.description: The twilight domain focuses on the transition between daylight and the dark of night, offering comfort and safety to those who must journey through darkness and rest in the shadows.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.summary: Gain keahlian with martial weapons and heavy armor.
features.description: You mendapatkan keahlian with martial weapons and heavy armor.

features.name: Eyes of Night
features.summary: Gain 300 feet of darkvision, and share it with willing creatures for 1 hour.
features.description: You can see through the deepest gloom. You have darkvision out to a range of 300 feet. In addition, as aksi, kamu dapat magically share your darkvision with willing creatures kamu bisa melihat within 10 feet of you, hingga a number equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one). The shared darkvision lasts for 1 hour, once per long rest, or by expending slot sihir of any level.

features.name: Vigilant Blessing
features.summary: Grant keuntungan on the next initiative roll to yourself or a touched creature.
features.description: The night has taught you to be watchful. As aksi, you give satu makhluk you touch (including possibly yourself) keuntungan on the next initiative roll the creature makes. This benefit ends immediately after the roll or jika kamu use this feature again.

features.name: Twilight Domain Spells
features.summary: Gain domain sihir at levels 1, 3, 5, 7, and 9.
features.description: You mendapatkan domain sihir at the cleric levels listed in the Twilight Domain Spells table: 1st: Faerie Fire, Sleep; 3rd: Moonbeam, See Invisibility; 5th: Aura of Vitality, Tiny Hut; 7th: Aura of Life, Greater Invisibility; 9th: Circle of Power, Mislead.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Twilight Sanctuary
features.summary: Create a 30-foot sphere of twilight granting 1d6 + cleric level temp HP or ending charm/fear.
features.description: As aksi, you present your holy symbol and utter a twilight prayer. A sphere of twilight emanates from you in a 30-foot radius. The sphere moves with you, is filled with dim light, and lasts for 1 minute or until kamu adalah incapacitated. Whenever makhluk (including you) ends its turn in the sphere, kamu dapat grant that creature 1d6 + your cleric level poin kesehatan sementara, or end one effect on it causing it to be charmed or frightened.

features.name: Steps of Night
features.summary: Fly with flying speed equal to kecepatan berjalanmu for 1 minute in dim light or darkness.
features.description: You draw on the mystical power of twilight to fly through the dark. As aksi bonus ketika kamu are in dim light or darkness, kamu dapat magically give yourself a flying speed equal to kecepatan berjalanmu for 1 minute. You can use this bonus action a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu, regaining all uses on istirahat panjang.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.summary: Once on each of your turns, deal an extra 1d8 radiant kerusakan on a weapon hit (2d8 at 14th).
features.description: At 8th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to infuse senjatamu strikes with divine energy. Once on each of your turns ketika kamu hit makhluk with a weapon attack, kamu dapat cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 radiant kerusakan to the target. When you reach 14th level, the extra kerusakan increases to 2d8.

features.name: Twilight Shroud
features.summary: Allies inside your Twilight Sanctuary mendapatkan the benefits of half cover (+2 AC and Dex saves).
features.description: The twilight that you summon offers a protective embrace: you and your allies have half cover while in the sphere created by your Twilight Sanctuary feature.

subclasses.name: War
subclasses.description:
The War domain represents the power of battle and conflict. Its clerics are divine warriors who inspire their allies and strike down their foes with righteous fury.

Gods of war—including Tempus, Nike, and Tyr—embrace the glory of combat and teach that conflict can be a noble pursuit when waged for a just cause. They inspire their followers to fight with honor and courage in the face of overwhelming odds.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: When you join the College of Lore at 3rd level, kamu mendapatkan keahlian dengan three skills of your choice.
features.summary: Gain keahlian with three skills of your choice.

features.name: War Priest
features.description: Also at 1st level, kamu dapat membuat aksi bonus attack ketika kamu use the Attack action. When you take the Attack action on giliranmu, kamu dapat membuat one weapon attack as aksi bonus. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Regain all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang. (bonus action).

features.name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, kamu dapat menggunakan your Channel Divinity to add +10 to an attack roll.
features.summary: Starting at 2nd level, kamu dapat menggunakan your Channel Divinity to add +10 to an attack roll. (action).

features.name: Channel Divinity: War God's Blessing
features.description: At 6th level, kamu dapat menggunakan your Channel Divinity to grant resistance to an ally. When makhluk yang kamu lihat dalam 30 feet of you makes an attack roll, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to grant that creature a +10 bonus to its attack roll.
features.summary: Can use reaksimu to grant that creature a +10 bonus to its attack roll. (reaction).

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.description: Starting at 8th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to the kerusakan rolls of your cleric sihir.
features.summary: Starting at 8th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to the kerusakan rolls of your cleric sihir. (action).

features.name: Avatar of Battle
features.description: At 17th level, kamu mendapatkan resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing kerusakan from nonmagical weapons.
features.summary: At 17th level, kamu mendapatkan resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing kerusakan from nonmagical weapons.

subclasses.name: Circle of Dreams
subclasses.description: Druids who are members of the Circle of Dreams hail from regions that have strong ties to the Feywild and its dreamlike realms. The druids' guardianship of the natural world makes them natural allies of the fey.

features.name: Balm of the Summer Court
features.description: At 2nd level, you become imbued with the blessings of the Summer Court. You mendapatkan a pool of fey energy represented by a number of d6s equal to your druid level. As aksi bonus, kamu dapat memilih satu makhluk yang kamu lihat within 120 feet of you and spend a number of those dice equal to half your druid level or less. Roll the spent dice and add them together. The target memulihkan kembali a number of poin kesehatan equal to the total. The target also mendapatkan 1 temporary poin kesehatan per die spent. You memulihkan kembali all expended dice ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Can choose satu makhluk yang kamu lihat within 120 feet of you and spend a number of those dice equal to half your druid level or less. (bonus action).

features.name: Hearth of Moonlight and Shadow
features.description: At 6th level, the magic of the Feywild guards your rest. When you or makhluk yang kamu lihat dalam 30 feet of you makes a saving throw or an attack roll, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to grant keuntungan to the roll. You can use this feature a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu, and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Can use reaksimu to grant keuntungan to the roll. (reaction).

features.name: Hidden Paths
features.description: Starting at 10th level, kamu dapat menggunakan the hidden paths that some fey use to traverse space in a blink of an eye. As aksi bonus, kamu dapat teleport hingga 60 feet to an unoccupied space kamu bisa melihat. Alternatively, kamu dapat menggunakan aksimu to teleport one willing creature you touch hingga 30 feet to an unoccupied space kamu bisa melihat. You can use this feature a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu, and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Can teleport hingga 60 feet to an unoccupied space kamu bisa melihat. (bonus action).

features.name: Walker in Dreams
features.description: At 14th level, the magic of the Feywild grants you the ability to travel mentally or physically through dreamlands. When you menyelesaikan istirahat singkat, kamu dapat menyalurkan the dream sihir once without expending slot sihir. In addition, kamu dapat menyalurkan the following sihir without expending slot sihir or material components: scrying (self only), teleportation circle. You can cast each of these sihir once, and kamu memulihkan kembali the ability to cast them this way ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Can cast each of these sihir once, and kamu memulihkan kembali the ability to cast them this way ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang. (action).

subclasses.name: Circle of Spores
subclasses.description: Druids of the Circle of Spores find beauty in decay. They see within mold, fungi, and spores the ability to transform lifeless matter into abundant, albeit strange, life.

features.name: Circle Spells
features.summary: Learn Chill Touch and mendapatkan circle sihir at levels 3, 5, 7, and 9.
features.description: You mendapatkan the Chill Touch cantrip. At 3rd level, Blindness/Deafness, Gentle Repose; 5th: Animate Dead, Gaseous Form; 7th: Blight, Confusion; 9th: Cloudkill, Contagion.

features.name: Halo of Spores
features.summary: Reaction deal 1d4 necrotic kerusakan to makhluk starting its turn or moving within 10 feet (scales to 1d8).
features.description: You are surrounded by invisible, necrotic spores. When makhluk yang kamu lihat starts its turn within 10 feet of you or moves there, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to deal 1d4 necrotic kerusakan to that creature unless it succeeds on a Constitution saving throw. The kerusakan increases to 1d6 at 6th, 1d8 at 10th, and 1d10 at 14th level.

features.name: Symbiotic Entity
features.summary: Expending Wild Shape grants 4 temp HP per druid level, doubles Halo of Spores kerusakan, and adds 1d6 necrotic to melee hits.
features.description: As aksi, kamu dapat menghabiskan a use of your Wild Shape feature to awaken your spores. You mendapatkan 4 poin kesehatan sementara for each level kamu memiliki in this class. While this feature is active, you roll your Halo of Spores kerusakan die a second time, and your melee weapon attacks deal an extra 1d6 necrotic kerusakan on a hit.

features.name: Fungal Infestation
features.summary: Animate a Small or Medium beast or humanoid that dies within 30 feet as a temporary zombie.
features.description: Your spores mendapatkan the ability to infest a corpse and animate it. When a beast or a humanoid that is Small or Medium dies within 30 feet of you, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to animate that creature with 1 poin kesehatan as a zombie under your command for 1 hour.

features.name: Spreading Spores
features.summary: Throw a 10-foot cube of spores hingga 30 feet that damages creatures inside with Halo of Spores.
features.description: As aksi bonus while your Symbiotic Entity feature is active, kamu dapat hurl spores hingga 30 feet away, where they swirl in a 10-foot cube for 1 minute. Any creature that moves into the cube or starts its turn there takes your Halo of Spores kerusakan.

features.name: Fungal Body
features.summary: Gain immunity to being blinded, deafened, frightened, or poisoned, and critical hits against you become normal hits.
features.description: The fungal spores in your body alter you: kamu tidak bisa blinded, deafened, frightened, or poisoned, and any critical hit against you counts as a normal hit instead, unless you're incapacitated.

subclasses.name: Circle of Stars
subclasses.description: The Circle of Stars allows druids to draw on the power of starlight. These druids track constellations and map secret connections throughout the cosmos to unleash starry manifestations.

features.name: Star Map
features.summary: Create a star map focus, learn Guidance cantrip, and cast Guiding Bolt for free PB times per day.
features.description: You've created a star chart as part of your heavenly studies. You learn the Guidance cantrip. You also have the Guiding Bolt sihir prepared, which counts as a druid sihir for you and can be cast without expending slot sihir a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu per long rest.

features.name: Starry Form
features.summary: Expending Wild Shape transforms you into a glimmering Starry Form: Archer, Chalice, or Dragon.
features.description: As aksi bonus, kamu dapat menghabiskan a use of your Wild Shape feature to take on a starry form for 10 minutes: Archer (bonus action ranged sihir attack dealing 1d8 + Wis radiant kerusakan), Chalice (penyembuhan makhluk menyembuhkan another creature for 1d8 + Wis), or Dragon (treat any roll of 9 or lower on the d20 as a 10 for Concentration saves and Intelligence/Wisdom checks).

features.name: Cosmic Omen
features.summary: Consult the stars after a rest to roll d6: add 1d6 to an ally's roll (Weal) or subtract 1d6 from an enemy's roll (Woe).
features.description: Whenever you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang, kamu dapat consult your Star Map for omens. Roll a d6: even is Weal (reaction add 1d6 to an ally's attack, save, or check within 30 ft), odd is Woe (reaction subtract 1d6 from a target's attack, save, or check within 30 ft). You can use this reaction a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu.

features.name: Twinkling Constellations
features.summary: The constellations of your Starry Form improve to 2d8, and kamu dapat switch forms each turn.
features.description: The constellations of your Starry Form become more potent: Archer and Chalice rolls increase to 2d8 radiant / penyembuhan, and Dragon form gives you a flying speed of 20 feet and hover. In addition, at the start of each of your turns while in Starry Form, kamu dapat switch which constellation is active.

features.name: Full of Stars
features.summary: While in Starry Form, you become partially incorporeal with resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing kerusakan.
features.description: While in your Starry Form, you become partially incorporeal, giving you resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing kerusakan.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Sea
subclasses.description: The Circle of the Sea is a druid circle that draws power from the ocean and its depths. These druids are at home in the water, and they command the tides and the creatures within them.

features.name: Oceanic Resilience
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, kamu dapat breathe air and water, and kamu memiliki a swimming speed equal to kecepatan berjalanmu.
features.summary: Starting at 2nd level, kamu dapat breathe air and water, and kamu memiliki a swimming speed equal to kecepatan berjalanmu. (permanent).

features.name: Wrath of the Sea
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, kamu dapat menggunakan aksimu to magically summon a watery spray that lashes out at nearby creatures. Each creature within 30 feet of you that kamu bisa melihat must make a Dexterity saving throw against your druid sihir save DC. On a failed save, makhluk takes 2d6 bludgeoning kerusakan and is pushed 10 feet away from you. On a successful save, makhluk takes half as much kerusakan and isn't pushed.
features.summary: On a failed save, makhluk takes 2d6 bludgeoning kerusakan and is pushed 10 feet away from you. (instant, action).

features.name: Elemental Wild Shape
features.description: At 6th level, kamu dapat menghabiskan two uses of Wild Shape instead of one to transform into a water elemental or a steamweird.
features.summary: At 6th level, kamu dapat menghabiskan two uses of Wild Shape instead of one to transform into a water elemental or a steamweird. (action).

features.name: Aquatic Master
features.description: Starting at 10th level, kamu memiliki keuntungan pada serangan melawan creatures that are underwater, and creatures have kerugian on attack rolls against you while kamu adalah underwater.
features.summary: Starting at 10th level, kamu memiliki keuntungan pada serangan melawan creatures that are underwater, and creatures have kerugian on attack rolls against you while kamu adalah underwater. (permanent).

features.name: Oceanic Guardian
features.description: Starting at 14th level, kamu dapat menyalurkan control water once per long rest without expending slot sihir. Additionally, kamu dapat breathe underwater indefinitely, and kamu memiliki ketahanan terhadap cold kerusakan.
features.summary: Additionally, kamu dapat breathe underwater indefinitely, and kamu memiliki ketahanan terhadap cold kerusakan. (action).

subclasses.name: Circle of the Shepherd
subclasses.description: Druids of the Circle of the Shepherd commune with the spirits of nature, especially the spirits of beasts and the fey, and call to them for aid. These druids recognize that all living things play a role in the natural world.

features.name: Speech of the Woods
features.description: At 2nd level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to converse with beasts and fey. You learn to speak, read, and write Sylvan. In addition, beasts can understand your speech, and kamu mendapatkan the ability to decipher their noises and motions. Most beasts lack the capacity for language, but a beast that knows a language can understand you.
features.summary: At 2nd level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to converse with beasts and fey.

features.name: Spirit Totem
features.description:
Starting at 2nd level, kamu dapat call forth nature spirits to aid you and your allies. As aksi bonus, kamu dapat menggunakan your Wild Shape to magically summon a nature spirit to a point kamu bisa melihat within 60 feet of you. The spirit is a spectral form of a bear, hawk, or unicorn, and it creates an aura in a 30-foot radius around it. The spirit is intangible and doesn't take up space. When you summon the spirit, choose which aura it creates:

Bear: The bear spirit grants you and your allies keuntungan on Strength checks and Strength saving throws, and you and your allies mendapatkan poin kesehatan sementara equal to your druid level.

Hawk: The hawk spirit grants you and your allies keuntungan on attack rolls against any creature in the aura, and you and your allies can use reaksi to make an opportunity attack against makhluk that moves out of the aura.

Unicorn: The unicorn spirit grants you and your allies keuntungan on ability checks made to detect anything in the aura, and ketika kamu cast a penyembuhan sihir with slot sihir, you and your allies memulihkan kembali poin kesehatan equal to your druid level.

The spirit remains for 1 minute, until you use this feature again, or until you die.
features.summary: Can use your Wild Shape to magically summon a nature spirit to a point kamu bisa melihat within 60 feet of you. (bonus action).

features.name: Mighty Summoner
features.description: Starting at 6th level, beasts and fey that you conjure are more resilient than normal. Any beast or fey that you summon or create with sihir mendapatkan the following benefits: The creature appears with more poin kesehatan than normal: 2 extra poin kesehatan per Hit Die it has. The weapon attacks of the creature count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and kerusakan.
features.summary: The weapon attacks of the creature count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and kerusakan.

features.name: Guardian Spirit
features.description: Beginning at 10th level, when a beast or fey that you summoned or created with sihir ends its turn in your Spirit Totem aura, it memulihkan kembali a number of poin kesehatan equal to half your druid level.
features.summary: When a beast or fey that you summoned or created with sihir ends its turn in your Spirit Totem aura, it memulihkan kembali a number of hit.

features.name: Faithful Summons
features.description: Starting at 14th level, the nature spirits you commune with protect you ketika kamu are the most vulnerable. When kamu adalah reduced to 0 poin kesehatan or are incapacitated against your will, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to conjure a nature spirit. The spirit appears within 60 feet of you and uses the spirit bear stat block, and it mendapatkan 40 poin kesehatan sementara. The spirit acts on its own initiative count. On each of its turns, it can take only the Attack (one weapon attack only), Dash, Disengage, Dodge, or Help action. On giliranmu, kamu dapat menggunakan aksi bonus to command the spirit, provided kamu adalah conscious. The spirit vanishes after 1 hour, when it is reduced to 0 poin kesehatan, ketika kamu use this feature again, or ketika kamu die.
features.summary: The spirit appears within 60 feet of you and uses the spirit bear stat block, and it mendapatkan 40 poin kesehatan sementara. (bonus action).

subclasses.name: Circle of Wildfire
subclasses.description: Druids in the Circle of Wildfire understand that destruction is sometimes the precursor to creation, just as a forest fire promotes new growth.

features.name: Circle of Wildfire Spells
features.summary: Gain wildfire sihir at levels 2, 3, 5, 7, and 9.
features.description: 2nd: Burning Hands, Cure Wounds; 3rd: Flaming Sphere, Scorching Ray; 5th: Plant Growth, Revivify; 7th: Aura of Life, Fire Shield; 9th: Flame Strike, Mass Cure Wounds.

features.name: Summon Wildfire Spirit
features.summary: Expending a Wild Shape summons a friendly Wildfire Spirit that burns foes and obeys your commands.
features.description: You can summon the primal spirit bound to your soul. As aksi, kamu dapat menghabiskan one use of your Wild Shape feature to summon your wildfire spirit within 30 feet. Each creature within 10 feet must succeed on a Dex save or take 2d6 fire kerusakan. The spirit takes its turn immediately after yours, attacks with Flame Seed, and can teleport itself and willing allies with Fiery Teleportation.

features.name: Enhanced Bond
features.summary: Add 1d8 to rolls of sihir that deal fire kerusakan or memulihkan poin kesehatan when your spirit is present.
features.description: The bond with your wildfire spirit enhances your destructive and restorative sihir. Whenever you cast sihir that deals fire kerusakan or memulihkan poin kesehatan while your wildfire spirit is summoned, roll a 1d8 and add the number rolled to one kerusakan or penyembuhan roll of sihir itu.

features.name: Cauterizing Flames
features.summary: Drop spectral flames when makhluk dies within 30 feet to menyembuhkan or kerusakan makhluk 2d10 + Wis.
features.description: You mendapatkan the ability to turn death into magical flames that can menyembuhkan or incinerate. When a Small or larger creature dies within 30 feet of you or your wildfire spirit, a harmless spectral flame springs up in its space. When makhluk touches it, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to either memulihkan 2d10 + Wis HP to it or deal 2d10 + Wis fire kerusakan.

features.name: Blazing Revival
features.summary: When reduced to 0 HP, sacrifice your wildfire spirit to drop to 1 HP and memulihkan kembali half your max HP.
features.description: If kamu adalah reduced to 0 poin kesehatan and your wildfire spirit is within 120 feet of you, kamu dapat sacrifice the spirit to cause you to drop to 1 poin kesehatan instead of 0, and setiap makhluk within 10 feet of the sacrificed spirit takes fire kerusakan equal to 2d10 + your Wisdom modifier.

subclasses.name: Land
subclasses.description: The Circle of the Land is made up of mystics and sages who safeguard ancient knowledge and rites through a vast oral tradition. These druids meet within sacred circles of trees or standing stones to whisper primal secrets in Druidic. The circle's wisest members preside as the chief priests of communities that hold to the Old Faith and serve as advisors to the rulers of those folk. As a member of this circle, your magic is influenced by the land where you were initiated into the circle's mysterious rites.

features.name: Bonus Cantrip
features.description: When you choose this circle at 2nd level, you learn one additional druid cantrip of your choice.

choices.name: cantrip
choices.description: Choose one additional druid cantrip

features.summary: Learn one additional druid cantrip of your choice. (action).

features.name: Natural Recovery
features.description:
Starting at 2nd level, kamu dapat memulihkan kembali some of your magical energy by sitting in meditation and communing with nature. During istirahat singkat, you choose expended slot sihir to recover. The slot sihir can have a combined level that is equal to or less than half your druid level (rounded up), and none of the slots can be 6th level or higher. You can't use this feature again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
For example, ketika kamu are a 4th-level druid, kamu dapat recover hingga two levels worth of slot sihir. You can recover either a 2nd-level slot or two 1st-level slots.
features.summary: Starting at 2nd level, kamu dapat memulihkan kembali some of your magical energy by sitting in meditation and communing with nature. (action).

features.name: Circle Spells
features.description:
Your mystical connection to the land infuses you with the ability to cast certain sihir. At 3rd, 5th, 7th, and 9th level kamu mendapatkan access to circle sihir connected to the land where you became a druid.
Choose that land--arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, or swamp--and consult the associated list of sihir.
Once kamu mendapatkan access to a circle sihir, you always have it prepared, and it doesn't count against the number of sihir kamu dapat prepare each day. If kamu mendapatkan access to sihir that doesn't appear on the druid sihir list, sihir itu is nonetheless a druid sihir for you.

choices.name: terrain
choices.description: Choose your terrain type (arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, swamp, underdark)

features.summary: At 3rd, 5th, 7th, and 9th level kamu mendapatkan access to circle sihir connected to the land where you became a druid. (action).

features.name: Land's Stride
features.description:
Starting at 6th level, moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs you no extra movement. You can also pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking kerusakan from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.
In addition, kamu memiliki keuntungan pada saving throw melawan plants that are magically created or manipulated to impede movement, such those created by the entangle sihir.
features.summary: In addition, kamu memiliki keuntungan pada saving throw melawan plants that are magically created or manipulated to impede movement, such those created by the entangle sihir.

features.name: Nature's Ward
features.description: When you reach 10th level, kamu tidak bisa charmed or frightened by elementals or fey, and kamu kebal terhadap poison and disease.
features.summary: Can't be charmed or frightened by elementals or fey, and kamu kebal terhadap poison and disease.

features.name: Nature's Sanctuary
features.description: When you reach 14th level, creatures of the natural world sense your connection to nature and become hesitant to attack you. When a beast or plant creature attacks you, that creature must make a Wisdom saving throw against your druid sihir save DC. On a failed save, the creature must choose a different target, or the attack automatically misses. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this effect for 24 hours. The creature is aware of this effect before it makes its attack against you.
features.summary: That creature must make a Wisdom saving throw against your druid sihir save DC. (action).

subclasses.name: Moon
subclasses.description:
Druids of the Circle of the Moon are fierce guardians of the natural order. They undergo special rituals that allow them to take on more powerful beast forms, transforming into creatures of great strength and ferocity.

These druids meet in secret places to share information and pass along warnings. They are masters of the wild, able to call upon the most powerful beasts to aid them in their sacred duty to protect nature from those who would do it harm.

subclasses.name: Arcane Archer
subclasses.description: An Arcane Archer studies a unique elven method of archery that weaves magic into attacks to produce supernatural effects. Arcane Archers are some of the most elite warriors on the multiverse, serving as special forces for armies or as scouts for adventuring parties.

features.name: Arcane Archer Lore
features.description: At 3rd level, you learn magical theory or some of the secrets of nature—typically related to the force of archery and the importance of focus. You learn either the prestidigitation or the druidcraft cantrip of your choice.
features.summary: At 3rd level, you learn magical theory or some of the secrets of nature—typically related to the force of archery and the importance of focus.

features.name: Arcane Shot
features.description: At 3rd level, you learn to unleash special magical effects with some of your shots. When kamu mendapatkan this feature, you learn two Arcane Shot options of your choice. Once per turn ketika kamu fire a shortbow or longbow as part of the Attack action, kamu dapat menerapkan one of your Arcane Shot options to the arrow. You decide to use the option after seeing the roll, but before the DM determines whether the attack hits or misses. You have two uses of this feature, and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses of it ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat singkat atau panjang.
features.summary: Learn two Arcane Shot options of your choice. (action).

features.name: Arcane Shot Options
features.description:
The following options are available to you ketika kamu use your Arcane Shot feature:

Banishing Arrow: You banish the target you hit to a harmless demiplane until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya. The target disappears, incapacitated. When the effect ends, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space.

Beguiling Arrow: Your charm inflicts psychic kerusakan and causes the target to be charmed by you.

Bursting Arrow: The arrow creates a burst of energy that damages the target and hingga two other creatures within 10 feet of it.

Enfeebling Arrow: The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target deals only half kerusakan with weapon attacks until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya.

Grasping Arrow: Vines burst from the arrow, grasping the target and hingga two other creatures within 10 feet of it.

Mind-Scrambling Arrow: The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target can't take reactions until the start of giliranmu selanjutnya and must roll a d6 to determine its behavior.

Piercing Arrow: You make a ranged attack with the arrow as a normal ranged attack. The arrow passes through the target to another creature.

Seeking Arrow: You mendapatkan magical insight on the location of the target. You make a ranged attack with the arrow as a normal ranged attack. If the attack misses, kamu dapat menggunakan aksi bonus to make a new attack against the same target.

Shadow Arrow: You weave illusion magic into your arrow, causing the target to be blinded until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya.

subclasses.name: Battle Master
subclasses.description:
The Battle Master is a supreme warrior who uses a variety of maneuvers to control the battlefield. Drawing on extensive combat experience and tactical knowledge, the Battle Master can turn the tide of battle with well-timed strikes and clever stratagems. Those who emulate this martial archetype combine rigorous training with physical excellence to deal devastating blows.

Battle Masters study the art of war, learning to read their opponents and exploit their weaknesses with precision and cunning. They use superiority dice to fuel powerful maneuvers that can disarm, trip, or push their enemies, turning the tide of battle in their favor.

features.name: Combat Superiority
features.description: You learn maneuvers fueled by superiority dice (d8s). You mendapatkan 4 superiority dice at level 3, regaining them on istirahat singkat atau panjang. You learn 3 maneuvers at level 3, and additional maneuvers at higher levels.

options.name: Distracting Strike
options.description: Add superiority die to kerusakan — next attack against target before giliranmu selanjutnya has keuntungan

options.name: Evasive Footwork
options.description: Add superiority die to AC until end of your move

options.name: Feinting Attack

options.name: Goading Attack
options.description: Add superiority die to kerusakan — target makes WIS save or has kerugian attacking anyone but you

options.name: Lunging Attack
options.description: Increase melee attack reach by 5ft and add superiority die to kerusakan

options.name: Maneuvering Attack
options.description: Add superiority die to kerusakan — ally can move half speed without provoking opportunity attacks

options.name: Menacing Attack

options.name: Parry

options.name: Precision Attack

options.name: Pushing Attack

options.name: Rally

options.description: Use reaction when makhluk misses you — make one melee attack and add superiority die to kerusakan

options.name: Sweeping Attack
options.description: Deal superiority die kerusakan to a second creature adjacent to the first target

options.name: Trip Attack
options.description: Add superiority die to kerusakan — target makes STR save or is knocked prone if Large or smaller

This effect ends early if kamu adalah incapacitated or die, or if someone else marks the target. While it is within 5 feet of you, a marked creature has kerugian on any attack roll that doesn't target you. In addition, if a marked creature deals kerusakan to anyone other than you, kamu dapat membuat a special melee attack against the marked creature as aksi bonus on giliranmu selanjutnya. You have keuntungan on the attack roll, and if it hits, senjatamu deals extra kerusakan equal to half your fighter level. Regardless of whether you use this bonus action, kamu dapat menggunakan it a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu, and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.

features.summary: Beginning ketika kamu choose this archetype at 3rd level, senjatamu attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20. (action).

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
features.description: Starting at 7th level, kamu dapat menambahkan half bonus keahlianmu (round up) to any Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check you make that doesn't already use bonus keahlianmu. In addition, ketika kamu make a running long jump, the distance kamu dapat cover increases by a number of feet equal to your Strength modifier.
features.summary: Starting at 7th level, kamu dapat menambahkan half bonus keahlianmu (round up) to any Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check you make that doesn't already use bonus keahlianmu. (action).

features.name: Additional Fighting Style
features.description: At 10th level, kamu dapat memilih a second option from the Fighting Style class feature.
features.summary: At 10th level, kamu dapat memilih a second option from the Fighting Style class feature. (action).

features.name: Superior Critical
features.description: Starting at 15th level, senjatamu attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20.
features.summary: Starting at 15th level, senjatamu attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20. (action).

features.name: Survivor
features.description: At 18th level, you attain the pinnacle of resilience in battle. At the start of each of your turns, kamu memulihkan kembali poin kesehatan equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier if kamu memiliki no more than half of poin kesehatanmu left. You don't mendapatkan this benefit if kamu memiliki 0 poin kesehatan.
features.summary: At the start of each of your turns, kamu memulihkan kembali poin kesehatan equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier if kamu memiliki no more than half of poin kesehatanmu.

subclasses.name: Echo Knight
subclasses.description: A mysterious warrior who can summon an echo of themselves from unspent potential, the Echo Knight uses their own shadow as a weapon. These fighters are rare and often misunderstood, for they walk the line between what is and what could be.

features.name: Manifest Echo
features.description: You can use aksi bonus to magically manifest a translucent, gray image of yourself in an unoccupied space kamu bisa melihat within 15 feet of you. This echo lasts until it is destroyed, you dismiss it, you manifest another echo, or you're incapacitated. Your echo has AC 14 + bonus keahlianmu, 1 poin kesehatan, and immunity to all conditions. If it has to make a saving throw, use your save bonus. It is the same size as you, and it occupies its space. On giliranmu, kamu dapat mentally command the echo to move hingga 30 feet in any direction (no action required). You can use it as the origin for your attacks and kamu dapat membuat opportunity attacks as jika kamu were in its space.
features.summary: Can use aksi bonus to magically manifest a translucent, gray image of yourself in an unoccupied space kamu bisa melihat within 15 feet of you. (bonus action).

features.name: Unleash Incarnation
features.description: When you take the Attack action on giliranmu, kamu dapat membuat one additional melee attack from the echo's space. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of once). You memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Regain all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang. (action).

features.name: Echo Avatar
features.description: As aksi bonus, kamu dapat teleport, magically swapping places with your echo at a cost of 15 feet of gerakanmu, regardless of the distance between the two of you. Immediately before you teleport, kamu bisa melihat through its eyes and hear through its ears until the start of giliranmu selanjutnya, gaining the benefits of any special senses that the echo has. During this time, kamu adalah deaf and blind with regard to your own senses.
features.summary: Can teleport, magically swapping places with your echo at a cost of 15 feet of gerakanmu, regardless of the distance between the two of you. (bonus action).

features.name: Shadow Martyr
features.description: When you take kerusakan from makhluk that is within 5 feet of your echo, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to teleport, causing the echo to teleport to the space you were in and become the target of the attack instead. You can use this feature a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu, and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Can use reaksimu to teleport, causing the echo to teleport to the space you were in and become the target of the attack instead. (reaction).

features.name: Reclaim Potential
features.description: When your echo is destroyed by taking kerusakan, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to mendapatkan a number of poin kesehatan sementara equal to 2d6 + your Constitution modifier. If you end giliranmu with these poin kesehatan sementara, you lose them. You can use this feature a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu, and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Can use reaksimu to mendapatkan a number of poin kesehatan sementara equal to 2d6 + your Constitution modifier. (reaction).

features.name: Legion of One
features.description: When you use Manifest Echo, kamu dapat create two echoes with it, and these echoes can coexist. When you take the Attack action on giliranmu, kamu dapat membuat one additional melee attack from the space of each echo. Moreover, ketika kamu use Unleash Incarnation, kamu dapat membuat the additional attack from either echo's space.
features.summary: Can create two echoes with it, and these echoes can coexist. (action).

subclasses.name: Eldritch Knight
subclasses.description:
The Eldritch Knight combines the martial prowess of a fighter with the arcane power of a wizard. Through years of study and practice, these warriors learn to cast sihir while wearing armor and wielding heavy weapons.

Eldritch Knights are versatile combatants, able to adapt to any situation by combining sword and sorcery. They are often found on the front lines, using their magical abilities to protect their allies and smite their enemies.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: When you reach 3rd level, you augment your martial prowess with the ability to cast sihir. Cantrips. You learn two cantrip of your choice from the wizard sihir list. You learn an additional wizard cantrip of your choice at 10th level. Spell Slots. The Eldritch Knight Spellcasting table shows how many slot sihir kamu memiliki to cast your wizard sihir of 1st level and higher. To cast one of these sihir, kamu harus expend a slot of sihir itu's level or higher. You memulihkan kembali all expended slot sihir ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang. Spells Known of 1st Level and Higher. You know three 1st-level wizard sihir of your choice, two of which kamu harus choose from the abjuration and evocation sihir on the wizard sihir list. The Spells Known column of the Eldritch Knight Spellcasting table shows ketika kamu learn more wizard sihir of 1st level or higher. Each of these sihir must be an abjuration or evocation sihir of your choice, and must be of a level for which kamu memiliki slot sihir. For instance, ketika kamu reach 7th level in this class, kamu dapat learn one new sihir of 1st or 2nd level. The sihir you learn at 8th, 14th, and 20th level can come from any school of magic. Spellcasting Ability. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for your wizard sihir, since you learn your sihir through study and memorization. You use your Intelligence whenever sihir refers to your spellcasting ability. In addition, you use your Intelligence modifier when setting the saving throw DC for a wizard sihir you cast and when making an attack roll with one. Spell save DC = 8 + bonus keahlianmu + your Intelligence modifier Spell attack modifier = bonus keahlianmu + your Intelligence modifier
features.onUse: Cast a prepared spell by expending a spell slot of the appropriate level
features.scaling: Gain higher spell slots and more spellbook spells as you level
features.summary: In addition, you use your Intelligence modifier when setting the saving throw DC for a wizard sihir you cast and when making an attack roll with one.

features.name: Weapon Bond
features.description: At 3rd level, you learn a ritual that creates a magical bond between yourself and one weapon. You perform the ritual over the course of 1 hour, which can be done selama istirahat singkat. The weapon must be within your reach throughout the ritual, at the conclusion of which you touch the weapon and forge the bond. Once kamu memiliki bonded a weapon to yourself, kamu tidak bisa disarmed of that weapon unless kamu adalah incapacitated. If it is on the same plane of existence, kamu dapat summon that weapon as aksi bonus on giliranmu, causing it to teleport instantly to your hand. You can have hingga two bonded weapons, but can summon only one at a time with aksi bonusmu. If you attempt to bond with a third weapon, kamu harus break the bond with one of the other two.
features.summary: At 3rd level, you learn a ritual that creates a magical bond between yourself and one weapon. (bonus action).

features.name: War Magic
features.description: Beginning at 7th level, ketika kamu use aksimu to cast a cantrip, kamu dapat membuat one weapon attack as aksi bonus.
features.summary: Beginning at 7th level, ketika kamu use aksimu to cast a cantrip, kamu dapat membuat one weapon attack as aksi bonus. (bonus action).

features.name: Eldritch Strike
features.description: At 10th level, you learn how to make senjatamu strikes undercut makhluk's resistance to your sihir. When you hit makhluk with a weapon attack, that creature has kerugian on the next saving throw it makes against sihir you cast before the end of giliranmu selanjutnya.
features.summary: At 10th level, you learn how to make senjatamu strikes undercut makhluk's resistance to your sihir.

features.name: Arcane Charge
features.description: At 15th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to teleport hingga 30 feet to an unoccupied space kamu bisa melihat ketika kamu use your Action Surge. You can teleport before or after the additional action.
features.summary: At 15th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to teleport hingga 30 feet to an unoccupied space kamu bisa melihat ketika kamu use your Action Surge. (action).

features.name: Improved War Magic
features.description: Starting at 18th level, ketika kamu use aksimu to cast sihir, kamu dapat membuat one weapon attack as aksi bonus.
features.summary: Starting at 18th level, ketika kamu use aksimu to cast sihir, kamu dapat membuat one weapon attack as aksi bonus. (bonus action).

subclasses.name: Psi Warrior
subclasses.description: Psi Warriors augment their martial might with psionic energy, using mental disciplines to shield allies, propel weapons, and leap through the air.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.summary: Harbor Psionic Energy dice (d6s scaling to d12s) to fuel Protective Field, Psionic Strike, and Telekinetic Movement.
features.description: You harbor a wellspring of psionic energy within yourself. You have a number of Psionic Energy dice equal to twice bonus keahlianmu, which are d6s (scaling to d8 at 5th, d10 at 11th, and d12 at 17th level). You can use your dice for: Protective Field (reaction reduce kerusakan to yourself or an ally within 30 ft by die roll + Int mod), Psionic Strike (deal extra force kerusakan equal to die roll + Int mod on a weapon hit), or Telekinetic Movement (move an object or willing creature hingga 30 ft as aksi).

features.name: Telekinetic Leap
features.summary: Gain flying speed equal to twice kecepatan berjalanmu until the end of giliranmu saat ini.
features.description: As aksi bonus, kamu dapat propel your body with your mind. You mendapatkan a flying speed equal to twice kecepatan berjalanmu until the end of the current turn. Once you take this bonus action, kamu tidak bisa do so again until you menyelesaikan istirahat singkat atau panjang, unless you expend a Psionic Energy die to take it again.

features.name: Guarded Mind
features.summary: Gain resistance to psychic kerusakan, and expend a Psionic Energy die to end charmed or frightened.
features.description: The psionic energy flowing through you has bolstered your mind. You have resistance to psychic kerusakan. Moreover, jika kamu start giliranmu charmed or frightened, kamu dapat menghabiskan one Psionic Energy die and immediately end every effect on yourself subjecting you to those conditions.

features.name: Bulwark of Force
features.summary: Shield yourself and allies within 30 feet with half cover (+2 AC and Dex saves) for 1 minute.
features.description: As aksi bonus, kamu dapat shield yourself and others with telekinetic force. You choose a number of creatures within 30 feet of you equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one), including yourself. For 1 minute or until kamu adalah incapacitated, the chosen creatures have half cover. Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa do so again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang, unless you expend a Psionic Energy die.

features.name: Telekinetic Master
features.summary: Cast Telekinesis without components, and make a weapon attack as aksi bonus while concentrating on it.
features.description: Your ability to move creatures and objects with your mind is unmatched. You can cast the Telekinesis sihir without components, using Intelligence as your spellcasting ability. On each turn while you concentrate on sihir itu, kamu dapat membuat one weapon attack as aksi bonus. Once you cast Telekinesis with this feature, kamu tidak bisa do so again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang, unless you expend a Psionic Energy die.

subclasses.name: Rune Knight
subclasses.description: Rune Knights discover how to enhance their martial prowess using the runic magic of giants, etching supernatural runes into their arms and armor.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.summary: Gain keahlian with smith's tools and learn to speak, read, and write Giant.
features.description: You mendapatkan keahlian with smith's tools, and you learn to speak, read, and write Giant.

features.name: Rune Carver
features.summary: Inscribe giant runes on equipment to mendapatkan passive benefits and activated magical invocations.
features.description: You can use magic runes to enhance your gear. You learn two runes of your choice (Cloud, Fire, Frost, Stone, Hill, or Storm). Whenever you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang, kamu dapat touch a number of objects equal to the number of runes you know and inscribe a different rune onto each. Each rune grants a passive bonus and can be invoked once per short or long rest for a powerful magical effect.

features.name: Giant's Might
features.summary: Grow to Large size, mendapatkan keuntungan pada Strength checks and saves, and deal +1d6 kerusakan once per turn.
features.description: As aksi bonus, you magically imbue yourself with the might of giants. For 1 minute: if kamu adalah smaller than Large, you become Large along with anything kamu adalah wearing; kamu memiliki keuntungan pada Strength checks and Strength saving throws; and once on each of your turns, one of senjatamu attacks or unarmed strikes can deal an extra 1d6 kerusakan to a target on a hit. You can use this feature a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu per long rest.

features.name: Runic Shield
features.summary: Force an attacker within 60 feet who hits an ally to reroll the d20 and take the new roll.
features.description: You learn to invoke your runic magic to protect your allies. When another creature kamu bisa melihat within 60 feet of you is hit by an attack roll, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to force the attacker to reroll the d20 and use the new roll. You can use this feature a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu per long rest.

features.name: Great Stature
features.summary: Your height increases by 3d4 inches, and your Giant's Might kerusakan increases to 1d8.
features.description: The magic of your runes permanently alters you. When kamu mendapatkan this feature, roll 3d4; you grow a number of inches in height equal to the roll. Moreover, the extra kerusakan you deal with your Giant's Might feature increases to 1d8.

features.name: Master of Runes
features.summary: Invoke each rune kamu memiliki inscribed twice per short or long rest instead of once.
features.description: You can invoke each such rune twice, rather than once, and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat singkat atau panjang.

features.name: Runic Juggernaut
features.summary: Giant's Might allows you to grow to Huge size, reach increases by 5 feet, and extra kerusakan becomes 1d10.
features.description: You learn how to amplify your rune-powered transformation. As a result, the extra kerusakan you deal with the Giant's Might feature increases to 1d10. Moreover, ketika kamu use that feature, your size can increase to Huge, and while kamu adalah that size, your reach increases by 5 feet.

subclasses.name: Samurai
subclasses.description: The Samurai is a fighter who draws on an implacable fighting spirit to overcome enemies. A Samurai's resolve is nearly unbreakable, and the Samurai's fighting spirit grants strength and speed.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, kamu mendapatkan keahlian dengan one of the following skills of your choice: History, Insight, Performance, or Persuasion. Alternatively, you learn one language of your choice.

choices.name: History
choices.description: Gain keahlian in History skill.

choices.name: Insight
choices.description: Gain keahlian in Insight skill.

choices.name: Performance
choices.description: Gain keahlian in Performance skill.

choices.name: Persuasion
choices.description: Gain keahlian in Persuasion skill.

choices.name: Language (choice)
choices.description: Learn one language of your choice.

features.summary: Alternatively, you learn one language of your choice. (action).

features.name: Fighting Spirit
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, your intensity in battle can shield you and help you strike true. As aksi bonus on giliranmu, kamu dapat give yourself keuntungan on weapon attack rolls until the end of giliranmu saat ini, gaining 5 poin kesehatan sementara. The number of poin kesehatan sementara increases to 10 at 10th level and to 15 at 15th level. You can use this feature three times, and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses of it ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Can give yourself keuntungan on weapon attack rolls until the end of giliranmu saat ini, gaining 5 poin kesehatan sementara. (bonus action).

features.name: Elegant Courtier
features.description: Starting at 7th level, your discipline and attention to detail allow you to excel in social situations. Whenever you make a Wisdom (Insight) check, kamu dapat memperlakukan a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10. In addition, kamu mendapatkan keahlian dalam Wisdom saving throws. If you already have keahlian in Wisdom saving throws, you instead mendapatkan keahlian dalam Intelligence or Charisma saving throws (your choice).
features.summary: In addition, kamu mendapatkan keahlian dalam Wisdom saving throws. (action).

features.name: Tireless Spirit
features.description: Starting at 10th level, ketika kamu roll initiative and have no uses of Fighting Spirit remaining, kamu memulihkan kembali one use.
features.summary: Starting at 10th level, ketika kamu roll initiative and have no uses of Fighting Spirit remaining, kamu memulihkan kembali one use. (action).

features.name: Rapid Strike
features.description: Starting at 15th level, kamu dapat sacrifice accuracy to make additional strikes. If you take the Attack action on giliranmu, kamu dapat forgo keuntungan on one of the attacks to make an additional weapon attack as aksi bonus.
features.summary: Can forgo keuntungan on one of the attacks to make an additional weapon attack as aksi bonus. (bonus action).

features.name: Strength Before Death
features.description: Starting at 18th level, your fighting spirit can delay the grasp of death. If you take kerusakan that reduces you to 0 poin kesehatan and doesn't kill you outright, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to delay falling unconscious, and kamu dapat immediately take an extra turn, interrupting the current turn. While kamu memiliki 0 poin kesehatan during that extra turn, taking kerusakan causes a death saving throw failure, and three failures can kill you. When the extra turn ends, you fall unconscious jika kamu still have 0 poin kesehatan. Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Taking kerusakan causes a death saving throw failure, and three failures can kill you. (reaction).

subclasses.name: Ascendant Dragon
subclasses.description: Monks of the Ascendant Dragon tradition learn to channel the elemental power of dragons through their ki. These monks can harness the destructive energy of dragonkind, unleashing it through their unarmed strikes and breath weapons.

features.name: Draconic Discipline
features.description: You mendapatkan the following benefits: You learn the draconic language. You learn one cantrip of your choice from the sorcerer sihir list. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this cantrip.
features.summary: Learn one cantrip of your choice from the sorcerer sihir list.

features.name: Breath of the Dragon
features.description: You can channel draconic power into a destructive breath. As aksi, kamu dapat menghabiskan 1 ki point to exhale a 15-foot cone of elemental energy. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 + bonus keahlianmu + your Wisdom modifier). On a failed save, makhluk takes 2d6 kerusakan of a type you choose: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. On a successful save, makhluk takes half as much kerusakan. The kerusakan increases to 3d6 at 6th level, 4d6 at 11th level, and 5d6 at 16th level.
features.summary: On a failed save, makhluk takes 2d6 kerusakan of a type you choose: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. (action).

features.name: Wings Unfurled
features.description: When you use your Step of the Wind, kamu dapat unfurl spectral draconic wings, granting you a flying speed equal to kecepatan berjalanmu until the end of giliranmu.
features.summary: Can unfurl spectral draconic wings, granting you a flying speed equal to kecepatan berjalanmu until the end of giliranmu. (action).

features.name: Aspect of the Wyrm
features.description: You can channel the might of dragonkind to mendapatkan draconic traits. As aksi bonus, kamu dapat menghabiskan 3 ki points to manifest these traits for 1 minute. For the duration, kamu memiliki ketahanan terhadap the tipe kerusakan associated with your Breath of the Dragon, and your Breath of the Dragon deals an additional 2d6 kerusakan.
features.summary: Have resistance to the tipe kerusakan associated with your Breath of the Dragon, and your Breath of the Dragon deals an additional 2d6 kerusakan. (bonus action).

features.name: Ascendant Aspect
features.description: You mendapatkan the following benefits: You can use your Breath of the Dragon without spending ki points. When you use your Breath of the Dragon, kamu dapat memilih to increase its area to a 30-foot cone.
features.summary: Can choose to increase its area to a 30-foot cone. (action).

subclasses.name: Open Hand
subclasses.description: Monks of the Way of the Open Hand are the ultimate masters of martial arts combat, whether armed or unarmed. They learn techniques to push and trip their opponents, manipulate ki to menyembuhkan kerusakan to their bodies, and practice advanced meditation that can protect them from harm.

features.name: Open Hand Technique
features.description:
Starting ketika kamu choose this tradition at 3rd level, kamu dapat manipulate your enemy's ki ketika kamu harness your own. Whenever you hit makhluk with one of the attacks granted by your Flurry of Blows, kamu dapat impose one of the following effects on that target:
- It must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.
- It must make a Strength saving throw. If it fails, kamu dapat push it hingga 15 feet away from you.
- It can't take reactions until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya.
features.summary: When you hit makhluk with an attack from Flurry of Blows, kamu dapat impose one of three effects: the target must make a Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone, pushed away, or unable to take Reactions until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya.

features.name: Wholeness of Body
features.description: At 6th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to menyembuhkan yourself. As aksi, kamu dapat memulihkan kembali poin kesehatan equal to three times your monk level. You must menyelesaikan istirahat panjang before kamu dapat menggunakan this feature again.
features.summary: Can memulihkan kembali poin kesehatan equal to three times your monk level. (action).

features.name: Tranquility
features.description: Beginning at 11th level, kamu dapat enter a special meditation that surrounds you with an aura of peace. At the end of istirahat panjang, kamu mendapatkan the effect of a sanctuary sihir that lasts until the start of your next long rest (sihir itu can end early as normal). The saving throw DC for sihir itu equals 8 + your Wisdom modifier + bonus keahlianmu.
features.summary: The saving throw DC for sihir itu equals 8 + your Wisdom modifier + bonus keahlianmu.

features.name: Quivering Palm
features.description:
At 17th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to set up lethal vibrations in someone's body. When you hit makhluk with an unarmed strike, kamu dapat menghabiskan 3 ki points to start these imperceptible vibrations, which last for a number of days equal to your monk level. The vibrations are harmless unless you use aksimu to end them. To do so, you and the target must be on the same plane of existence. When you use this action, the creature must make a Constitution saving throw. If it fails, it is reduced to 0 poin kesehatan. If it succeeds, it takes 10d10 necrotic kerusakan.
You can have only satu makhluk under the effect of this feature at a time. You can choose to end the vibrations harmlessly without using aksi.
features.summary: When you hit makhluk with an unarmed strike, spend 3 ki points to start vibrations that last for days equal to your monk level. You can end them early as aksi to deal 10d10 necrotic kerusakan; the target must make a Constitution saving throw or drop to 0 Hit Points.

subclasses.name: Shadow
subclasses.description:
Monks of the Way of Shadow follow the path of darkness and stealth. They learn to use ki to manipulate shadows, becoming invisible and striking from the darkness with deadly precision.

These monks are spies, assassins, and infiltrators, using their abilities to move unseen and gather information. They are masters of the night, able to blend into the shadows and disappear at will.

features.name: Shadow Arts
features.description: At 3rd level, kamu dapat menggunakan ki to replicate certain sihir. As aksi, kamu dapat menghabiskan 2 ki points to cast the darkness, darkvision, pass without trace, or silence sihir, without providing material components. Additionally, kamu mendapatkan the minor illusion cantrip jika kamu don't already know it.
features.summary: Additionally, kamu mendapatkan the minor illusion cantrip jika kamu don't already know it. (action).

features.name: Shadow Step
features.description: At 6th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to step from one shadow into another. When kamu adalah in dim light or darkness, as aksi bonus kamu dapat teleport hingga 60 feet to an unoccupied space kamu bisa melihat that is also in dim light or darkness. You then have keuntungan on the first melee attack you make before the end of the turn.
features.summary: As aksi bonus kamu dapat teleport hingga 60 feet to an unoccupied space kamu bisa melihat that is also in dim light or darkness. (bonus action).

features.name: Cloak of Shadows
features.description: By 11th level, kamu memiliki learned to become one with the shadows. When kamu adalah in an area of dim light or darkness, kamu dapat menggunakan aksimu to become invisible. You remain invisible until you make an attack, cast sihir, or are in an area of bright light.
features.summary: Remain invisible until you make an attack, cast sihir, or are in an area of bright light. (action).

features.name: Opportunist
features.description: At 17th level, kamu dapat exploit makhluk's momentary distraction when it is hit by an attack. When makhluk dalam 5 feet of you is hit by an attack from an attacker other than you, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to make a melee attack against that creature.
features.summary: Can use reaksimu to make a melee attack against that creature. (reaction).

subclasses.name: Way of Mercy
subclasses.description: Monks of the Way of Mercy learn to manipulate the life force of others to bring aid to those in need. They are wandering physicians and harbingers of swift death to those beyond saving.

features.name: Implements of Mercy
features.summary: Gain keahlian in Insight, Medicine, and the herbalism kit, and craft a unique mercy mask.
features.description: You mendapatkan keahlian dalam the Insight and Medicine skills, and kamu mendapatkan keahlian dengan the herbalism kit. You also mendapatkan a special mask, which you often wear when conducting your work.

features.name: Hands of Healing
features.summary: Spend 1 ki to touch makhluk and menyembuhkan poin kesehatan equal to your Martial Arts die + Wis modifier.
features.description: Your mystical touch can mend wounds. As aksi, kamu dapat menghabiskan 1 ki point to touch makhluk and memulihkan a number of poin kesehatan equal to a roll of your Martial Arts die + your Wisdom modifier. When you use your Flurry of Blows, kamu dapat replace one of the unarmed strikes with a use of this feature without spending its ki point.

features.name: Hands of Harm
features.summary: Spend 1 ki when hitting with an unarmed strike to deal extra necrotic kerusakan equal to Martial Arts die + Wis.
features.description: You can use your ki to inflict wounds. When you hit makhluk with an unarmed strike, kamu dapat menghabiskan 1 ki point to deal extra necrotic kerusakan equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die + your Wisdom modifier. You can use this feature only once per turn.

features.name: Physician's Touch
features.summary: Hands of Healing cures disease, blindness, paralysis, or poisoned; Hands of Harm poisons the target without a save.
features.description: Starting at 6th level, kamu dapat administer even greater medical aid with your touch. When you use Hands of Healing, kamu dapat also end one disease or one condition afflicting the target: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, poisoned, or stunned. When you use Hands of Harm on makhluk, kamu dapat subject that creature to the poisoned condition until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya.

features.name: Flurry of Healing and Harm
features.summary: When you use Flurry of Blows, kamu dapat replace both attacks with Hands of Healing without spending extra ki.
features.description: Starting at 11th level, kamu dapat now use Hands of Healing to menyembuhkan makhluk with both of the unarmed strikes granted by your Flurry of Blows, without spending extra ki points.
