In addition, ketika kamu make an unarmed strike with Flurry of Blows, kamu dapat menggunakan Hands of Harm with that strike without spending the ki point for Hands of Harm.

features.name: Hand of Ultimate Mercy
features.summary: Touch makhluk that died within 24 hours and spend 5 ki points to return it to life with 4d10 + Wis HP.
features.description: Your mastery of life energy opens the door to the ultimate mercy. As aksi, kamu dapat touch the corpse of makhluk that died within the past 24 hours and expend 5 ki points. The creature returns to life, regaining a number of poin kesehatan equal to 4d10 + your Wisdom modifier. If the creature died while subject to any of the following conditions, it revives with those conditions removed: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, poisoned, and stunned. Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.

subclasses.name: Way of the Astral Self
subclasses.description: A monk who follows the Way of the Astral Self believes their body is an illusion. They see their ki as a representation of their true form: the astral self.

features.name: Arms of the Astral Self
features.summary: Spend 1 ki to summon spectral astral arms dealing force kerusakan with Wisdom for attacks/checks.
features.description: Your ki allows you to manifest spectral arms. As aksi bonus, kamu dapat menghabiskan 1 ki point to summon the arms of your astral self for 10 minutes. Each creature within 10 feet must succeed on a Dex save or take 2x your Martial Arts die in force kerusakan. While active, kamu dapat menggunakan Wisdom modifier in place of Strength for checks and saves, your unarmed strike reach increases by 5 feet, and your unarmed strikes deal force kerusakan using Wisdom.

features.name: Visage of the Astral Self
features.summary: Spend 1 ki to manifest an astral mask gaining darkvision through magical darkness, Insight/Intimidation keuntungan, and whisper projection.
features.description: You can summon the spectral visage of your astral self. As aksi bonus, or as part of summoning your arms, you spend 1 ki point to manifest your visage for 10 minutes. You mendapatkan Astral Sight (see in normal and magical darkness out to 120 ft), Wisdom of the Spirit (keuntungan on Insight and Intimidation checks), and Word of the Astral Self (project your voice to whisper hingga 600 ft or boom 3x loud).

features.name: Body of the Astral Self
features.summary: Manifest astral armor: deflect elemental kerusakan as reaksi, and make 3 attacks with Flurry of Blows.
features.description: When kamu memiliki both your astral arms and visage active, kamu dapat manifest the complete body of your astral self. You mendapatkan: Deflect Energy (reaction reduce acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, or thunder kerusakan by 1d10 + Wis mod) and Empowered Arms (once on each of your turns ketika kamu hit with your astral arms, deal extra kerusakan equal to your Martial Arts die).

features.name: Awakened Astral Self
features.summary: Spend 5 ki to summon your full astral form: +2 AC, 3 attacks per Extra Attack, and crushing force.
features.description: You can awaken the full power of your astral self. As aksi bonus, kamu dapat menghabiskan 5 ki points to summon your arms, visage, and body simultaneously for 10 minutes. While active: kamu mendapatkan a +2 bonus to AC, kamu dapat membuat three attacks instead of two setiap kali kamu take the Attack action with your astral arms, and ketika kamu hit a target kamu dapat deal extra force kerusakan.

subclasses.name: Way of the Drunken Master
subclasses.description: The Way of the Drunken Master teaches its students to move with the jerky, unpredictable movements of a drunkard. A drunken master sways, tottering on unsteady feet, to present what seems like an incompetent combatant who proves frustrating to engage. The drunken master's erratic stumbles conceal a carefully executed dance of blocks, parries, advances, and attacks.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: At 3rd level, kamu mendapatkan keahlian dalam the Performance skill jika kamu don't already have it. Your unarmored movement speed increases by 10 feet while kamu adalah not wearing armor or wielding a shield, and kamu mendapatkan keahlian dengan brewer's supplies jika kamu don't already have it.
features.summary: Your unarmored movement speed increases by 10 feet while kamu adalah not wearing armor or wielding a shield, and kamu mendapatkan keahlian dengan brewer's supplies jika kamu don't already have.

features.name: Drunken Technique
features.description: At 3rd level, you learn how to twist away from danger. When you use your Flurry of Blows, kamu dapat disengage as aksi bonus, and kecepatan berjalanmu increases by 10 feet until the end of the current turn.
features.summary: Can disengage as aksi bonus, and kecepatan berjalanmu increases by 10 feet until the end of the current turn. (bonus action).

features.name: Tipsy Sway
features.description: Starting at 6th level, kamu dapat dodge in unanticipated ways, seemingly moving out of harm's way at the last moment. When makhluk misses you with a melee attack, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to spend 1 ki point to make a melee attack against the creature. If the attack hits, the creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
features.summary: The creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. (reaction).

features.name: Drunkard's Luck
features.description: Starting at 11th level, you always seem to get a lucky bounce at the right moment. When you make an ability check, an attack roll, or a saving throw that has kerugian, kamu dapat menghabiskan 2 ki points to cancel the kerugian for that roll.
features.summary: An attack roll, or a saving throw that has kerugian, kamu dapat menghabiskan 2 ki points to cancel the kerugian for that roll. (action).

features.name: Intoxicated Frenzy
features.description: At 17th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to make a whirlwind of attacks. When you use your Flurry of Blows, kamu dapat membuat hingga three additional attacks with it (hingga a total of five attacks), provided that each attack targets a different creature.
features.summary: At 17th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to make a whirlwind of attacks. (action).

subclasses.name: Way of the Four Elements
subclasses.description: You follow a monastic tradition that teaches you to harness the elements. When you focus your ki, kamu dapat align yourself with the forces of creation and bend the four elements to your will.

features.name: Disciple of the Elements
features.summary: Learn magical disciplines that harness earth, air, fire, and water by spending ki points.
features.description: You learn magical disciplines that harness the power of the four elements. A discipline requires you to spend ki points each time you use it. You know the Elemental Attunement discipline and one other elemental discipline of your choice. You learn one additional elemental discipline of your choice at 6th, 11th, and 17th level.

features.name: Elemental Attunement
features.summary: Produce minor harmless elemental effects, create sparks, cool or warm objects, or shape mist.
features.description: You can use aksimu to briefly control elemental forces nearby: create harmless sensory effects like showers of sparks, puff of wind, or mist; light or snuff a candle or campfire; chill or warm hingga 1 pound of nonliving material; or shape earth, fire, water, or mist into crude shapes for 1 minute.

features.name: Fangs of the Fire Snake
features.summary: Spend 1 ki to extend unarmed strike reach by 10 ft and deal fire kerusakan; spend extra ki for +1d10 fire.
features.description: When you use the Attack action on giliranmu, kamu dapat menghabiskan 1 ki point to cause tendrils of flame to stretch out from your fists and feet. Your reach with your unarmed strikes increases by 10 feet for that action, as well as the rest of the turn. A hit with such an attack deals fire kerusakan instead of bludgeoning kerusakan, and jika kamu spend 1 additional ki point when the attack hits, it deals an extra 1d10 fire kerusakan.

features.name: Water Whip
features.summary: Spend 2 ki to create a water whip dealing 3d10 bludgeoning and pulling the target 25 ft or knocking prone.
features.description: You can spend 2 ki points as aksi to create a whip of water that shoves and pulls makhluk to unbalance it. A creature that kamu bisa melihat that is within 30 feet of kamu harus make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 3d10 bludgeoning kerusakan plus an extra 1d10 for each additional ki point spent, and kamu dapat either knock it prone or pull it hingga 25 feet closer to you.

features.name: Fist of Four Thunders
features.summary: Spend 2 ki points to cast Thunderwave.
features.description: You can spend 2 ki points to cast Thunderwave.

features.name: Sweeping Cinder Strike
features.summary: Spend 2 ki points to cast Burning Hands.
features.description: You can spend 2 ki points to cast Burning Hands.

features.name: Gong of the Summit
features.summary: Spend 3 ki points to cast Shatter.
features.description: You can spend 3 ki points to cast Shatter.

features.name: Flames of the Phoenix
features.summary: Spend 4 ki points to cast Fireball.
features.description: You can spend 4 ki points to cast Fireball.

features.name: Ride the Wind
features.summary: Spend 4 ki points to cast Fly on yourself.
features.description: You can spend 4 ki points to cast Fly, targeting yourself.

features.name: River of Hungry Flame
features.summary: Spend 5 ki points to cast Wall of Fire.
features.description: You can spend 5 ki points to cast Wall of Fire.

subclasses.name: Way of the Kensei
subclasses.description: Monks of the Way of the Kensei train relentlessly with their weapons, to the point where they become extensions of their body. Founded on a mastery of sword fighting, the tradition has expanded to include many different weapons.

features.name: Path of the Kensei
features.description: When you choose this tradition at 3rd level, kamu mendapatkan keahlian dengan martial weapons and calligrapher's supplies or painter's supplies. You also choose two types of Kensei Weapons: melee weapons or ranged weapons. You can change your choices each time kamu mendapatkan a level. You can use your choice of any Kensei Weapon as a monk weapon, and ketika kamu do so, kamu dapat menggunakan your Dexterity modifier instead of Strength for the attack and kerusakan rolls of your Kensei Weapons.

choices.name: Kensei Weapons (Melee)
choices.description: Choose two types of melee weapons to be your kensei weapons. You can use your Dexterity modifier instead of Strength for attack and kerusakan rolls with these weapons.

choices.name: Kensei Weapons (Ranged)
choices.description: Choose one ranged weapon to be your kensei weapon. You can use your Dexterity modifier instead of Strength for attack and kerusakan rolls with this weapon.

features.summary: Gain keahlian with martial weapons and calligrapher's supplies or painter's supplies. (action).

features.name: One with the Blade
features.description: At 6th level, you extend your ki into your kensei weapons. When you hit makhluk with a kensei weapon, kamu dapat menghabiskan 1 ki point to do one of the following: add your Wisdom modifier to the kerusakan of the attack, or the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away from you.
features.summary: Can spend 1 ki point to do one of the following: add your Wisdom modifier to the kerusakan of the attack, or the target must succeed on a Strength saving.

features.name: Sharpen the Blade
features.description: At 11th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to augment senjatamu with your ki. As aksi bonus, kamu dapat menghabiskan hingga 3 ki points to grant a kensei weapon you touch a bonus to attack and kerusakan rolls ketika kamu attack with it. The bonus equals the number of ki points you spent. The bonus lasts for 1 minute or until you use this feature again. This feature has no effect on a magic weapon that already has a bonus to attack and kerusakan rolls.
features.summary: Has no effect on a magic weapon that already has a bonus to attack and kerusakan rolls. (bonus action).

features.name: Unerring Accuracy
features.description: Starting at 17th level, your mastery of the blade ensures that your strikes land. If you miss with an attack roll using a monk weapon on giliranmu, kamu dapat reroll the attack roll, and kamu harus use the new roll. You can use this feature only once on each of your turns.
features.summary: Can reroll the attack roll, and kamu harus use the new roll. (action).

subclasses.name: Way of the Long Death
subclasses.description: Monks of the Way of the Long Death obsess over the meaning and mechanics of dying. They study creatures as they die and record the exact moment when the soul leaves the body.

features.name: Touch of Death
features.summary: Gain poin kesehatan sementara equal to Wisdom modifier + monk level when reducing makhluk dalam 5 ft to 0 HP.
features.description: Your study of death allows you to extract vitality from dying creatures. When you reduce makhluk dalam 5 feet of you to 0 poin kesehatan, kamu mendapatkan poin kesehatan sementara equal to your Wisdom modifier + your monk level (minimum 1).

features.name: Hour of Reaping
features.summary: Frighten all creatures within 30 feet that can see you on a failed Wisdom saving throw.
features.description: As aksi, you unleash the macabre presence of death. Each creature within 30 feet of you that can see kamu harus succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of you until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya.

features.name: Mastery of Death
features.summary: Spend 1 ki point when reduced to 0 poin kesehatan to drop to 1 poin kesehatan instead.
features.description: Beginning at 11th level, you use your familiarity with death to escape its grasp. When kamu adalah reduced to 0 poin kesehatan, kamu dapat menghabiskan 1 ki point (no action required) to have 1 poin kesehatan instead.

features.name: Touch of the Long Death
features.summary: Spend 1 to 10 ki points on a touched creature to deal 2d10 necrotic kerusakan per ki point spent.
features.description: Your touch channels the pure energy of death. As aksi, you touch satu makhluk within 5 feet of you and expend 1 to 10 ki points. The target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d10 necrotic kerusakan per ki point spent on a failure, or half as much on a success.

subclasses.name: Way of the Sun Soul
subclasses.description: Monks of the Way of the Sun Soul learn to channel the power of the sun into devastating attacks. They teach that the soul is a spark of the sun's divine light, and that by channeling that light, they can overcome any darkness.

features.name: Radiant Sun Bolt
features.description: Starting ketika kamu choose this tradition at 3rd level, kamu dapat hurl searing bolts of magical radiance. You mendapatkan a ranged sihir attack that kamu dapat membuat as aksi bonus. The attack has a range of 30 feet and uses your Dexterity modifier for the attack roll. On a hit, the target takes radiant kerusakan equal to your Martial Arts die. You can use this attack a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu, and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: The attack has a range of 30 feet and uses your Dexterity modifier for the attack roll. (bonus action).

features.name: Searing Arc Strike
features.description: At 6th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to channel your ki into a blast of radiant energy. Immediately after you take the Attack action on giliranmu, kamu dapat menghabiskan 2 ki points to cast the burning hands sihir at 3rd level (save DC equals 8 + bonus keahlianmu + your Wisdom modifier). You can spend additional ki points to cast sihir itu at a higher level. Each additional ki point you spend increases sihir itu's level by 1. The maximum number of extra ki points kamu dapat menghabiskan is 3.
features.summary: At 6th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to channel your ki into a blast of radiant energy. (action).

features.name: Searing Sunburst
features.description: At 11th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to create a ball of light that erupts in a devastating radiant explosion. As aksi, kamu dapat create a sphere centered on a point kamu bisa melihat within 150 feet of you. The sphere has a radius of 20 feet. Each creature in that area must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 2d6 radiant kerusakan per ki point you spend on a failed save, or half as much kerusakan on a successful one. A creature that fails its save is also blinded until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya.
features.summary: A creature takes 2d6 radiant kerusakan per ki point you spend on a failed save, or half as much kerusakan on a successful one. (action).

features.name: Sun Shield
features.description: At 17th level, you become wreathed in a luminous, magical aura. You shed bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. You can suppress or memulihkan this light as aksi bonus. If makhluk hits you with a melee attack while this light shines, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to deal 5 radiant kerusakan to the creature.
features.summary: Shed bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. (bonus action).

subclasses.name: Ancients
subclasses.description:
The Oath of the Ancients is as old as the race of elves and the rituals of the druids. Sometimes called fey knights, green knights, or horned knights, paladins who swear this oath cast their lot with the side of the light in the cosmic struggle against darkness.

These paladins love the beautiful and life-giving things of the world, not necessarily because they believe in principles of honor, courage, and justice. They adorn their armor and clothing with images of growing things—leaves, antlers, or flowers—to reflect their commitment to preserving life and light in the world.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.description:
Each oath has a list of associated sihir. You mendapatkan access to these sihir at the levels specified in the oath description. Once kamu mendapatkan access to an oath sihir, you always have it prepared. Oath sihir don't count against the number of sihir kamu dapat prepare each day.
If kamu mendapatkan an oath sihir that doesn't appear on the paladin sihir list, sihir itu is nonetheless a paladin sihir for you.
features.summary: Gain access to these sihir at the levels specified in the oath description.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Nature's Wrath
features.description: You can use your Channel Divinity to invoke primeval forces to ensnare a foe. As aksi, kamu dapat cause spectral vines to spring up and reach for makhluk dalam 10 feet of you that kamu bisa melihat. The creature must succeed on a Strength or Dexterity saving throw (its choice) or be restrained. While restrained by the vines, the creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a success, it frees itself and the vines vanish.
features.summary: Can cause spectral vines to spring up and reach for makhluk dalam 10 feet of you that kamu bisa melihat. (action).

features.name: Channel Divinity: Turn the Faithless
features.description: You can use your Channel Divinity to utter ancient words that are painful for fey and fiends to hear. As aksi, you present your holy symbol, and each fey or fiend within 30 feet of you that can hear kamu harus make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is turned for 1 minute or until it takes kerusakan. A turned creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can't willingly move to a space within 30 feet of you. It also can't take reactions. For its action, it can use only the Dash action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If there's nowhere to move, the creature can use the Dodge action. If the creature's true form is concealed by an illusion, shapeshifting, or other effect, that form is revealed while it is turned.
features.summary: Present your holy symbol, and each fey or fiend within 30 feet of you that can hear kamu harus make a Wisdom saving throw. (reaction).

features.name: Aura of Warding
features.description: Beginning at 7th level, ancient magic lies so heavily upon you that it forms an eldritch ward. You and friendly creatures within 10 feet of kamu memiliki ketahanan terhadap kerusakan from sihir. At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.
features.summary: And friendly creatures within 10 feet of kamu memiliki ketahanan terhadap kerusakan from sihir.

features.name: Undying Sentinel
features.description: Starting at 15th level, ketika kamu are reduced to 0 poin kesehatan and are not killed outright, kamu dapat memilih to drop to 1 poin kesehatan instead. Once you use this ability, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang. Additionally, you suffer none of the drawbacks of old age, and kamu tidak bisa aged magically.
features.summary: Starting at 15th level, ketika kamu are reduced to 0 poin kesehatan and are not killed outright, kamu dapat memilih to drop to 1 poin kesehatan instead. (action).

features.name: Elder Champion
features.description: At 20th level, kamu dapat assume the form of an ancient force of nature, taking on an appearance you choose. For example, your skin might turn green or take on a bark-like texture, your hair might become leafy or moss-like, or you might sprout antlers or a lion-like mane. Using aksimu, you undergo a transformation. For 1 minute, kamu mendapatkan the following benefits: At the start of each of your turns, kamu memulihkan kembali 10 poin kesehatan. Whenever you cast a paladin sihir that has a casting time of 1 action, kamu dapat menyalurkannya using aksi bonus instead. Enemy creatures within 10 feet of kamu memiliki kerugian pada saving throw against your paladin sihir and Channel Divinity options. Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Enemy creatures within 10 feet of kamu memiliki kerugian pada saving throw against your paladin sihir and Channel Divinity options. (bonus action).

subclasses.name: Devotion
subclasses.description: The Oath of Devotion binds a paladin to the loftiest ideals of justice, virtue, and order. Sometimes called cavaliers, white knights, or holy warriors, these paladins meet the ideal of the knight in shining armor, acting with honor in pursuit of justice and the greater good. They hold themselves to the highest standards of conduct, and some, for better or worse, hold the rest of the world to the same standards. Many who swear this oath are devoted to gods of law and good and use their gods' tenets as the measure of their devotion. They hold angels--the perfect servants of good--as their ideals, and incorporate images of angelic wings into their helmets or coats of arms.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.description:
Each oath has a list of associated sihir. You mendapatkan access to these sihir at the levels specified in the oath description. Once kamu mendapatkan access to an oath sihir, you always have it prepared. Oath sihir don't count against the number of sihir kamu dapat prepare each day.
If kamu mendapatkan an oath sihir that doesn't appear on the paladin sihir list, sihir itu is nonetheless a paladin sihir for you.
features.summary: Gain access to these sihir at the levels specified in the oath description.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Sacred Weapon
features.description:
As aksi, kamu dapat imbue one weapon that kamu adalah holding with positive energy, using your Channel Divinity. For 1 minute, you add your Charisma modifier to attack rolls made with that weapon (with a minimum bonus of +1). The weapon also emits bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light 20 feet beyond that. If the weapon is not already magical, it becomes magical for the duration.
You can end this effect on giliranmu as part of any other action. If kamu adalah no longer holding or carrying this weapon, or jika kamu fall unconscious, this effect ends.
features.summary: The weapon also emits bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light 20 feet beyond that. (action).

features.name: Channel Divinity: Turn the Unholy
features.description:
As aksi, you present your holy symbol and speak a prayer censuring fiends and undead, using your Channel Divinity. Each fiend or undead that can see or hear you within 30 feet of kamu harus make a Wisdom saving throw. If the creature fails its saving throw, it is turned for 1 minute or until it takes kerusakan.
A turned creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can't willingly move to a space within 30 feet of you. It also can't take reactions. For its action, it can use only the Dash action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If there's nowhere to move, the creature can use the Dodge action.
features.summary: Each fiend or undead that can see or hear you within 30 feet of kamu harus make a Wisdom saving throw. (reaction).

features.name: Aura of Devotion
features.description:
Starting at 7th level, you and friendly creatures within 10 feet of kamu tidak bisa charmed while kamu adalah conscious.
At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.
features.summary: At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

features.name: Purity of Spirit
features.description: Beginning at 15th level, kamu adalah always under the effects of a protection from evil and good sihir.
features.summary: Beginning at 15th level, kamu adalah always under the effects of a protection from evil and good sihir.

features.name: Holy Nimbus
features.description:
At 20th level, as aksi, kamu dapat emanate an aura of sunlight. For 1 minute, bright light shines from you in a 30-foot radius, and dim light shines 30 feet beyond that.
Whenever an enemy creature starts its turn in the bright light, the creature takes 10 radiant kerusakan.
In addition, for the duration, kamu memiliki keuntungan pada saving throw melawan sihir cast by fiends or undead.
features.summary: Whenever an enemy creature starts its turn in the bright light, the creature takes 10 radiant kerusakan. (action).

subclasses.name: Draconic Disciple
subclasses.description: The Oath of the Draconic Disciple binds a paladin to the ideals of dragonkind. These paladins draw power from their draconic heritage, channeling the might of dragons through their divine oath. They seek to embody the virtues of dragonkind: strength, wisdom, and majesty.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Draconic Presence
features.description: As aksi, kamu dapat channel the power of dragonkind to demoralize your foes. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of kamu harus make a Wisdom saving throw against your sihir save DC. On a failed save, makhluk is frightened of you for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
features.summary: Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of kamu harus make a Wisdom saving throw against your sihir save DC. (action).

features.name: Channel Divinity: Draconic Might
features.description: As aksi bonus, kamu dapat channel the power of dragonkind to augment kekuatanmu. For 1 minute, kamu memiliki keuntungan pada Strength checks, and ketika kamu deal kerusakan with a melee weapon, kamu dapat menambahkan Charisma modifier to the kerusakan roll.
features.summary: Have keuntungan on Strength checks, and ketika kamu deal kerusakan with a melee weapon, kamu dapat menambahkan Charisma modifier to the kerusakan roll. (bonus action).

features.name: Aura of the Dragon
features.description: You emanate an aura of draconic power. Whenever you or a friendly creature within 10 feet of you makes a saving throw, that creature mendapatkan a bonus to the roll equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of +1). You must be conscious to grant this bonus.
features.summary: You emanate an aura of draconic power.

features.name: Draconic Resilience
features.description: The power of dragonkind flows through you. You mendapatkan resistance to the tipe kerusakan associated with your draconic ancestry.
features.summary: Gain resistance to the tipe kerusakan associated with your draconic ancestry.

features.name: Dragon Knight
features.description: As aksi, kamu dapat channel the full power of dragonkind, gaining the following benefits for 1 minute: You have a flying speed equal to kecepatan berjalanmu. You have resistance to all kerusakan. Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: As aksi, channel draconic power for 1 minute: mendapatkan a flying speed equal to kecepatan berjalanmu, resistance to all kerusakan, and your breath weapon deals max kerusakan.

subclasses.name: Oath of Conquest
subclasses.description: The Oath of Conquest calls to paladins who seek glory in battle and the subjugation of their enemies. These paladins are the masters of combat, and they believe that victory is the ultimate expression of their faith.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Conquering Presence
features.description:
When you take this oath at 3rd level, kamu mendapatkan the following Channel Divinity options:

Conquering Presence: As aksi, you force setiap makhluk pilihanmu that kamu bisa melihat within 30 feet of you to make a Wisdom saving throw. If makhluk fails its save, it is frightened of you for 1 minute. The frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a successful save.

Guided Strike: When you make an attack roll, kamu dapat menggunakan your Channel Divinity to mendapatkan a +10 bonus to the attack roll. You make this choice after you see the roll, but before the DM determines whether the attack hits or misses.
features.summary: Gain the following Channel Divinity options: Conquering Presence: As aksi, you force setiap makhluk pilihanmu that kamu bisa melihat within 30 feet of you to make.

features.name: Aura of Conquest
features.description: Starting at 7th level, you constantly emanate a menacing aura while kamu adalah not incapacitated. The aura extends 10 feet from you in every direction, but not through total cover. If makhluk is frightened of you, its speed is reduced to 0 while in the aura, and that creature takes psychic kerusakan equal to half your paladin level if it ends its turn there. At 18th level, the aura extends to 30 feet.
features.summary: Its speed is reduced to 0 while in the aura, and that creature takes psychic kerusakan equal to half your paladin level if it ends its turn there.

features.name: Scared Earth
features.description: Starting at 15th level, kamu dapat call on the power of your oath to strike fear into your foes. As aksi, kamu dapat cause the ground in a 30-foot radius around you to become difficult terrain for 1 minute. In addition, the first time each turn that makhluk moves into the area or starts its turn there, it takes 3d6 psychic kerusakan. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once), and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: In addition, the first time each turn that makhluk moves into the area or starts its turn there, it takes 3d6 psychic kerusakan. (action).

features.name: Invincible Conqueror
features.description: At 20th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to harness extraordinary martial prowess. As aksi, kamu dapat magically become an avatar of conquest, gaining the following benefits for 1 minute: You have resistance to all kerusakan. When you take the Attack action on giliranmu, kamu dapat membuat one additional attack as a part of that action. Your melee weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20. Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: At 20th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to harness extraordinary martial prowess. (action).

subclasses.name: Oath of Glory
subclasses.description: Paladins who take the Oath of Glory believe they and their companions are destined to achieve heroic glory through acts of courage, discipline, and deeds written in legend.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.summary: Gain oath sihir at levels 3, 5, 9, 13, and 17.
features.description: 3rd: Guiding Bolt, Heroism; 5th: Enhance Ability, Magic Weapon; 9th: Haste, Protection from Energy; 13th: Compulsion, Freedom of Movement; 17th: Commune, Flame Strike.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Peerless Athlete
features.summary: Gain keuntungan on Athletics/Acrobatics checks, double carry weight, and jump distance +10 ft for 10 minutes.
features.description: As aksi bonus, kamu dapat menggunakan your Channel Divinity to augment your athleticism. For 10 minutes, kamu memiliki keuntungan pada Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks; kamu dapat carry, push, drag, and lift twice as much weight; and your jump distance increases by 10 feet.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Inspiring Smite
features.summary: Distribute 2d8 + paladin level poin kesehatan sementara to allies within 30 feet after using Divine Smite.
features.description: Immediately after you deal kerusakan to makhluk with your Divine Smite feature, kamu dapat menggunakan your Channel Divinity as aksi bonus to distribute poin kesehatan sementara to creatures of your choice within 30 feet of you (including yourself) equal to 2d8 + your paladin level, divided among them as you choose.

features.name: Aura of Alacrity
features.summary: Your walking speed increases by 10 feet, and allies starting their turn within 5 feet (10 ft at 18th) mendapatkan +10 ft speed.
features.description: You exude an aura that fills you and your companions with vigor. Your walking speed increases by 10 feet. In addition, that of each ally within 5 feet of you increases by 10 feet until the end of their next turn. At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 10 feet.

features.name: Glorious Defense
features.summary: Reaction add your Charisma modifier to an ally's AC; if attack misses, make a weapon attack against the attacker.
features.description: You can turn defense into attack. When you or another creature kamu bisa melihat within 10 feet of you is hit by an attack roll, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to grant a bonus to the target's AC against that attack equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of +1). If the attack misses, kamu dapat immediately make one weapon attack against the attacker as part of this reaction, provided the attacker is within senjatamu's range.

features.name: Living Legend
features.summary: Transform into a legendary hero for 1 minute: keuntungan on Charisma checks, reroll missed attacks, reaction sihir save keuntungan.
features.description: You can empower yourself with the legends of your destiny. As aksi bonus, kamu mendapatkan the following benefits for 1 minute: kamu adalah blessed with an otherworldly presence, gaining keuntungan on all Charisma checks; once on each of your turns ketika kamu make a weapon attack and miss, kamu dapat cause that attack to hit instead; and jika kamu fail a saving throw, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to reroll it.

subclasses.name: Oath of Redemption
subclasses.description: The Oath of Redemption sets a paladin on a difficult path, one that requires the courage to give quarter to those who have none and the strength to put mercy before justice.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Emissary of Peace
features.description:
When you take this oath at 3rd level, kamu mendapatkan the following Channel Divinity options:

Emissary of Peace: As aksi bonus, you grant makhluk yang kamu lihat dalam 30 feet of you a +5 bonus to its next Charisma check. The bonus lasts for 10 minutes.

Rebuke the Violent: When makhluk dalam 30 feet of you deals kerusakan to makhluk other than you, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to force the attacker to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the attacker takes radiant kerusakan equal to the kerusakan it just dealt. On a successful save, it takes half as much kerusakan.
features.summary: Rebuke the Violent: When makhluk dalam 30 feet of you deals kerusakan to makhluk other than you, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to force the attacker to make.

features.name: Aura of the Guardian
features.description: Starting at 7th level, kamu dapat shield others from harm. When makhluk dalam 10 feet of you takes kerusakan, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to magically take that kerusakan, instead of that creature taking it. This feature doesn't transfer any other effects associated with the kerusakan, and the kerusakan can't be reduced in any way. At 18th level, the aura extends to 30 feet.
features.summary: Can use reaksimu to magically take that kerusakan, instead of that creature taking it. (reaction).

features.name: Protective Spirit
features.description: Starting at 15th level, a protective, guardian spirit keeps you and your allies safe. If you or makhluk yang kamu lihat dalam 30 feet of you fails a saving throw, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to grant a +5 bonus to the saving throw, potentially turning the failure into a success. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once), and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Can use reaksimu to grant a +5 bonus to the saving throw, potentially turning the failure into a success. (reaction).

features.name: Emissary of Redemption
features.description: At 20th level, you become an avatar of peace, which gives you the following benefits: You have resistance to all kerusakan dealt by other creatures (their attacks, sihir, and other effects). Whenever makhluk hits you with an attack, it takes radiant kerusakan equal to half the kerusakan you took from the attack. If kamu adalah reduced to 0 poin kesehatan by makhluk and aren't killed outright, kamu dapat memilih to drop to 1 poin kesehatan instead. Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Whenever makhluk hits you with an attack, it takes radiant kerusakan equal to half the kerusakan you took from the attack. (action).

subclasses.name: Oath of the Crown
subclasses.description: The Oath of the Crown is sworn to the ideals of civilization, the law, and the preservation of an established sovereign realm.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.summary: Gain oath sihir at levels 3, 5, 9, 13, and 17.
features.description: 3rd: Command, Compelled Duel; 5th: Warding Bond, Zone of Truth; 9th: Aura of Vitality, Spirit Guardians; 13th: Banishment, Guardian of Faith; 17th: Circle of Power, Geas.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Champion Challenge
features.summary: Force hostile creatures within 30 feet to stay within 30 feet of you on a failed Wisdom saving throw.
features.description: As aksi bonus, you issue a challenge that compels other creatures to do battle with you. Each creature of your choice that kamu bisa melihat within 30 feet of kamu harus make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, makhluk can't willingly move more than 30 feet away from you.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Turn the Tide
features.summary: Restore 1d6 + Cha mod poin kesehatan to allies within 30 feet that have no more than half their max HP.
features.description: As aksi bonus, kamu dapat bolster injured creatures with your Channel Divinity. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you that can hear you and has no more than half its poin kesehatan memulihkan kembali poin kesehatan equal to 1d6 + your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

features.name: Divine Allegiance
features.summary: When an ally within 5 feet takes kerusakan, use reaksimu to magically take that kerusakan instead.
features.description: Starting at 7th level, when makhluk dalam 5 feet of you takes kerusakan, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to magically substitute your own health for that of the target creature, taking that kerusakan in its place. This kerusakan to kamu tidak dapat be reduced or prevented in any way.

features.name: Unyielding Saint
features.summary: Gain keuntungan on saving throws to avoid being paralyzed or stunned.
features.description: Beginning at 15th level, kamu memiliki keuntungan pada saving throw to avoid becoming paralyzed or stunned.

features.name: Exalted Champion
features.summary: For 1 hour: resistance to nonmagical weapon kerusakan, allies within 30 ft have keuntungan on death and Wisdom saves.
features.description: At 20th level, your presence on the battlefield becomes an inspiration to your allies. As aksi, kamu mendapatkan the following benefits for 1 hour: resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing kerusakan from nonmagical weapons; your allies within 30 feet have keuntungan on death saving throws; and you and your allies within 30 feet have keuntungan on Wisdom saving throws.

subclasses.name: Oath of the Watchers
subclasses.description: The Oath of the Watchers binds paladins to protect the mortal realm against otherworldly threats. These paladins are vigilant in spotting the influence of extraplanar entities and in defeating their agents.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Watcher's Will
features.description:
When you take this oath at 3rd level, kamu mendapatkan the following Channel Divinity options:

Watcher's Will: As aksi bonus, you grant yourself or makhluk yang kamu lihat dalam 30 feet of you keuntungan on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws for 1 minute.

Abjure the Extraplanar: As aksi, you force each aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, or fiend of your choice within 30 feet of you to make a Wisdom saving throw. If the creature fails its save, it is turned for 1 minute or until it takes any kerusakan. Turned creatures must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can't willingly move to a space within 30 feet of you. It also can't take reactions. For its action, it can use only the Dash action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving.
features.summary: Abjure the Extraplanar: As aksi, you force each aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, or fiend of your choice within 30 feet of you to make a Wisdom saving throw.

features.name: Aura of the Sentinel
features.description: Starting at 7th level, you emit a 10-foot aura of alertness. If you and any creatures of your choice within the aura are sleeping, you and those creatures are not surprised ketika kamu wake up. In addition, you and creatures of your choice within the aura have keuntungan on Wisdom (Perception) checks. At 18th level, the aura extends to 30 feet.
features.summary: Emit a 10-foot aura. You and creatures of your choice within the aura cannot be surprised while sleeping. At 18th level, the aura extends to 30 feet.

features.name: Vigilant Rebuke
features.description: Starting at 15th level, you respond to threats with divine speed. When makhluk dalam 30 feet of you makes an attack roll while under the effect of sihir or other magical effect, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to force the creature to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 3d8 psychic kerusakan, and it has kerugian on the attack roll. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much kerusakan, and it doesn't suffer kerugian on the attack roll.
features.summary: Can use reaksimu to force the creature to make a Wisdom saving throw. (reaction).

features.name: Mortal Bulwark
features.description: At 20th level, you channel divine power to protect the mortal realm. As aksi bonus, kamu mendapatkan the following benefits for 1 minute: You mendapatkan truesight with a range of 30 feet. You have keuntungan on attack rolls against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, and fiends. When you hit makhluk with an attack roll, kamu dapat turn the hit into a critical hit. Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Have keuntungan on attack rolls against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, and fiends. (bonus action).

subclasses.name: Oathbreaker
subclasses.description: An Oathbreaker is a paladin who has broken their sacred vows to pursue a dark ambition or serve a fiendish power. Only malice and dark magic remain where virtue once stood.

features.name: Oathbreaker Spells
features.summary: Gain dark oathbreaker sihir at levels 3, 5, 9, 13, and 17.
features.description: 3rd: Hellish Rebuke, Inflict Wounds; 5th: Crown of Madness, Darkness; 9th: Animate Dead, Bestow Curse; 13th: Blight, Confusion; 17th: Contagion, Dominate Person.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Control Undead
features.summary: Take control of an undead creature within 30 feet with CR lower than your paladin level for 24 hours.
features.description: As aksi, you target one undead creature kamu bisa melihat within 30 feet. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target must obey your commands for the next 24 hours, or until you use this Channel Divinity option again. An undead whose challenge rating is equal to or greater than your paladin level is immune.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Dreadful Aspect
features.summary: Frighten all hostile creatures within 30 feet for 1 minute on a failed Wisdom saving throw.
features.description: As aksi, the paladin channels the darkest emotions and focuses them into a burst of magical menace. Each creature of the paladin's choice within 30 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw if it can see the paladin. On a failed save, the target is frightened of the paladin for 1 minute.

features.name: Aura of Hate
features.summary: Add your Charisma modifier to melee weapon kerusakan rolls for yourself and friendly fiends/undead within 10 ft.
features.description: Starting at 7th level, the paladin, as well as any fiends and undead within 10 feet of the paladin, mendapatkan a bonus to melee weapon kerusakan rolls equal to the paladin's Charisma modifier (minimum of +1). At 18th level, the range increases to 30 feet.

features.name: Supernatural Resistance
features.summary: Gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing kerusakan from nonmagical attacks.
features.description: At 15th level, the paladin mendapatkan resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing kerusakan from nonmagical weapons.

features.name: Dread Lord
features.summary: Transform into an avatar of darkness for 1 minute: 30 ft gloomy aura, 4d10 psychic kerusakan, bonus action shadow attack.
features.description: At 20th level, the paladin can surround himself or herself with an aura of gloom for 1 minute. The aura sheds dim light in a 30-foot radius. Enemies in the aura take 4d10 psychic kerusakan at the start of their turns if frightened, and the paladin can use aksi bonus to make a melee sihir attack dealing 3d10 + Cha necrotic kerusakan.

subclasses.name: Vengeance
subclasses.description:
The Oath of Vengeance represents the power of righteous fury and retribution. Paladins who swear this oath are typically driven by a personal quest for revenge against evil.

They are willing to sometimes circumvent conventional morality to defeat evil, and they do not show mercy to those who have committed evil acts. Their oath is a solemn vow to pursue and destroy the wicked, no matter the cost.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.description:
Each oath has a list of associated sihir. You mendapatkan access to these sihir at the levels specified in the oath description. Once kamu mendapatkan access to an oath sihir, you always have it prepared. Oath sihir don't count against the number of sihir kamu dapat prepare each day.
If kamu mendapatkan an oath sihir that doesn't appear on the paladin sihir list, sihir itu is nonetheless a paladin sihir for you.
features.summary: Gain access to these sihir at the levels specified in the oath description.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Abjure Enemy
features.description: As aksi, you present your holy symbol and speak a prayer of denunciation, using your Channel Divinity. Choose satu makhluk within 60 feet of you that kamu bisa melihat. That creature must make a Wisdom saving throw, unless it is immune to being frightened. Fiends and undead have kerugian on this saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is frightened for 1 minute or until it takes any kerusakan. While frightened, the creature's speed is 0, and it can't benefit from any bonus to its speed. On a successful save, the creature's speed is halved for 1 minute or until the creature takes any kerusakan.
features.summary: Choose satu makhluk within 60 feet of you that kamu bisa melihat. (action).

features.name: Channel Divinity: Vow of Enmity
features.description: As aksi bonus, kamu dapat utter a vow of enmity against makhluk yang kamu lihat dalam 10 feet of you, using your Channel Divinity. You mendapatkan keuntungan pada serangan against the creature for 1 minute or until it drops to 0 poin kesehatan or falls unconscious.
features.summary: Can utter a vow of enmity against makhluk yang kamu lihat dalam 10 feet of you, using your Channel Divinity. (bonus action).

features.name: Relentless Avenger
features.description: By 7th level, your supernatural focus helps you close off a foe's retreat. When you hit makhluk with an opportunity attack, kamu dapat bergerak hingga half kecepatanmu immediately after the attack and as part of the same reaction. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.
features.summary: Can move hingga half kecepatanmu immediately after the attack and as part of the same reaction. (reaction).

features.name: Soul of Vengeance
features.description: Starting at 15th level, the authority with which you speak your Vow of Enmity gives you greater power over your foe. When makhluk under the effect of your Vow of Enmity makes an attack, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to make a melee weapon attack against that creature if it is within range.
features.summary: Can use reaksimu to make a melee weapon attack against that creature if it is within range. (reaction).

features.name: Avenging Angel
features.description: At 20th level, kamu dapat assume the form of an angelic avenger. Using aksimu, you undergo a transformation. For 1 hour, kamu mendapatkan the following benefits: Wings sprout from your back and grant you a flying speed of 60 feet. You emanate an aura of menace in a 30-foot radius. The first time any enemy creature enters the aura or starts its turn there during a battle, the creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you for 1 minute or until it takes any kerusakan. Attack rolls against the frightened creature have keuntungan. Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Gain the following benefits: Wings sprout from your back and grant you a flying speed of 60 feet. (action).

subclasses.name: Beast Master
subclasses.description:
The Beast Master archetype embodies a friendship between the civilized races and the beasts of the world. United in focus, beast and ranger work as one to fight the monstrous foes that threaten civilization and the wilderness alike.

Emulating the Beast Master archetype means committing yourself to this ideal, working in partnership with an animal as its companion and friend. The bond between a Beast Master and their companion is unbreakable, forged through shared battles and mutual trust.

features.name: Ranger's Companion
features.description: At 3rd level, kamu mendapatkan a beast companion that accompanies you on your adventures and is trained to fight alongside you. Choose a beast that is no larger than Medium and that has a challenge rating of 1/4 or lower. Add bonus keahlianmu to the beast's AC, attack rolls, and kerusakan rolls, as well as to any saving throws and skills it is proficient in. Its poin kesehatan maximum equals its normal maximum or four times your ranger level, whichever is higher. The beast obeys your commands as best as it can. It takes its turn on your initiative. On giliranmu, kamu dapat verbally command the beast where to move (no action required by you). You can use aksimu to verbally command it to take the Attack, Dash, Disengage, or Help action. If you don't issue a command, the beast takes the Dodge action. Once kamu memiliki the Extra Attack feature, kamu dapat membuat one weapon attack yourself ketika kamu command the beast to take the Attack action. If kamu adalah incapacitated or absent, the beast acts on its own, focusing on protecting you and itself. The beast never requires your command to use its reaction. If the beast dies, kamu dapat obtain another one by spending 8 hours magically bonding with another beast that isn't hostile to you, either the same type of beast as before or a different one.
features.summary: Add bonus keahlianmu to the beast's AC, attack rolls, and kerusakan rolls, as well as to any saving throws and skills it is proficient in. (reaction).

features.name: Exceptional Training
features.description: Beginning at 7th level, on any of your turns when your beast companion doesn't attack, kamu dapat menggunakan aksi bonus to command the beast to take the Dash, Disengage, or Help action on its turn. In addition, the beast's attacks now count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and kerusakan.
features.summary: In addition, the beast's attacks now count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and kerusakan. (bonus action).

features.name: Bestial Fury
features.description: Starting at 11th level, ketika kamu command your beast companion to take the Attack action, the beast can make two attacks, or it can take the Multiattack action if it has that action.
features.summary: Starting at 11th level, ketika kamu command your beast companion to take the Attack action, the beast can make two attacks, or it can take the Multiattack action if it.

features.name: Share Spells
features.description: Beginning at 15th level, ketika kamu cast sihir targeting yourself, kamu dapat also affect your beast companion with sihir itu if the beast is within 30 feet of you.
features.summary: Beginning at 15th level, ketika kamu cast sihir targeting yourself, kamu dapat also affect your beast companion with sihir itu if the beast is within 30 feet of you.

subclasses.name: Drake Warden
subclasses.description: Drake Wardens are rangers who have bonded with a lesser drake, forming a mystical connection with their draconic companion. These rangers train alongside their drake, learning to fight as one with their scaled ally.

features.name: Draconic Gift
features.description: You mendapatkan a drake companion that accompanies you on your adventures. The drake is friendly to you and your companions, and it obeys your commands. See the Drake Companion stat block for its traits and actions. In combat, the drake shares your initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It can move and use its reaction on its own, but the only action it can take is the Dodge action, unless you use aksi bonusmu on giliranmu to command it to take aksi.
features.summary: Gain a drake companion that accompanies you on your adventures. (bonus action).

features.name: Bond of Fang and Scale
features.description: Your drake's bond with you grants it resilience. While your drake is within 30 feet of you, it has a +2 bonus to AC and saving throws.
features.summary: While your drake is within 30 feet of you, it has a +2 bonus to AC and saving throws.

features.name: Drake's Breath
features.description: As aksi, kamu dapat command your drake to exhale a 15-foot cone of elemental energy. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 + bonus keahlianmu + your Wisdom modifier). On a failed save, makhluk takes 4d6 kerusakan of the type associated with your drake. On a successful save, makhluk takes half as much kerusakan. Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat singkat atau panjang.
features.summary: On a failed save, makhluk takes 4d6 kerusakan of the type associated with your drake. (action).

features.name: Perfected Bond
features.description: Your bond with your drake deepens. When you take kerusakan while your drake is within 30 feet of you, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to have your drake take the kerusakan instead. Additionally, ketika kamu deal kerusakan to makhluk dalam 30 feet of your drake, kamu dapat have your drake make a bite attack against that creature as reaksi.
features.summary: Additionally, ketika kamu deal kerusakan to makhluk dalam 30 feet of your drake, kamu dapat have your drake make a bite attack against that creature as reaksi. (reaction).

features.name: Reflexive Resistance
features.description: When you or your drake takes kerusakan, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to grant resistance to that tipe kerusakan to both you and your drake for 1 minute. Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Can use reaksimu to grant resistance to that tipe kerusakan to both you and your drake for 1 minute. (reaction).

subclasses.name: Fey Wanderer
subclasses.description: Fey Wanderers are rangers who have learned to tap into the magic of the Feywild. They are adept at traversing the border between the mortal world and the realm of the fey, and they use their connection to the fey to bolster their own abilities and those of their allies.

features.name: Dreadful Strikes
features.description: At 3rd level, kamu dapat menggunakan your connection to the Feywild to mark your foes with otherworldly dread. Once per turn ketika kamu hit makhluk with a weapon attack, kamu dapat deal an extra 1d4 psychic kerusakan to the target. The kerusakan increases to 1d6 at 11th level.
features.summary: Once per turn ketika kamu hit makhluk with a weapon attack, kamu dapat deal an extra 1d4 psychic kerusakan to the target. (action).

features.name: Fey Wanderer Magic
features.description:
At 3rd level, you learn an additional sihir ketika kamu reach certain levels in this class, as shown in the Fey Wanderer Spells table. The sihir counts as a ranger sihir for you, but it doesn't count against the number of ranger sihir you know.

3rd: charm person
5th: misty step
9th: dispel magic
13th: dimension door
17th: mislead
features.summary: The sihir counts as a ranger sihir for you, but it doesn't count against the number of ranger sihir you know.

features.name: Otherworldly Glamour
features.description: At 3rd level, your fey connection allows you to project a magical glamour. When you make a Charisma check, kamu dapat menghabiskan a use of this feature to mendapatkan a bonus to the check equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1). You can also use this feature on a Charisma (Deception), Charisma (Intimidation), or Charisma (Performance) check.
features.summary: Can expend a use of this feature to mendapatkan a bonus to the check equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of +1). (action).

features.name: Beguiling Twist
features.description: Starting at 7th level, the magic of the Feywild safeguards your mind. You have keuntungan on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. In addition, setiap kali kamu or makhluk yang kamu lihat dalam 120 feet of you succeeds on a saving throw against being charmed or frightened, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to force a different creature kamu bisa melihat within 120 feet of you to make a Wisdom saving throw against your sihir save DC. If the save fails, the target is charmed or frightened by you (your choice) until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya.
features.summary: In addition, setiap kali kamu or makhluk yang kamu lihat dalam 120 feet of you succeeds on a saving throw against being charmed or frightened, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu.

features.name: Fey Reinforcements
features.description: At 11th level, the royal courts of the Feywild have noticed you. Whenever you cast sihir of 1st level or higher that summons a fey or a beast, the summoned creature mendapatkan the following benefits: The creature appears with more poin kesehatan than normal: 1 extra poin kesehatan per level of sihir itu. The summoned creature's weapon attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and kerusakan.
features.summary: The summoned creature's weapon attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and kerusakan.

features.name: Misty Wanderer
features.description: At 15th level, kamu dapat menggunakan the mystical energy of the Feywild to move between planes. Once per short rest, kamu dapat menyalurkan the misty step sihir, requiring no sihir slot or material components. In addition, ketika kamu use this feature, kamu dapat bring along hingga two willing creatures within 5 feet of you, provided kamu memiliki a way to reach them (such as a rope or chain).
features.summary: In addition, ketika kamu use this feature, kamu dapat bring along hingga two willing creatures within 5 feet of you, provided kamu memiliki a way to reach them.

subclasses.name: Gloom Stalker
subclasses.description: Gloom Stalkers are at home in the darkest places: deep under the earth, in shadowy alleyways, and in primeval forests. They master the shadows to ambush threats before enemies even know they are there.

features.name: Gloom Stalker Magic
features.summary: Gain additional sihir at levels 3, 5, 9, 13, and 17.
features.description: 3rd: Disguise Self; 5th: Rope Trick; 9th: Fear; 13th: Greater Invisibility; 17th: Seeming.

features.name: Dread Ambusher
features.summary: Add Wisdom modifier to initiative, mendapatkan +10 ft speed on your first turn, and make an extra attack dealing +1d8 kerusakan.
features.description: At 3rd level, you master the art of the ambush. You can give yourself a bonus to your initiative rolls equal to your Wisdom modifier. At the start of your first turn of each combat, kecepatan berjalanmu increases by 10 feet, which lasts until the end of that turn. If you take the Attack action on that turn, kamu dapat membuat one additional weapon attack as part of that action. If that attack hits, the target takes an extra 1d8 kerusakan of the weapon's tipe kerusakan.

features.name: Umbral Sight
features.summary: Gain 60 ft darkvision (or +30 ft), and become completely invisible to any creature relying on darkvision in darkness.
features.description: At 3rd level, kamu mendapatkan darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. If you already have darkvision from your race, its range increases by 30 feet. You are also adept at evading creatures that rely on darkvision. While in darkness, kamu adalah invisible to any creature that relies on darkvision to see you in that darkness.

features.name: Iron Mind
features.summary: Gain keahlian in Wisdom saving throws (or Intelligence or Charisma jika kamu already have it).
features.description: By 7th level, kamu memiliki honed keampuanmu to resist the mind-altering powers of your prey. You mendapatkan keahlian dalam Wisdom saving throws. If you already have this keahlian, you instead mendapatkan keahlian dalam Intelligence or Charisma saving throws (your choice).

features.name: Stalker's Flurry
features.summary: Once on each of your turns ketika kamu miss with a weapon attack, make another weapon attack as part of the same action.
features.description: At 11th level, you learn to attack with such rapid speed that kamu dapat turn a miss into another strike. Once on each of your turns ketika kamu miss with a weapon attack, kamu dapat membuat another weapon attack as part of the same action.

features.name: Shadowy Dodge
features.summary: Impose kerugian on an attack roll against you as reaksi unless the attacker has keuntungan.
features.description: Starting at 15th level, kamu dapat dodge in unforeseen ways, with wisps of supernatural shadow around you. Whenever makhluk makes an attack roll against you and doesn't have keuntungan on the roll, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to impose kerugian on it.

subclasses.name: Horizon Walker
subclasses.description: Rangers who walk the border between planes are known as Horizon Wanderers. They are adept at hunting creatures that cross between worlds, and they use their knowledge of the planes to protect the mortal realm.

features.name: Detect Portal
features.description: At 3rd level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to magically sense the presence of a planar portal. As aksi, kamu dapat detect the distance and direction to the closest planar portal within 1 mile of you. Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat singkat atau panjang.
features.summary: At 3rd level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to magically sense the presence of a planar portal. (action).

features.name: Planar Warrior
features.description: At 3rd level, you learn to draw on the energy of other planes to enhance your attacks. As aksi bonus, kamu dapat memilih satu makhluk yang kamu lihat within 30 feet of you. The next time you hit that creature on this turn with a weapon attack, all kerusakan dealt by the attack becomes force kerusakan, and the target takes an extra 1d8 force kerusakan from the attack. When you reach 11th level, the extra kerusakan increases to 2d8.
features.summary: The next time you hit that creature on this turn with a weapon attack, all kerusakan dealt by the attack becomes force kerusakan, and the target takes an extra 1d8.

features.name: Ethereal Step
features.description: At 7th level, you learn to step through the Ethereal Plane. As aksi bonus, kamu dapat menyalurkan the etherealness sihir with this feature, without expending slot sihir, but sihir itu ends at the end of giliranmu saat ini. Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat singkat atau panjang.
features.summary: Can cast the etherealness sihir with this feature, without expending slot sihir, but sihir itu ends at the end of giliranmu saat ini. (bonus action).

features.name: Distant Strike
features.description: At 11th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to pass between the planes in the midst of battle. When you take the Attack action, kamu dapat teleport hingga 10 feet before each attack to an unoccupied space kamu bisa melihat. If you attack at least two different creatures with the action, kamu dapat membuat one additional weapon attack with it.
features.summary: Can teleport hingga 10 feet before each attack to an unoccupied space kamu bisa melihat. (action).

features.name: Spectral Defense
features.description: At 15th level, keampuanmu to move between planes enables you to slip away from harm. When you take kerusakan from an attack, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to give yourself resistance to all of that attack's kerusakan.
features.summary: At 15th level, keampuanmu to move between planes enables you to slip away from harm. (reaction).

subclasses.name: Hunter
subclasses.description: Emulating the Hunter archetype means accepting your place as a bulwark between civilization and the terrors of the wilderness. As you walk the Hunter's path, you learn specialized techniques for fighting the threats you face, from rampaging ogres and hordes of orcs to towering giants and terrifying dragons.

features.name: Hunter's Prey
features.description:
At 3rd level, kamu mendapatkan one of the following features of your choice.
Colossus Slayer
Giant Killer
Horde Breaker
features.summary: Choose one: Colossus Slayer (extra 1d8 kerusakan once per turn), Giant Killer (use reaction to attack when a Large or larger creature hits you), or Horde Breaker (make an extra attack against a different creature within 5 feet of the target).

features.name: Defensive Tactics
features.description:
At 7th level, kamu mendapatkan one of the following features of your choice.
Escape the Horde
Multiattack Defense
Steel Will
features.summary: Choose one: Escape the Horde (opportunity attacks against kamu memiliki kerugian), Multiattack Defense (when hit by an attack, mendapatkan +4 AC against the attacker until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya), or Steel Will (keuntungan on saving throws against being frightened).

features.name: Multiattack
features.description:
At 11th level, kamu mendapatkan one of the following features of your choice.
Volley
Whirlwind Attack
features.summary: Choose one: Volley (use aksimu to make a ranged attack against every creature within 10 feet of a point kamu bisa melihat within range) or Whirlwind Attack (make a melee attack against every creature within 5 feet of you).

features.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
features.description:
At 15th level, kamu mendapatkan one of the following features of your choice.
Evasion
Stand Against the Tide
Uncanny Dodge
features.summary: Choose one: Evasion (take no kerusakan on a successful Dexterity saving throw against an effect), Stand Against the Tide (use reaction to redirect a missed attack to another creature), or Uncanny Dodge (use reaction to halve the kerusakan of an attack).

subclasses.name: Monster Slayer
subclasses.description: Rangers who dedicate themselves to hunting and slaying monsters are known as Monster Slayers. They are skilled in tracking their prey and in using their knowledge of monsters to defeat them.

features.name: Hunter's Sense
features.description: At 3rd level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to peer at makhluk and magically discern how best to hurt it. As aksi, you choose satu makhluk yang kamu lihat within 60 feet of you. You immediately learn whether the creature has any kerusakan immunities, resistances, or vulnerabilities and what they are. If the creature is hidden from divination magic, you sense that it is present, but you learn nothing about its defenses.
features.summary: Choose satu makhluk yang kamu lihat within 60 feet of you. (action).

features.name: Slayer's Prey
features.description: At 3rd level, kamu dapat target makhluk for death. As aksi bonus, you designate satu makhluk yang kamu lihat within 60 feet of you as your slayer's prey. The first time each turn you hit that target with a weapon attack, you deal an extra 1d6 kerusakan to it. This benefit lasts until you menyelesaikan istirahat singkat atau panjang. When you finish a rest, kamu dapat transfer the benefit to a different creature ketika kamu spot the creature within 60 feet of you, provided you aren't incapacitated.
features.summary: The first time each turn you hit that target with a weapon attack, you deal an extra 1d6 kerusakan to it. (bonus action).

features.name: Supernatural Defense
features.description: At 7th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to any saving throw you make that doesn't already include your Wisdom modifier. In addition, kamu mendapatkan a +1 bonus to AC-mu while kamu adalah not wearing heavy armor.
features.summary: At 7th level, you add your Wisdom modifier to any saving throw you make that doesn't already include your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Magic-User's Nemesis
features.description: At 11th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to thwart someone else's spellcasting. When you see makhluk casting sihir or using a magical effect within 60 feet of you, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to make a Wisdom check, with a DC of 10 + sihir itu's level. On a success, the creature's sihir fails and has no effect, and any material components used to cast sihir itu are wasted. Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat singkat atau panjang.
features.summary: Can use reaksimu to make a Wisdom check, with a DC of 10 + sihir itu's level. (reaction).

features.name: Slayer's Counter
features.description: At 15th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to counterattack when your prey tries to resist your assault. If the target of your Slayer's Prey forces you to make a saving throw, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to make one weapon attack against the creature. You make this attack immediately before making the saving throw. If your attack hits, saving throwmu against the target's effect is made with keuntungan.
features.summary: Make this attack immediately before making the saving throw. (reaction).

subclasses.name: Swarmkeeper
subclasses.description: Swarmkeepers are rangers who have learned to call upon the power of nature's smallest creatures. They can summon a swarm of fey spirits that take the form of various creatures, and they use the swarm to aid them in battle.

features.name: Swarmkeeper Magic
features.description:
At 3rd level, you learn the mage hand cantrip jika kamu don't already know it. When you cast it, the hand takes the form of a swarm of nature spirits. In addition, you learn an additional sihir ketika kamu reach certain levels in this class, as shown in the Swarmkeeper Spells table. The sihir counts as a ranger sihir for you, but it doesn't count against the number of ranger sihir you know.

3rd: faerie fire
5th: web
9th: gaseous form
13th: giant insect
17th: insect plague
features.summary: The sihir counts as a ranger sihir for you, but it doesn't count against the number of ranger sihir you know.

features.name: Gathered Swarm
features.description:
At 3rd level, kamu dapat call forth a swarm of fey spirits to attack your enemies. As aksi bonus, kamu dapat conjure the swarm in a space kamu bisa melihat within 30 feet of you. The swarm is a spectral version of a Tiny beast (bats, insects, birds, or other creatures of your choice). The swarm occupies its space and doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. The swarm remains for 1 minute, until you dismiss it as aksi bonus, or until you use this feature again.

When you conjure the swarm, kamu dapat memilih one of the following effects:

Damage: Once per turn ketika kamu hit makhluk with a weapon attack, kamu dapat have the swarm deal 1d6 piercing, slashing, or bludgeoning kerusakan (your choice) to the target.

Movement: You can use aksi bonus to move the swarm hingga 30 feet. If the swarm moves through makhluk's space, that creature takes 1 piercing kerusakan. You can also move a willing creature within 5 feet of the swarm hingga 10 feet.

Protection: When makhluk yang kamu lihat takes kerusakan while within 5 feet of the swarm, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to reduce the kerusakan by 1d6.

The kerusakan increases to 2d6 at 11th level.
features.summary: Protection: When makhluk yang kamu lihat takes kerusakan while within 5 feet of the swarm, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to reduce the kerusakan by 1d6. (bonus action).

features.name: Writhing Tide
features.description: At 7th level, kamu dapat call on the swarm to lift you up. As aksi bonus, kamu mendapatkan a flying speed of 10 feet. This speed lasts for 1 minute or until kamu adalah incapacitated. You can use this feature a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu, and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: As aksi bonus, mendapatkan a flying speed of 10 feet for 1 minute or until incapacitated. Usable a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu, regaining all uses on istirahat panjang.

features.name: Mighty Swarm
features.description:
At 11th level, your Gathered Swarm grows more powerful. When you use Gathered Swarm, kamu dapat memilih one of the following additional benefits:

Damage: The swarm's kerusakan increases by 1d6.

Movement: The swarm's movement speed increases by10 feet, and the creature moved takes 1d6 kerusakan.

Protection: The kerusakan reduction increases by 1d6.
features.summary: Movement: The swarm's movement speed increases by10 feet, and the creature moved takes 1d6 kerusakan. (action).

features.name: Swarming Dispersal
features.description: At 15th level, kamu dapat call on the swarm to protect you from harm. When you take kerusakan, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to give yourself resistance to that tipe kerusakan until the end of the current turn. The swarm then teleports to an unoccupied space of your choice that kamu bisa melihat within 30 feet of you.
features.summary: The swarm then teleports to an unoccupied space of your choice that kamu bisa melihat within 30 feet of you. (reaction).

subclasses.name: Arcane Trickster
subclasses.description:
Some rogues enhance their fine-honed skills of stealth and agility with magic, learning tricks of enchantment and illusion. These rogues include pickpockets and burglars, but also pranksters, mischief-makers, and a significant number of adventurers.

You learn to cast sihir, typically sihir of enchantment and illusion, to augment your existing abilities. You also learn to use your mage hand to perform tricks at range, picking pockets and disarm traps from a distance.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: When you reach 3rd level, you augment your martial prowess with the ability to cast sihir. Cantrips: You learn three cantrip: mage hand and two other cantrip of your choice from the wizard sihir list. You learn another wizard cantrip of your choice at 10th level. Spell Slots: The Arcane Trickster Spellcasting table shows how many slot sihir kamu memiliki to cast your wizard sihir of 1st level and higher. To cast one of these sihir, kamu harus expend a slot of sihir itu's level or higher. You memulihkan kembali all expended slot sihir ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang. Spells Known of 1st Level and Higher: You know three 1st-level sihir of your choice from the wizard sihir list. The Spells Known column of the Arcane Trickster Spellcasting table shows ketika kamu learn more wizard sihir of your choice. Each of these sihir must be of a level for which kamu memiliki slot sihir. For instance, ketika kamu reach 7th level in this class, kamu dapat learn one new sihir of 1st or 2nd level. Additionally, when kamu mendapatkan a level in this class, kamu dapat memilih one of the wizard sihir you know and replace it with another sihir from the wizard sihir list, which also must be of a level for which kamu memiliki slot sihir. Spellcasting Ability: Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for your wizard sihir, since you learn your sihir through dedicated study and memorization. You use your Intelligence whenever sihir refers to your spellcasting ability. In addition, you use your Intelligence modifier when setting the saving throw DC for a wizard sihir you cast and when making an attack roll with one. Spell save DC = 8 + bonus keahlianmu + your Intelligence modifier. Spell attack modifier = bonus keahlianmu + your Intelligence modifier.
features.onUse: Cast a prepared spell by expending a spell slot of the appropriate level
features.scaling: Gain higher spell slots and more spellbook spells as you level
features.summary: In addition, you use your Intelligence modifier when setting the saving throw DC for a wizard sihir you cast and when making an attack roll with one.

features.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, ketika kamu cast mage hand, kamu dapat membuat the spectral hand invisible, and kamu dapat melakukan the following additional tasks with it: You can stow one object the hand is holding in a container worn or carried by another creature.
