You can retrieve an object in a container worn or carried by another creature. You can use thieves' tools to pick locks and disarm traps at range. You can perform one of these tasks without being noticed by makhluk jika kamu succeed on a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check contested by the creature's Wisdom (Perception) check. In addition, kamu dapat menggunakan the bonus action granted by your Cunning Action to control the hand.
features.summary: Can retrieve an object in a container worn or carried by another creature. (bonus action).

features.name: Magical Ambush
features.description: Starting at 9th level, if kamu adalah hidden from makhluk ketika kamu cast sihir on it, the creature has kerugian on any saving throw it makes against sihir itu this turn.
features.summary: Starting at 9th level, if kamu adalah hidden from makhluk ketika kamu cast sihir on it, the creature has kerugian on any saving throw it makes against.

features.name: Versatile Trickster
features.description: At 13th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to distract targets with your mage hand. As aksi bonus on giliranmu, kamu dapat designate makhluk dalam 5 feet of the spectral hand created by sihir itu. You have keuntungan on attack rolls against that creature until the end of the turn.
features.summary: Can designate makhluk dalam 5 feet of the spectral hand created by sihir itu. (bonus action).

features.name: Spell Thief
features.description: At 17th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to magically steal knowledge of how to cast sihir from another spellcaster. When makhluk casts sihir of 1st level or higher within 60 feet of you that kamu bisa melihat, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to force the spellcaster to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC equal to your sihir save DC). On a failed save, you learn sihir itu if it is of a level for which kamu memiliki slot sihir. The spellcaster loses sihir itu if they cast it at 3rd level or lower. The sihir remains in effect if the spellcaster succeeds on the saving throw. Once you successfully steal sihir using this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Can use reaksimu to force the spellcaster to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC equal to your sihir save DC). (reaction).

subclasses.name: Assassin
subclasses.description:
You focus your training on the grim art of death. Those who adhere to this archetype are diverse: hired killers, spies, bounty hunters, and even specially anointed priests trained to exterminate the enemies of their deity.

You have a powerful keuntungan ketika kamu can strike from the shadows, taking your foe unawares. You are a master of disguise, poison, and deception, using ketrampilanmu to eliminate targets with ruthless efficiency.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: When you join the College of Lore at 3rd level, kamu mendapatkan keahlian dengan three skills of your choice.
features.summary: Gain keahlian with three skills of your choice.

features.name: Assassinate
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, kamu adalah at your deadliest ketika kamu get the drop on your enemies. You have keuntungan on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn in the combat yet. In addition, any hit you score against makhluk that is surprised is a critical hit.
features.summary: Have keuntungan on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn in the combat yet. (action).

features.name: Infiltration Expertise
features.description: Starting at 9th level, kamu dapat unfailingly create false identities for yourself. You must spend seven days and 25 gp to establish a new identity, including establishing history, contacts, and appropriate credentials. You can't establish an identity that belongs to someone else. Thereafter, other creatures believe kamu adalah that person until given an obvious reason not to.
features.summary: Starting at 9th level, kamu dapat unfailingly create false identities for yourself. (action).

features.name: Impostor
features.description: At 13th level, you acquire the ability to unearth another creature's speech, handwriting, or both, given three hours of study. Your ruse is indiscernible to the untrained eye. However, makhluk that is suspicious of kamu dapat membuat a Wisdom (Insight) check contested by your Charisma (Deception) check to determine that kamu adalah not who you claim to be.
features.summary: You acquire the ability to unearth another creature's speech, handwriting, or both, given three hours of study.

features.name: Death Strike
features.description: Starting at 17th level, you become a master of instant death. When you attack and hit makhluk that is surprised, it must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + your Dexterity modifier + bonus keahlianmu). On a failed save, you double the kerusakan of your attack against the creature.
features.summary: It must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + your Dexterity modifier + bonus keahlianmu).

subclasses.name: Inquisitive
subclasses.description: Inquisitives are specialist sleuths who use their knowledge of body language and psychology to detect lies and ferret out secrets. They are often employed by nobles, merchants, and law enforcement to investigate crimes and uncover the truth.

features.name: Ear for Deceit
features.description: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you develop a keen ear for deception. Whenever you make a Wisdom (Insight) check to determine whether someone is lying or to get a hunch about a person's manner, kamu dapat memperlakukan a d20 roll of 7 or lower as an 8.
features.summary: Whenever you make a Wisdom (Insight) check to determine whether someone is lying or to get a hunch about a person's manner, kamu dapat memperlakukan a d20 roll of 7.

features.name: Eye for Detail
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, kamu dapat menggunakan aksi bonus to make a Wisdom (Perception) check to spot a hidden object or creature, or to make an Investigation check to uncover or decipher clues. In addition, kamu dapat menggunakan aksi bonus to make a Wisdom (Insight) check to get a hunch about a person's manner.
features.summary: Use aksi bonus to make a Wisdom (Perception) check to spot a hidden object or creature, or to make an Investigation check.

features.name: Insightful Fighting
features.description: At 3rd level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to read a foe's fighting style and exploit its weaknesses. As aksi bonus, kamu dapat membuat a Wisdom (Insight) check contested by the target's Charisma (Deception) check. If you win the contest, kamu dapat menggunakan your Sneak Attack against that target even jika kamu don't have keuntungan on the attack roll, but not if kamu memiliki kerugian. This benefit lasts for 1 minute or until you use this feature against a different creature.
features.summary: Can use your Sneak Attack against that target even jika kamu don't have keuntungan on the attack roll, but not if kamu memiliki kerugian. (bonus action).

features.name: Steady Eye
features.description: Starting at 9th level, kamu memiliki keuntungan pada any Wisdom (Perception) or Wisdom (Insight) check that relies on your sight ketika kamu, the target kamu adalah trying to observe, and your observer are all in the same plane of existence. In addition, kamu memiliki keuntungan pada Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight ketika kamu are not moving.
features.summary: You have keuntungan on any Wisdom (Perception) or Wisdom (Insight) check that relies on your sight ketika kamu, the target you.

features.name: Unerring Eye
features.description: At 13th level, keampuanmu to read the intentions of others becomes nearly supernatural. As aksi, kamu dapat sense the presence of shapechangers and anything that isn't in its original form, and kamu dapat detect the presence of illusions and other magic that masks the true form of makhluk or object within 30 feet of you. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Can sense the presence of shapechangers and anything that isn't in its original form, and kamu dapat detect the presence of illusions and other magic that masks the true form.

features.name: Eye for Weakness
features.description: Starting at 17th level, you learn to exploit makhluk's weaknesses by studying its tactics. While your Insightful Fighting feature applies to makhluk, your Sneak Attack kerusakan against that creature increases by 3d6.
features.summary: Your Sneak Attack kerusakan against that creature increases by 3d6.

subclasses.name: Mastermind
subclasses.description: Masterminds are criminal masterminds who use their cunning and charisma to manipulate others. They are often the brains behind criminal enterprises, and they use their knowledge of the law and their connections to stay one step ahead of the authorities.

features.name: Master of Intrigue
features.description: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, kamu mendapatkan keahlian dengan the disguise kit, the forgery kit, and one gaming set of your choice. You also learn two languages of your choice. You can mimic the speech of another person or the sounds made by other creatures. You must have heard the person speaking, or heard the creature make the noise, for at least 1 minute. A successful Wisdom (Insight) check contested by your Charisma (Deception) check allows a listener to determine that the effect is faked.
features.summary: Gain keahlian with the disguise kit, the forgery kit, and one gaming set of your choice. (action).

features.name: Master of Tactics
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, kamu dapat menggunakan the Help action as aksi bonus. Additionally, ketika kamu use the Help action to aid an ally in attacking makhluk, the target of that attack can be within 30 feet of you, rather than within 5 feet of you.
features.summary: Additionally, ketika kamu use the Help action to aid an ally in attacking makhluk, the target of that attack can be within 30 feet of you, rather than within.

features.name: Insightful Manipulator
features.description: Starting at 9th level, jika kamu spend at least 1 minute observing or interacting with another creature outside combat, kamu dapat learn certain information about its capabilities compared to your own. The DM tells you if your target is your equal, superior, or inferior in regard to two of the following characteristics of your choice: Intelligence score, Wisdom score, Charisma score, Class levels (if any).
features.summary: Starting at 9th level, jika kamu spend at least 1 minute observing or interacting with another creature outside combat, kamu dapat learn certain information about its capabilities compared to your.

features.name: Misdirection
features.description: At 13th level, kamu dapat sometimes cause another creature to take the blow meant for you. When kamu adalah targeted by an attack while makhluk dalam 5 feet of you is granting you cover against that attack, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to have the attack target that creature instead of you.
features.summary: Can use reaksimu to have the attack target that creature instead of you. (reaction).

features.name: Soul of Deceit
features.description: Starting at 17th level, your thoughts can't be read by telepathy or other means, unless you allow it. You can present false thoughts by succeeding on a Charisma (Deception) check contested by the mind reader's Wisdom (Insight) check. Additionally, no matter what you say, magic that would determine if kamu adalah telling the truth indicates that kamu adalah being truthful, jika kamu so choose, and kamu tidak bisa compelled to tell the truth by magic.
features.summary: Starting at 17th level, your thoughts can't be read by telepathy or other means, unless you allow it. (action).

subclasses.name: Phantom
subclasses.description: Many rogues walk a fine line between life and death. Phantoms embrace that connection, drawing on the knowledge and whispers of spirits to walk between worlds.

features.name: Whispers of the Dead
features.summary: Echoes of the dead grant you keahlian in one skill or tool of your choice each short or long rest.
features.description: Echoes of those who have died begin to cling to you. Whenever you menyelesaikan istirahat singkat atau panjang, kamu dapat memilih one skill or tool keahlian that you lack and mendapatkan it, as a ghostly presence shares its knowledge with you. You lose this keahlian ketika kamu use this feature to choose a different keahlian.

features.name: Wails from the Grave
features.summary: When you deal Sneak Attack kerusakan, deal half your Sneak Attack dice in necrotic kerusakan to a second creature within 30 ft.
features.description: As you nudge someone closer to the grave, kamu dapat channel the wails of departed spirits. Immediately after you deal Sneak Attack kerusakan to makhluk on giliranmu, kamu dapat target a second creature that kamu bisa melihat within 30 feet of the first creature. Roll half the number of Sneak Attack dice for your level (round up), and the second creature takes necrotic kerusakan equal to the roll's total.

features.name: Tokens of the Departed
features.summary: Snatch the soul of a dying creature within 30 ft into a Soul Trinket granting keuntungan on Death and Con saves.
features.description: When makhluk dies within 30 feet of you, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to capture its soul into a tiny trinket called a soul trinket (max hingga bonus keahlianmu). While carrying a soul trinket, kamu memiliki keuntungan pada death saving throws and Constitution saving throws. You can destroy a trinket to ask the spirit a question or use Wails from the Grave without expending a use.

features.name: Ghost Walk
features.summary: Transform into a ghostly form for 10 minutes: 10 ft flying speed, kerugian on attacks against you, and pass through solid objects.
features.description: You can phase, at least partially, into the realm of the dead. As aksi bonus, you assume a spectral form for 10 minutes (or until dismissed). You mendapatkan a flying speed of 10 feet and can hover; attack rolls against kamu memiliki kerugian; and kamu dapat bergerak through creatures and solid objects as if they were difficult terrain.

features.name: Death's Friend
features.summary: Wails from the Grave deals kerusakan to both targets, and mendapatkan a free soul trinket at the end of istirahat panjang.
features.description: Your association with death reaches its peak: ketika kamu use your Wails from the Grave, kamu dapat now deal the necrotic kerusakan to both the first and the second creature. In addition, setiap kali kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang, a soul trinket appears in your hand jika kamu don't already have one.

subclasses.name: Scout
subclasses.description: Skirmishers are skirmishers who excel at scouting ahead of the main group. They are skilled in stealth, tracking, and survival, and they use their knowledge of the wilderness to aid their allies.

features.name: Skirmisher
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, kamu adalah difficult to pin down during a fight. You can move hingga half kecepatanmu as reaksi when an enemy ends its turn within 5 feet of you. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.
features.summary: Can move hingga half kecepatanmu as reaksi when an enemy ends its turn within 5 feet of you. (reaction).

features.name: Survivalist
features.description: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, kamu mendapatkan keahlian dalam the Nature and Survival skills jika kamu don't already have them. Your keahlian bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of those proficiencies.
features.summary: Your keahlian bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of those proficiencies. (action).

features.name: Superior Mobility
features.description: At 9th level, kecepatan berjalanmu increases by 10 feet. If kamu adalah wearing medium or heavy armor, this bonus is reduced to 5 feet.
features.summary: At 9th level, kecepatan berjalanmu increases by 10 feet.

features.name: Ambush Master
features.description: At 13th level, you excel at setting ambushes. When you use the Hide action during combat, kamu dapat membuat a Dexterity (Stealth) check with keuntungan. In addition, if kamu adalah hidden from makhluk ketika kamu make an attack roll against it, kamu memiliki keuntungan pada the attack roll.
features.summary: In addition, if kamu adalah hidden from makhluk ketika kamu make an attack roll against it, kamu memiliki keuntungan pada the attack roll. (action).

features.name: Sudden Strike
features.description: Starting at 17th level, kamu dapat strike with deadly speed. If you use the Attack action on giliranmu, kamu dapat membuat one additional attack as aksi bonus. This attack can use your Sneak Attack even jika kamu already used it this turn, but kamu tidak bisa menggunakan your Sneak Attack on both attacks against the same target.
features.summary: Starting at 17th level, kamu dapat strike with deadly speed. (bonus action).

subclasses.name: Soulknife
subclasses.description: Soulknives strike and infiltrate with the power of their minds. They manifest blades of shimmering psychic energy from their hands to execute stealthy assassinations and bridge thoughts with allies.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.summary: Harbor Psionic Energy dice (d6s scaling to d12s) to fuel Psi-Bolstered Knack and Psychic Whispers.
features.description: You harbor a wellspring of psionic energy within yourself, represented by your Psionic Energy dice (twice bonus keahlianmu in d6s, scaling to d8 at 5th, d10 at 11th, and d12 at 17th level). You can use your dice for: Psi-Bolstered Knack (add the die to a failed ability check using a proficient skill; if it still fails, the die is not expended) and Psychic Whispers (telepathically connect with allies within 1 mile for hours equal to the die roll).

features.name: Psychic Blades
features.summary: Manifest shimmering blades of psychic energy dealing 1d6 psychic kerusakan, with a 1d4 bonus action offhand strike.
features.description: You can manifest your psionic power as shimmering blades of psychic energy. Whenever you take the Attack action, kamu dapat manifest a psychic blade from your free hand and make the attack with that blade. It is a simple melee weapon with the finesse and thrown properties (range 60 ft). It deals 1d6 psychic kerusakan on a hit. If you attack with a blade, kamu dapat menggunakan aksi bonus to make a second psychic blade attack with your other hand, dealing 1d4 psychic kerusakan.

features.name: Soul Blades
features.summary: Expend Psionic Energy dice to boost missed psychic blade attack rolls or teleport hingga 10x the roll in feet.
features.description: You can weave your psychic blades with your psionic power in two new ways: Homing Strikes (jika kamu miss with a psychic blade, add a Psionic Energy die to the attack roll; die is expended only if the attack hits) and Psychic Teleportation (bonus action throw a blade hingga 10 times the number rolled on a Psionic Energy die in feet and teleport to that unoccupied space).

features.name: Psychic Veil
features.summary: Become completely invisible for 1 hour as aksi; ends jika kamu deal kerusakan or force a saving throw.
features.description: You can weave a veil of psychic static to mask your physical presence. As aksi, kamu dapat magically become invisible, along with anything kamu adalah wearing or carrying, for 1 hour or until you dismiss this effect. The invisibility ends early immediately after you deal kerusakan to makhluk or you force makhluk to make a saving throw. You can use this once per long rest, or by expending a Psionic Energy die.

features.name: Rend Mind
features.summary: When you deal Sneak Attack kerusakan with a psychic blade, force a Wisdom save or stun the target for 1 minute.
features.description: You can sweep your psychic blade directly through makhluk's mind. When you use your Psychic Blades to deal Sneak Attack kerusakan to makhluk, kamu dapat force that target to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + keahlian bonus + Dexterity modifier). If the save fails, the target is stunned for 1 minute. The stunned target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

subclasses.name: Swashbuckler
subclasses.description: Swashbucklers are charismatic duelists who rely on charm and wit as much as they do on their blades. They are often found in the courts of nobles, where they use their skills to navigate the treacherous waters of politics and intrigue.

features.name: Fancy Footwork
features.description: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you learn how to land a strike and then escape retaliation. During giliranmu, jika kamu make a melee attack against makhluk, that creature can't make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of giliranmu.
features.summary: During giliranmu, jika kamu make a melee attack against makhluk, that creature can't make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of giliranmu. (action).

features.name: Rakish Audacity
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, your confidence propels you into battle. You can give yourself keuntungan on a Charisma (Persuasion) check if kamu memiliki not yet done so this encounter. In addition, you don't need keuntungan on your attack roll to use your Sneak Attack against makhluk if kamu adalah within 5 feet of it, no other creatures are within 5 feet of you, and you don't have kerugian on the attack roll. All the other rules for Sneak Attack still apply to you.
features.summary: In addition, you don't need keuntungan on your attack roll to use your Sneak Attack against makhluk if kamu adalah within 5 feet of it, no other creatures.

features.name: Panache
features.description: At 9th level, your charm becomes exceedingly persuasive. As aksi, kamu dapat membuat a Charisma (Persuasion) check contested by makhluk's Charisma (Intimidation) check. The creature must be able to hear you, and kamu harus share a language with it. If you succeed, the creature is charmed by you for 1 minute. While charmed, the creature is friendly to you and your allies. If you fail, the creature is immune to your Panache for 24 hours.
features.summary: The creature is immune to your Panache for 24 hours. (action).

features.name: Elegant Maneuver
features.description: Starting at 13th level, kamu dapat menggunakan aksi bonus on giliranmu to mendapatkan keuntungan pada the next Dexterity (Acrobatics) or Strength (Athletics) check you make during the same turn.
features.summary: Starting at 13th level, kamu dapat menggunakan aksi bonus on giliranmu to mendapatkan keuntungan pada the next Dexterity (Acrobatics) or Strength (Athletics) check you make during the same.

features.name: Duelist's Defense
features.description: Starting at 17th level, your mastery of the blade allows you to turn defense into offense. When kamu adalah hit by a melee attack, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to add bonus keahlianmu to AC-mu against that attack, potentially causing the attack to miss.
features.summary: Can use reaksimu to add bonus keahlianmu to AC-mu against that attack, potentially causing the attack to miss. (reaction).

subclasses.name: Thief
subclasses.description: You hone ketrampilanmu in the larcenous arts. Burglars, bandits, cutpurses, and other criminals typically follow this archetype, but so do rogues who prefer to think of themselves as professional treasure seekers, explorers, delvers, and investigators. In addition to improving your agility and stealth, you learn skills useful for delving into ancient ruins, reading unfamiliar languages, and using magic items you normally couldn't employ.

features.name: Fast Hands
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, kamu dapat menggunakan the bonus action granted by your Cunning Action to make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check, use your thieves' tools to disarm a trap or open a lock, or take the Use an Object action.
features.summary: Starting at 3rd level, kamu dapat menggunakan the bonus action granted by your Cunning Action to make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check, use your thieves' tools to disarm.

features.name: Second-Story Work
features.description:
When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to climb faster than normal; climbing no longer costs you extra movement.
In addition, ketika kamu make a running jump, the distance you cover increases by a number of feet equal to your Dexterity modifier.
features.summary: Gain the ability to climb faster than normal; climbing no longer costs you extra movement. (action).

features.name: Supreme Sneak
features.description: Starting at 9th level, kamu memiliki keuntungan pada a Dexterity (Stealth) check jika kamu move no more than half kecepatanmu on the same turn.
features.summary: Starting at 9th level, kamu memiliki keuntungan pada a Dexterity (Stealth) check jika kamu move no more than half kecepatanmu on the same turn.

features.name: Use Magic Device
features.description: By 13th level, kamu memiliki learned enough about the workings of magic that kamu dapat improvise the use of items even when they are not intended for you. You ignore all class, race, and level requirements on the use of magic items.
features.summary: Ignore all class, race, and level requirements on the use of magic items. (action).

features.name: Thief's Reflexes
features.description: When you reach 17th level, kamu memiliki become adept at laying ambushes and quickly escaping danger. You can take two turns during the first round of any combat. You take your first turn at your normal initiative and your second turn at your initiative minus 10. You can't use this feature ketika kamu are surprised.
features.summary: Take your first turn at your normal initiative and your second turn at your initiative minus 10. (action).

subclasses.name: Aberrant Mind
subclasses.description: An alien influence has wrapped its tendrils around your mind, giving you psionic power. You can now project that power to alter the world around you. You can also use your psionic power to cast sihir.

features.name: Telepathy
features.description: At 1st level, kamu dapat menggunakan aksimu to touch a willing creature's mind and establish a telepathic link with it. Until the effect ends, you and the creature can share words, images, sounds, and other sensory messages with one another through the link. The link is broken jika kamu and the creature are on different planes of existence or if either of you is incapacitated. The creature must be able to understand at least one language.
features.summary: Until the effect ends, you and the creature can share words, images, sounds, and other sensory messages with one another through the link. (action).

features.name: Psionic Spells
features.description:
Starting at 1st level, you learn additional sihir ketika kamu reach certain levels in this class, as shown on the Psionic Spells table. Each of these sihir counts as a sorcerer sihir for you, but it doesn't count against your number of sorcerer sihir you know.

1st: arms of Hadar, dissonant whispers, mind sliver
3rd: calm emotions, detect thoughts, hunger of Hadar
5th: compulsion, Sending, slow
7th: Evard's black tentacles, summon aberration
9th: Rary's telepathic bond, telekinesis
11th: psychic scream, summon aberration
features.summary: Each of these sihir counts as a sorcerer sihir for you, but it doesn't count against your number of sorcerer sihir you know.

features.name: Psychic Deflection
features.description: At 6th level, kamu dapat menggunakan your mind to deflect attacks. When you take kerusakan, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to roll 1d4 and add it to AC-mu until the start of giliranmu selanjutnya, including against the triggering attack. When you use this feature, kamu dapat also choose to either mendapatkan keuntungan pada the next attack roll you make before the end of giliranmu selanjutnya, or impose kerugian on the next attack roll made against you before the end of giliranmu selanjutnya.
features.summary: Can use reaksimu to roll 1d4 and add it to AC-mu until the start of giliranmu selanjutnya, including against the triggering attack. (reaction).

features.name: Revelation in Flesh
features.description:
Starting at 14th level, kamu dapat unleash the aberrant truth hidden within your flesh. As aksi bonus, kamu dapat menghabiskan 1 or more sorcery points to magically transform your body for 1 minute. For each point you spend, kamu mendapatkan one of the following benefits of your choice, the benefits lasting until the transformation ends:

You can see any invisible creature within 60 feet of you that isn't behind total cover.

You mendapatkan a climbing speed equal to kecepatan berjalanmu, and kamu dapat bergerak up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving your hands free.

You mendapatkan a swimming speed equal to kecepatan berjalanmu and can breathe underwater.

Your eyes become a deeper color, and kamu bisa melihat in darkness (both dim light and darkness) to a range of 60 feet.
features.summary: Gain a swimming speed equal to kecepatan berjalanmu and can breathe underwater. (bonus action).

features.name: Warping Implosion
features.description: At 18th level, kamu dapat warp space around makhluk to destroy it. As aksi, kamu dapat memilih makhluk yang kamu lihat dalam 120 feet of you. The creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 5d10 force kerusakan and is teleported to an unoccupied space of your choice that kamu bisa melihat within 30 feet of you. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much kerusakan and isn't teleported. If this kerusakan reduces the creature to 0 poin kesehatan, it is disintegrated. Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: On a failed save, the creature takes 5d10 force kerusakan and is teleported to an unoccupied space of your choice that kamu bisa melihat within 30 feet of you. (action).

subclasses.name: Clockwork Soul
subclasses.description: The cosmic power of Mechanus and the clockwork gears of order infuse your soul. You weave magic that corrects balance, removes keuntungan and kerugian, and protects reality from chaos.

features.name: Clockwork Magic
features.summary: Learn additional order and abjuration sihir at levels 1, 3, 5, 7, and 9.
features.description: 1st: Alarm, Protection from Evil and Good; 3rd: Aid, Lesser Restoration; 5th: Dispel Magic, Protection from Energy; 7th: Freedom of Movement, Summon Construct; 9th: Greater Restoration, Wall of Force. You can replace these with abjuration or transmutation sihir from the sorcerer, warlock, or wizard sihir lists.

features.name: Restore Balance
features.summary: Reaction cancel keuntungan or kerugian on a d20 roll for makhluk dalam 60 feet.
features.description: Your connection to the plane of absolute law allows you to equalize chaotic fluctuations. When makhluk yang kamu lihat dalam 60 feet of you is about to roll a d20 with keuntungan or kerugian, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to prevent the roll from being affected by keuntungan and kerugian.

features.name: Bastion of Law
features.summary: Spend 1 to 5 sorcery points to create a protective ward of d8s that reduces incoming kerusakan.
features.description: You can imbue makhluk with a shimmering shield of order. As aksi, kamu dapat menghabiskan 1 to 5 sorcery points to create a magical ward around yourself or another creature kamu bisa melihat within 30 feet of you. The ward has a number of d8s equal to the sorcery points spent. When the warded creature takes kerusakan, it can expend a number of those dice, roll them, and reduce the kerusakan taken by the total rolled.

features.name: Trance of Order
features.summary: Enter a clockwork trance for 1 minute: attacks against kamu tidak bisa have keuntungan, and attack/check/save d20 rolls of 9 or lower count as 10.
features.description: As aksi bonus, kamu dapat enter a state of clockwork perfection for 1 minute. Attack rolls against kamu tidak bisa benefit from keuntungan, and setiap kali kamu make an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, kamu dapat memperlakukan a roll of 9 or lower on the d20 as a 10.

features.name: Clockwork Cavalcade
features.summary: Summon a 30-foot cube of clockwork spirits: memulihkan hingga 100 HP, repair broken objects, and end 6th level or lower sihir.
features.description: You summon a procession of spirits of order to memulihkan balance. As aksi, you summon spirits in a 30-foot cube originating from you: the spirits memulihkan hingga 100 poin kesehatan, divided as you choose among any number of creatures in the cube; damaged objects in the cube are instantly repaired; and any sihir of 6th level or lower on creatures and objects in the cube end.

subclasses.name: Divine Soul
subclasses.description: A divine soul has been touched by the grace of a divine being. The magic you wield is a gift from the gods, and kamu adalah a conduit for their power.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: At 1st level, kamu mendapatkan keahlian dalam the Religion skill.
features.summary: At 1st level, kamu mendapatkan keahlian dalam the Religion skill.

features.name: Favored by the Gods
features.description: Starting at 1st level, divine power guards your destiny. If you fail a saving throw or miss with an attack roll, kamu dapat melempar 2d4 and add it to the total, possibly changing the outcome. Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat singkat atau panjang.
features.summary: Can roll 2d4 and add it to the total, possibly changing the outcome. (action).

features.name: Empowered Healing
features.description: Starting at 6th level, the divine energy flowing through kamu dapat empower penyembuhan sihir. Whenever you or an ally within 60 feet of you rolls dice to determine the number of poin kesehatan sihir memulihkan, kamu dapat menghabiskan 1 sorcery point to reroll any number of those dice. You can use this feature only once per turn.
features.summary: Whenever you or an ally within 60 feet of you rolls dice to determine the number of poin kesehatan sihir memulihkan, kamu dapat menghabiskan 1 sorcery point to reroll.

features.name: Otherworldly Wings
features.description: At 14th level, kamu dapat menggunakan aksi bonus to manifest a pair of spectral wings from your back. While the wings are present, kamu memiliki a flying speed of 30 feet. The wings last until kamu adalah incapacitated, you die, or you dismiss them as aksi bonus. You can create the wings a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu, and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: As aksi bonus, manifest spectral wings. While present, kamu memiliki a flying speed of 30 feet. The wings last until kamu adalah incapacitated or die.

features.name: Unnerving Defense
features.description: Starting at 18th level, kamu dapat channel divine power to protect yourself from harm. When you take kerusakan, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to reduce the kerusakan by an amount equal to your sorcerer level + your Charisma modifier. If the kerusakan is reduced to 0, the attacker takes psychic kerusakan equal to half the kerusakan you would have taken.
features.summary: The attacker takes psychic kerusakan equal to half the kerusakan you would have taken. (reaction).

subclasses.name: Draconic
subclasses.description: Your innate magic comes from draconic magic that was mingled with your blood or that of your ancestors. Most often, sorcerers with this origin trace their descent back to a mighty sorcerer of ancient times who made a bargain with a dragon or who might even have claimed a dragon parent. Some of these bloodlines are well established in the world, but most are obscure. Any given sorcerer could be the first of a new bloodline, as a result of a pact or some other exceptional circumstance.

features.name: Dragon Ancestor
features.description:
At 1st level, you choose one type of dragon as your ancestor. The tipe kerusakan associated with each dragon is used by features kamu mendapatkan later.
You can speak, read, and write Draconic. Additionally, setiap kali kamu make a Charisma check when interacting with dragons, bonus keahlianmu is doubled if it applies to the check.

choices.name: Black
choices.description: Acid kerusakan

choices.name: Blue
choices.description: Lightning kerusakan

choices.name: Brass
choices.description: Fire kerusakan

choices.name: Bronze
choices.description: Lightning kerusakan

choices.name: Copper
choices.description: Acid kerusakan

choices.name: Gold
choices.description: Fire kerusakan

choices.name: Green
choices.description: Poison kerusakan

choices.name: Red
choices.description: Fire kerusakan

choices.name: Silver
choices.description: Cold kerusakan

choices.name: White
choices.description: Cold kerusakan

features.summary: The tipe kerusakan associated with each dragon is used by features kamu mendapatkan later. (action).

features.name: Draconic Resilience
features.description:
As magic flows through your body, it causes physical traits of your dragon ancestors to emerge. At 1st level, maksimum poin kesehatanmu increases by 1 and increases by 1 again setiap kali kamu mendapatkan a level in this class.
Additionally, parts of your skin are covered by a thin sheen of dragon-like scales. When you aren't wearing armor, AC-mu equals 13 + your Dexterity modifier.
features.summary: Your AC equals 13 + your Dexterity modifier. (action).

features.name: Elemental Affinity
features.description: Starting at 6th level, ketika kamu cast sihir that deals kerusakan of the type associated with your draconic ancestry, kamu dapat menambahkan Charisma modifier to one kerusakan roll of that sihir. At the same time, kamu dapat menghabiskan 1 sorcery point to mendapatkan resistance to that tipe kerusakan for 1 hour.
features.summary: Starting at 6th level, ketika kamu cast sihir that deals kerusakan of the type associated with your draconic ancestry, kamu dapat menambahkan Charisma modifier to one kerusakan roll.

features.name: Dragon Wings
features.description:
At 14th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to sprout a pair of dragon wings from your back, gaining a flying speed equal to your current speed. You can create these wings as aksi bonus on giliranmu. They last until you dismiss them as aksi bonus on giliranmu.
You can't manifest your wings while wearing armor unless the armor is made to accommodate them, and clothing not made to accommodate your wings might be destroyed ketika kamu manifest them.
features.summary: At 14th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to sprout a pair of dragon wings from your back, gaining a flying speed equal to your current speed. (bonus action).

features.name: Draconic Presence
features.description: Beginning at 18th level, kamu dapat channel the dread presence of your dragon ancestor, causing those around you to become awestruck or frightened. As aksi, kamu dapat menghabiskan 5 sorcery points to draw on this power and exude an aura of awe or fear (your choice) to a distance of 60 feet. For 1 minute or until you lose your konsentrasi (as jika kamu were casting a konsentrasi sihir), each hostile creature that starts its turn in this aura must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed (jika kamu chose awe) or frightened (jika kamu chose fear) until the aura ends. A creature that succeeds on this saving throw is immune to your aura for 24 hours.
features.summary: A creature that succeeds on this saving throw is immune to your aura for 24 hours. (action).

subclasses.name: Shadow Magic
subclasses.description: You are makhluk of shadow, for kamu memiliki drawn on the power of the Shadowfell itself. You can call on the dim power of the plane of shadow to bend light and darkness to your will.

features.name: Eyes of the Dark
features.description: Starting at 1st level, kamu memiliki darkvision with a range of 120 feet. When you reach 3rd level in this class, you learn the darkness sihir, which doesn't count against your number of sihir known. In addition, kamu dapat menyalurkan that sihir by spending 2 sorcery points, and kamu bisa melihat through the darkness created by sihir itu.
features.summary: Starting at 1st level, kamu memiliki darkvision with a range of 120 feet. (action).

features.name: Strength of the Grave
features.description: Starting at 1st level, the magic of the Shadowfell wards your soul. When kerusakan reduces you to 0 poin kesehatan, kamu dapat membuat a Charisma saving throw (DC 5 + the kerusakan taken). On a success, you drop to 1 poin kesehatan instead. You can't use this feature if kamu adalah reduced to 0 poin kesehatan by radiant kerusakan or by a critical hit. After the saving throw succeeds, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan this feature again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Can make a Charisma saving throw (DC 5 + the kerusakan taken). (action).

features.name: Hound of Ill Omen
features.description:
At 6th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to call forth a howling creature of darkness to harass your foes. As aksi bonus, kamu dapat menghabiskan 3 sorcery points to summon a hound of ill omen to target satu makhluk yang kamu lihat within 120 feet of you. The hound uses the dire wolf stat block, with the following changes: The hound is a fiend, not a beast. It appears with a number of poin kesehatan sementara equal to half your sorcerer level. It can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 force kerusakan if it ends its turn inside an object. The hound disappears if it is reduced to 0 poin kesehatan, if it is more than 30 feet away from you for more than 1 minute, or jika kamu use this feature again.

On each of your turns, kamu dapat menggunakan aksi bonusmu to command the hound to move to a space within 5 feet of the target and make an attack roll against it. The hound can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 force kerusakan if it ends its turn inside an object.
features.summary: The hound disappears if it is reduced to 0 poin kesehatan, if it is more than 30 feet away from you for more than 1 minute, or jika kamu use.

features.name: Shadow Walk
features.description: At 14th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to step from one shadow into another. When kamu adalah in dim light or darkness, as aksi bonus, kamu dapat teleport hingga 120 feet to an unoccupied space kamu bisa melihat that is also in dim light or darkness.
features.summary: As aksi bonus, kamu dapat teleport hingga 120 feet to an unoccupied space kamu bisa melihat that is also in dim light or darkness. (bonus action).

features.name: Umbral Form
features.description: Starting at 18th level, kamu dapat menggunakan aksi bonus to spend 5 sorcery points to transform your body into living shadow for 1 minute. While in this form, kamu memiliki ketahanan terhadap all kerusakan except psychic and radiant kerusakan, and kamu dapat bergerak through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. You take 5 force kerusakan jika kamu end giliranmu inside an object. In addition, kamu adalah invisible while kamu adalah in dim light or darkness.
features.summary: Take 5 force kerusakan jika kamu end giliranmu inside an object. (bonus action).

subclasses.name: Storm Sorcery
subclasses.description: Your magic springs from a connection to the elemental power of the storm. Many storm sorcerers can trace their magic to a near-death experience caused by a powerful storm, but perhaps your magic comes from a more distant source.

features.name: Wind Speaker
features.description: The arcane magic you command is infused with elemental air. You can speak, read, and write Primordial. Knowing this language allows you to understand and be understood by those who speak its dialects: Aquan, Auran, Ignan, and Terran.
features.summary: The arcane magic you command is infused with elemental air. (action).

features.name: Tempestuous Magic
features.description: Starting at 1st level, kamu dapat menggunakan aksi bonus on giliranmu to cause whirling gusts of elemental air to briefly surround you, immediately before or after you cast sihir of 1st level or higher. Doing so allows you to fly hingga 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.
features.summary: Doing so allows you to fly hingga 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks. (bonus action).

features.name: Heart of the Storm
features.description: At 6th level, kamu mendapatkan resistance to lightning and thunder kerusakan. In addition, setiap kali kamu start casting sihir of 1st level or higher that deals lightning or thunder kerusakan, stormy magic erupts from you. This magic forces setiap makhluk pilihanmu that kamu bisa melihat within 10 feet of you to make a Constitution saving throw. The creature takes lightning or thunder kerusakan (your choice) equal to half your sorcerer level on a failed save, or half as much kerusakan on a successful one.
features.summary: This magic forces setiap makhluk pilihanmu that kamu bisa melihat within 10 feet of you to make a Constitution saving throw.

features.name: Storm Guide
features.description: At 6th level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to subtly control the weather around you. If it is raining, kamu dapat menggunakan aksi to cause the rain to stop falling in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on you. You can end this effect as aksi bonus. If it is windy, kamu dapat menggunakan aksi bonus on giliranmu to choose the direction that the wind is blowing in a 100-foot-radius sphere centered on you. The wind blows in that direction until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya. This feature doesn't alter the speed of the wind.
features.summary: Doesn't alter the speed of the wind. (bonus action).

features.name: Storm's Fury
features.description: Starting at 14th level, ketika kamu are hit by a melee attack, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to deal lightning kerusakan to the attacker. The kerusakan equals your sorcerer level, and the attacker must also make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the attacker is pushed hingga 20 feet away from you.
features.summary: On a failed save, the attacker is pushed hingga 20 feet away from you. (reaction).

features.name: Wind Soul
features.description: At 18th level, kamu mendapatkan immunity to lightning and thunder kerusakan. You also mendapatkan a magical flying speed of 60 feet. As aksi, kamu dapat reduce your flying speed to 30 feet for 1 hour and choose a number of creatures within 30 feet of you equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier. The chosen creatures mendapatkan a magical flying speed of 30 feet for 1 hour. Once you reduce your flying speed in this way, kamu tidak bisa do so again until you menyelesaikan istirahat singkat atau panjang.
features.summary: Also mendapatkan a magical flying speed of 60 feet. (action).

subclasses.name: Wild Magic
subclasses.description:
Your innate magic comes from the chaos of wild magic. The raw, uncontrolled magical energy that flows through kamu dapat manifest in unpredictable ways, creating random magical effects ketika kamu cast sihir.

Wild Magic sorcerers are born with chaotic magic that surges within them. This power can be both a blessing and a curse, granting great strength but also carrying the risk of catastrophic magical surges.

features.name: Wild Magic Surge
features.description: Starting at 1st level, your spellcasting can unleash surges of untamed magic. Immediately after you cast a sorcerer sihir of 1st level or higher, the DM can have you roll a d20. If you roll a 1, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table to create a random magical effect. A surge can occur once per turn. If a surge effect is sihir, it is too wild to be affected by your Metamagic. Wild Magic Surge Table (d100): 01-02: Roll on this table at the start of each of your turns for the next minute, ignoring this result on subsequent rolls. 03-04: For the next minute, kamu bisa melihat any invisible creature if kamu memiliki line of sight to it. 05-06: A modron chosen and controlled by the DM appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you, then disappears 1 minute later. 07-08: You cast Fireball as a 3rd-level sihir centered on yourself. 09-10: You cast Magic Missile as a 5th-level sihir. 11-12: Roll a d10. Your height changes by a number of inches equal to the roll. If the roll is odd, you shrink. If the roll is even, you grow. 13-14: You cast Confusion centered on yourself. 15-16: For the next minute, kamu memulihkan kembali 5 poin kesehatan at the start of each of your turns. 17-18: Your head grows to the size of a watermelon for the next minute. 19-20: You cast Fly on a random creature within 60 feet of you. 21-22: You become invisible for the next minute. During that time, other creatures can't hear you. The invisibility ends jika kamu attack or cast sihir. 23-24: A spectral shield hovers near you for the next minute, granting a +2 bonus to AC and immunity to Magic Missile. 25-26: You can't speak for the next minute. Pink bubbles float out of your mouth setiap kali kamu try. 27-28: A unicorn controlled by the DM appears in a space within 5 feet of you, then disappears 1 minute later. 29-30: You cast Fog Cloud centered on yourself. 31-32: Up to three creatures you choose within 30 feet of you take 4d10 lightning kerusakan. 33-34: You are frightened by the nearest creature until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya. 35-36: Each creature within 30 feet of you becomes invisible for the next minute. The invisibility ends on makhluk when it attacks or casts sihir. 37-38: You mendapatkan resistance to all kerusakan for the next minute. 39-40: Your skin turns a vibrant shade of blue for 1d10 days. 41-42: A creature other than you within 30 feet of you is poisoned for 1d4 hours. 43-44: You cast Polymorph on yourself. If you fail the saving throw, you turn into a sheep for the duration. 45-46: For the next minute, any flammable object you touch that isn't being worn or carried bursts into flame. 47-48: You memulihkan kembali your lowest-level expended sihir slot. 49-50: For the next minute, kamu harus shout ketika kamu speak. 51-52: You cast Mirror Image on yourself. 53-54: You cast Fly on a random creature within 30 feet of you. 55-56: You become invisible for the next minute. During that time, other creatures can't hear you. The invisibility ends jika kamu attack or cast sihir. 57-58: You cast Stinking Cloud centered on yourself. 59-60: Up to three creatures you choose within 30 feet of you take 4d10 fire kerusakan. 61-62: You cast Speak with Dead. 63-64: You can immediately take one additional action. 65-66: You are teleported hingga 60 feet to an unoccupied space of your choice that kamu bisa melihat. 67-68: The nearest door within 60 feet of you becomes a portal to a random plane for 1 minute. 69-70: A unicorn controlled by the DM appears in a space within 5 feet of you, then disappears 1 minute later. 71-72: You are teleported to the Astral Plane until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya, after which time you return to the space you previously occupied or the nearest unoccupied space. 73-74: Maximize the kerusakan of the next damaging sihir you cast at a higher level. 75-76: Roll a d10. Your age changes by a number of years equal to the roll. If the roll is odd, you get younger (minimum 1 year). If the roll is even, you get older. 77-78: 1d6 flumphs controlled by the DM appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of you and are frightened of you. They vanish after 1 minute. 79-80: You cast Polymorph on yourself. If you fail the saving throw, you turn into a sheep for the duration. 81-82: For the next minute, kamu dapat teleport hingga 20 feet as aksi bonus on each of your turns. 83-84: You cast Sunburst centered on yourself. 85-86: A mind flayer chosen and controlled by the DM appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you, then disappears 1 minute later. 87-88: For the next minute, a random creature within 60 feet of you is poisoned. 89-90: You are immune to intoxication for the next 5d6 days. 91-92: Your hands become covered in sticky goo for the next minute. 93-94: You cast Greater Invisibility on yourself. 95-96: Your gender is changed for 1d10 days. 97-98: The next creature you hit with an attack takes an extra 1d6 force kerusakan from the attack. 99-00: You memulihkan kembali all expended sorcery points.
features.summary: 97-98: The next creature you hit with an attack takes an extra 1d6 force kerusakan from the attack. (bonus action).

features.name: Tides of Chaos
features.description: Starting at 1st level, kamu dapat manipulate the forces of chance and chaos to mendapatkan keuntungan pada one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. Once you do so, kamu harus menyelesaikan istirahat panjang before kamu dapat menggunakan this feature again. Any time before kamu memulihkan kembali the use of this feature, the DM can have you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table immediately after you cast a sorcerer sihir of 1st level or higher. You then memulihkan kembali the use of this feature.
features.summary: Starting at 1st level, kamu dapat manipulate the forces of chance and chaos to mendapatkan keuntungan pada one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. (action).

features.name: Bend Luck
features.description: Starting at 6th level, kamu memiliki the ability to twist fate using your wild magic. When another creature kamu bisa melihat makes an ability check or a saving throw, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu and spend 2 sorcery points to roll 4d4 and apply the number rolled as a bonus or penalty (your choice) to the creature's ability check or saving throw. You can do so after the creature rolls but before the outcome is determined.
features.summary: You have the ability to twist fate using your wild magic.

features.name: Controlled Chaos
features.description: At 14th level, kamu mendapatkan a modicum of control over the surges of your wild magic. Whenever you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table, kamu dapat melempar twice and use either number.
features.summary: At 14th level, kamu mendapatkan a modicum of control over the surges of your wild magic. (action).

features.name: Spell Bombardment
features.description: At 18th level, the power of your sihir is amplified by the magic of chaos. When you roll kerusakan for sihir and roll the same number on two or more of the dice, kamu dapat reroll one of the dice. You must use the new roll, and kamu dapat only use this feature once per turn.
features.summary: When you roll kerusakan for sihir and roll the same number on two or more dice, kamu dapat reroll one of those dice. You must use the new roll.

subclasses.name: Archfey
subclasses.description:
Your patron is a lord or lady of the fey, makhluk of legend who holds secrets that were forgotten before the mortal races were born. These beings are capricious and unpredictable, but they can grant great power to those who serve them.

The Archfey patron represents the wild magic of the fey courts. Warlocks who serve these beings mendapatkan abilities that reflect the fey's connection to nature and illusion, including the power to charm and beguile others.

features.name: Fey Presence
features.description: Starting at 1st level, your patron bestows upon you the ability to project the beguiling and fearsome presence of the fey. As aksi, kamu dapat cause setiap makhluk di a 10-foot cube originating from you to make a Wisdom saving throw against your warlock sihir save DC. The creatures that fail their saving throws are all charmed or frightened by you (your choice) until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya. Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat singkat atau panjang.
features.summary: The creatures that fail their saving throws are all charmed or frightened by you (your choice) until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya. (action).

features.name: Misty Escape
features.description: Starting at 6th level, kamu dapat vanish in a puff of mist in response to harm. When you take kerusakan, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to turn invisible and teleport hingga 60 feet to an unoccupied space kamu bisa melihat. You remain invisible until the start of giliranmu selanjutnya or until you attack or cast sihir. Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat singkat atau panjang.
features.summary: Can use reaksimu to turn invisible and teleport hingga 60 feet to an unoccupied space kamu bisa melihat. (reaction).

features.name: Beguiling Defenses
features.description: Beginning at 10th level, your patron teaches you how to turn the mind-affecting magic of your enemies against them. You are immune to being charmed, and when another creature attempts to charm you, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to attempt to turn the charm back on that creature. The creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your warlock sihir save DC or be charmed by you for 1 minute or until the creature takes any kerusakan.
features.summary: The creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your warlock sihir save DC or be charmed by you for 1 minute or until the creature takes any.

features.name: Dark Delirium
features.description: Starting at 14th level, kamu dapat plunge makhluk into an illusory realm. As aksi, choose makhluk that kamu bisa melihat within 60 feet of you. It must make a Wisdom saving throw against your warlock sihir save DC. On a failed save, it is charmed or frightened by you (your choice) for 1 minute or until your konsentrasi is broken (as if kamu adalah concentrating on sihir). This effect ends early if the creature takes any kerusakan. Until this illusion ends, the creature thinks it is lost in a misty realm, the appearance of which you choose. The creature can see and hear only itself, you, and the illusion. You must menyelesaikan istirahat singkat atau panjang before kamu dapat menggunakan this feature again.
features.summary: Choose makhluk that kamu bisa melihat within 60 feet of you. (action).

subclasses.name: Fiend
subclasses.description: You have made a pact with a fiend from the lower planes of existence, a being whose aims are evil, even jika kamu strive against those aims. Such beings desire the corruption or destruction of all things, ultimately including you. Fiends powerful enough to forge a pact include demon lords such as Demogorgon, Orcus, Fraz'Urb-luu, and Baphomet; archdevils such as Asmodeus, Dispater, Mephistopheles, and Belial; pit fiends and balors that are especially mighty; and ultroloths and other lords of the yugoloths.

features.name: Dark One's Blessing
features.description: Starting at 1st level, ketika kamu reduce a hostile creature to 0 poin kesehatan, kamu mendapatkan poin kesehatan sementara equal to your Charisma modifier + your warlock level (minimum of 1).
features.summary: When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 poin kesehatan, kamu mendapatkan poin kesehatan sementara equal to your Charisma modifier + your warlock level (minimum of 1).

features.name: Dark One's Own Luck
features.description:
Starting at 6th level, kamu dapat call on your patron to alter fate in your favor. When you make an ability check or a saving throw, kamu dapat menggunakan this feature to add a d10 to your roll. You can do so after seeing the initial roll but before any of the roll's effects occur.
Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat singkat atau panjang.
features.summary: Can use this feature to add a d10 to your roll. (action).

features.name: Fiendish Resilience
features.description: Starting at 10th level, kamu dapat memilih one tipe kerusakan ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat singkat atau panjang. You mendapatkan resistance to that tipe kerusakan until you choose a different one with this feature. Damage from magical weapons or silver weapons ignores this resistance.
features.summary: Gain resistance to that tipe kerusakan until you choose a different one with this feature. (action).

features.name: Hurl Through Hell
features.description:
Starting at 14th level, ketika kamu hit makhluk with an attack, kamu dapat menggunakan this feature to instantly transport the target through the lower planes. The creature disappears and hurtles through a nightmare landscape.
At the end of giliranmu selanjutnya, the target returns to the space it previously occupied, or the nearest unoccupied space. If the target is not a fiend, it takes 10d10 psychic kerusakan as it reels from its horrific experience.
Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: It takes 10d10 psychic kerusakan as it reels from its horrific experience. (action).

subclasses.name: Great Old One
subclasses.description:
Your patron is a being from beyond the stars, an entity of immense power and alien intelligence. The Great Old One might be a sleeping god, an ancient aberration, or a being from another plane of existence entirely.

Those who make pacts with such beings often find their minds expanded, gaining access to telepathic abilities and forbidden knowledge. However, the price of such power can be high, as the Great Old One's influence can slowly drive mortals to madness.

features.name: Awakened Mind
features.description: At 1st level, kamu dapat communicate telepathically.
features.summary: At 1st level, kamu dapat communicate telepathically with any creature within 30 feet of you, provided the creature understands at least one language.

features.name: Entropic Ward
features.description: At 6th level, kamu dapat impose kerugian on an attack roll against you.
features.summary: At 6th level, kamu dapat impose kerugian on an attack roll against you. (action).

features.name: Thought Shield
features.description: At 10th level, kamu memiliki ketahanan terhadap psychic kerusakan.
features.summary: At 10th level, kamu memiliki ketahanan terhadap psychic kerusakan.

features.name: Create Thrall
features.description: At 14th level, kamu dapat charm makhluk.
features.summary: At 14th level, kamu dapat charm makhluk dalam 30 feet of you. The creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for 1 minute. You can use this feature a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu, regaining all uses on istirahat panjang.

subclasses.name: Hexblade
subclasses.description:
You have made a pact with a mysterious entity from the Shadowfell—a force that manifests in sentient magic weapons. The Hexblade might have forged the blade you wield as your pact weapon, or it might have revealed itself through a ritual of dark binding.

The Hexblade patron represents the power of the Shadowfell and its connection to death and darkness. Warlocks who serve these beings mendapatkan abilities that reflect this connection, including the power to curse their enemies and channel dark energy through their weapons.

features.name: Hexblade's Curse
features.description: Starting at 1st level, kamu mendapatkan the ability to place a bitter curse on someone. As aksi bonus, choose satu makhluk yang kamu lihat within 30 feet of you. The target is cursed for 1 minute. The curse ends early if the target dies, you die, or kamu adalah incapacitated. Until the curse ends, kamu mendapatkan the following benefits: You mendapatkan a bonus to kerusakan rolls against the cursed target. The bonus equals bonus keahlianmu. Any attack roll you make against the cursed target is a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20. If the target dies, kamu memulihkan kembali poin kesehatan equal to your warlock level + your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1 poin kesehatan). You can use this feature a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu, and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Choose satu makhluk yang kamu lihat within 30 feet of you. (bonus action).

features.name: Hex Warrior
features.description: At 1st level, you acquire the training necessary to effectively arm yourself for battle. You mendapatkan keahlian with medium armor, shields, and martial weapons. The influence of your patron also allows you to mystically channel your will through a particular weapon. Whenever you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang, kamu dapat touch one weapon that kamu ahli dengan and that lacks the two-handed property. When you attack with that weapon, kamu dapat menggunakan your Charisma modifier, instead of Strength or Dexterity, for the attack and kerusakan rolls. This benefit lasts until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang again. If you later mendapatkan the Pact of the Blade feature, this benefit applies to any pact weapon you conjure with that feature, no matter the weapon's type.
features.summary: Gain keahlian with medium armor, shields, and martial weapons. (action).

features.name: Accursed Specter
features.description: Starting at 6th level, kamu dapat curse the soul of a slain enemy and bind it to your service. When you slay a humanoid, kamu dapat cause its spirit to rise as a specter. When the specter appears, it mendapatkan poin kesehatan sementara equal to half your warlock level. Roll initiative for the specter, which has its own turns. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you), and it mendapatkan a special bonus to its attack rolls equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of +0). The specter remains in your service until the end of your next long rest, at which point it vanishes to the afterlife. Once you bind a specter with this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: It mendapatkan poin kesehatan sementara equal to half your warlock level. (action).

features.name: Armor of Hexes
features.description: At 10th level, your hex grows more powerful. If the target cursed by your Hexblade's Curse hits you with an attack, roll a d6. On a roll of 4 or higher, the attack instead misses you, regardless of its roll. This ability functions against attack rolls made by both creatures and objects.
features.summary: This ability functions against attack rolls made by both creatures and objects. (action).

features.name: Master of Hexes
features.description: Starting at 14th level, the curse you place on a foe spreads to another when its host falls. When the humanoid kamu memiliki cursed is reduced to 0 poin kesehatan and dies, kamu dapat menerapkan the curse to a different humanoid kamu bisa melihat within 30 feet of you. When you transfer the curse, you don't memulihkan kembali uses of the Hexblade's Curse feature.
features.summary: Can apply the curse to a different humanoid kamu bisa melihat within 30 feet of you. (action).

subclasses.name: The Celestial
subclasses.description: A Celestial patron is a being of the Upper Planes. A celestial warlock is a champion of the forces of good and light, and they channel the power of their patron to menyembuhkan and protect.

features.name: Bonus Cantrips
features.description: When you choose this patron at 1st level, you learn the sacred flame and light cantrip. They count as warlock cantrip for you, but they don't count against your number of cantrip known.
features.summary: They count as warlock cantrip for you, but they don't count against your number of cantrip known. (action).

features.name: Healing Light
features.description: At 1st level, kamu mendapatkan a pool of magical energy represented by a number of d6s equal to 1 + your warlock level. As aksi bonus, kamu dapat menyembuhkan satu makhluk yang kamu lihat within 60 feet of you. The maximum number of dice kamu dapat menghabiskan on a turn equals your Charisma modifier (minimum of one die). Roll the spent dice and add them together. The target memulihkan kembali a number of poin kesehatan equal to the total. You memulihkan kembali all expended dice ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Can menyembuhkan satu makhluk yang kamu lihat within 60 feet of you. (bonus action).

features.name: Radiant Soul
features.description: Starting at 6th level, your connection to the Celestial allows you to serve as a conduit for radiant energy. You have resistance to radiant kerusakan. Whenever you cast sihir that deals radiant or fire kerusakan, you add your Charisma modifier to one radiant or fire kerusakan roll of that sihir against one of its targets.
features.summary: Whenever you cast sihir that deals radiant or fire kerusakan, you add your Charisma modifier to one radiant or fire kerusakan roll of that sihir against one of its.

features.name: Celestial Resilience
features.description: Starting at 10th level, kamu dapat draw on the resilience of the Celestial to protect yourself and your allies. When you or makhluk yang kamu lihat dalam 30 feet of you takes kerusakan, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to grant resistance to that tipe kerusakan until the end of the current turn. You can use this feature a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu, and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Can use reaksimu to grant resistance to that tipe kerusakan until the end of the current turn. (reaction).

features.name: Searing Vengeance
features.description: At 14th level, the radiant energy you channel allows you to overcome death's grasp. When kamu adalah reduced to 0 poin kesehatan and aren't killed outright, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to instead drop to 1 poin kesehatan and shed bright light in a 30-foot radius. Each of your foes within that radius takes 2d8 + your Charisma modifier radiant kerusakan. Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Each of your foes within that radius takes 2d8 + your Charisma modifier radiant kerusakan. (reaction).

subclasses.name: The Fathomless
subclasses.description: You have made a pact with an entity of the deep sea. A fathomless warlock is a champion of the dark depths, and they channel the power of their patron to control the waters and the creatures that dwell within them.

features.name: Bonus Spells
features.description:
At 1st level, you learn additional sihir ketika kamu reach certain levels in this class, as shown in the Fathomless Spells table. Each of these sihir counts as a warlock sihir for you, but it doesn't count against your number of warlock sihir you know.

1st: create or destroy water, thunderwave
3rd: gust of wind, silence
5th: lightning bolt, sleet storm
7th: control water, summon elemental
9th: Bigby's hand, cone of cold
11th: conjure elemental, maelstrom
features.summary: Each of these sihir counts as a warlock sihir for you, but it doesn't count against your number of warlock sihir you know.

features.name: Tentacle of the Deep
features.description: At 1st level, kamu dapat summon a spectral tentacle that strikes at your foes. As aksi bonus, kamu dapat create a 10-foot-long tentacle at a point kamu bisa melihat within 60 feet of you. The tentacle lasts for 1 minute or until you use this feature to create another tentacle. When you create the tentacle, kamu dapat membuat a melee sihir attack against satu makhluk within 10 feet of it. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 cold kerusakan, and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of giliranmu selanjutnya. The tentacle can attack a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu, and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang. The kerusakan increases to 2d8 at 5th level, 3d8 at 11th level, and 4d8 at 17th level.
features.summary: On a hit, the target takes 1d8 cold kerusakan, and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of giliranmu selanjutnya. (bonus action).

features.name: Gift of the Sea
features.description: At 6th level, kamu mendapatkan a swimming speed of 40 feet, and kamu dapat breathe underwater.
features.summary: At 6th level, kamu mendapatkan a swimming speed of 40 feet, and kamu dapat breathe underwater.

features.name: Oceanic Soul
features.description: At 10th level, kamu mendapatkan resistance to cold kerusakan. In addition, while kamu adalah fully submerged in water, kamu dapat communicate simple ideas with any beast that has an innate swimming speed.
features.summary: At 10th level, mendapatkan resistance to cold kerusakan. While fully submerged in water, kamu dapat communicate simple ideas with any beast that has an innate swimming speed.

features.name: Guardian Coil
features.description: At 14th level, your tentacle can defend you and your allies. When you or makhluk yang kamu lihat dalam 30 feet of you takes kerusakan, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to choose one of the creatures and reduce the kerusakan by 1d8. If you reduce the kerusakan to 0, kamu dapat membuat a melee sihir attack against the attacker as part of the same reaction. On a hit, the attacker takes 1d8 + your Charisma modifier cold kerusakan.
features.summary: Can use reaksimu to choose one of the creatures and reduce the kerusakan by 1d8. (reaction).

features.name: Grasping Tentacles
features.description: At 18th level, kamu dapat call forth a manifestation of the deep. You can cast the evard's black tentacles sihir, requiring no sihir slot or material components. When you cast sihir itu in this way, the area of sihir itu is difficult terrain for creatures other than you. Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang. (action).

subclasses.name: The Genie
subclasses.description: You have made a pact with one of the genies, the mighty elemental rulers of the Inner Planes. A genie patron is a powerful being that can grant wishes and bend reality to its will.

features.name: Bonus Spells
features.description:
At 1st level, you learn additional sihir ketika kamu reach certain levels in this class, as shown in the Genie Spells table. Each of these sihir counts as a warlock sihir for you, but it doesn't count against your number of warlock sihir you know.

1st: detect evil and good, protection from evil and good
3rd: create food and water, phantasmal killer
5th: creation, sending
7th: creation, summon elemental
9th: creation, wall of stone
11th: creation, wish
features.summary: Each of these sihir counts as a warlock sihir for you, but it doesn't count against your number of warlock sihir you know.

features.name: Genie's Vessel
features.description:
At 1st level, your patron gifts you a magical vessel that grants you a measure of the genie's power. The vessel is a Tiny object, and you choose the object's nature: an oil lamp, an ornate urn, a gilded chalice, or some other similarly shaped Tiny object. While kamu adalah touching the vessel, kamu dapat menggunakan it as a spellcasting focus for your warlock sihir. The vessel's AC equals your sihir save DC. It has a number of poin kesehatan equal to your warlock level + bonus keahlianmu, and it is immune to poison and psychic kerusakan.

The vessel grants you the following benefits:

Elemental Gift: You mendapatkan a flying speed of 30 feet, which works only while kamu adalah not wearing heavy armor.

Limited Wish: Once per long rest, kamu dapat menyalurkan sihir of 6th level or lower from the warlock sihir list, requiring no sihir slot or material components.
features.summary: The vessel grants you the following benefits: Elemental Gift: You mendapatkan a flying speed of 30 feet, which works only while kamu adalah not wearing heavy armor. (action).

features.name: Elemental Gift
features.description: Starting at 6th level, the vessel grants you resistance to a tipe kerusakan based on your patron's kind: fire (Dao), cold (Djinni), lightning (Efreeti), or thunder (Marid). You also mendapatkan a flying speed of 30 feet, which works only while kamu adalah not wearing heavy armor.
features.summary: Also mendapatkan a flying speed of 30 feet, which works only while kamu adalah not wearing heavy armor.

features.name: Sanctuary Vessel
features.description: At 10th level, ketika kamu or an ally within 30 feet of you takes kerusakan, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to whisk the damaged creature into your vessel. The creature is transported to the vessel's extradimensional space, where it is safe from harm. The creature remains there until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya or until you use this feature again. When the creature reappears, it appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within 30 feet of you. You can use this feature a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu, and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: At 10th level, ketika kamu or an ally within 30 feet of you takes kerusakan, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to whisk the damaged creature into your vessel. (reaction).

features.name: Limited Wish
features.description: At 14th level, kamu dapat tap into the power of your genie patron to cast powerful sihir. Once per long rest, kamu dapat menyalurkan sihir of 6th level or lower from the warlock sihir list, requiring no sihir slot or material components.
features.summary: At 14th level, kamu dapat tap into the power of your genie patron to cast powerful sihir.

subclasses.name: The Undead
subclasses.description: You've made a pact with a powerful undead being, such as a vampire, lich, or mummy lord. This patron grants you power over death and undeath, allowing you to channel the chill of the grave and command the spirits of the dead.

features.name: Form of Dread
features.description: You can use aksi bonus to transform into a terrifying visage of death. For 1 minute, kamu mendapatkan the following benefits: You mendapatkan poin kesehatan sementara equal to 1d10 + your warlock level. Once on each of your turns ketika kamu hit makhluk with an attack, kamu dapat force the target to make a Wisdom saving throw against your sihir save DC. On a failed save, the target is frightened of you until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya. You can transform a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu, and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Gain the following benefits: You mendapatkan poin kesehatan sementara equal to 1d10 + your warlock level. (bonus action).

features.name: Grave Touched
features.description: Your patron's power changes your body. You don't need to eat, drink, or breathe. In addition, once on each of your turns ketika kamu hit makhluk with an attack, kamu dapat change the tipe kerusakan of the attack to necrotic kerusakan. While kamu adalah in your Form of Dread, kamu dapat also change the tipe kerusakan of any sihir you cast to necrotic kerusakan.
features.summary: In addition, once on each of your turns ketika kamu hit makhluk with an attack, kamu dapat change the tipe kerusakan of the attack to necrotic kerusakan.

features.name: Necrotic Husk
features.description: Your body is suffused with necrotic energy. You have resistance to necrotic kerusakan. In addition, ketika kamu are reduced to 0 poin kesehatan but not killed outright, kamu dapat drop to 1 poin kesehatan instead, and setiap makhluk pilihanmu within 30 feet of you takes necrotic kerusakan equal to your warlock level + your Charisma modifier.
