Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: In addition, ketika kamu are reduced to 0 poin kesehatan but not killed outright, kamu dapat drop to 1 poin kesehatan instead, and setiap makhluk pilihanmu within 30.

features.name: Spirit Projection
features.description: As aksi, kamu dapat project your spirit from your body. Your body is unconscious and appears dead while your spirit is projected. Your spirit resembles a spectral version of your body and has the following statistics: It has 1 poin kesehatan and immunity to all kerusakan except force kerusakan. It can't take actions or cast sihir. It can move through creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It has a flying speed of 40 feet and can hover. While projected, kamu dapat menggunakan aksimu to return to your body. Your body memulihkan kembali consciousness when your spirit returns to it. Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: It has a flying speed of 40 feet and can hover. (action).

subclasses.name: Undying
subclasses.description:
Your patron is a powerful undead being, such as a lich, vampire, or mummy lord. These beings have cheated death and didapatkan immortality through dark magic, and they share some of their power with their warlock servants.

The Undying patron represents those who have transcended death, and its warlocks mendapatkan abilities that reflect this connection to undeath. They can resist disease, recover from wounds, and even cheat death itself.

features.name: Among the Dead
features.description: At 1st level, kamu memiliki keuntungan pada saving throw melawan being frightened.
features.summary: At 1st level, kamu memiliki keuntungan pada saving throw melawan being frightened.

features.name: Undying Nature
features.description: Also at 1st level, kamu memiliki keuntungan pada saving throw melawan disease.
features.summary: Also at 1st level, kamu memiliki keuntungan pada saving throw melawan disease.

features.name: Beyond the Grave
features.description: At 6th level, kamu dapat mendapatkan poin kesehatan sementara ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat singkat.
features.summary: At 6th level, kamu dapat mendapatkan poin kesehatan sementara ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat singkat.

features.name: Indestructible Life
features.description: At 10th level, kamu dapat memulihkan kembali poin kesehatan ketika kamu take kerusakan.
features.summary: At 10th level, kamu dapat memulihkan kembali poin kesehatan ketika kamu take kerusakan.

features.name: Undying Nature
features.description: At 14th level, kamu tidak bisa killed by a single attack.
features.summary: At 14th level, kamu tidak bisa killed by a single attack.

subclasses.name: Abjuration
subclasses.description:
The abjuration specialist is a wizard who focuses on protective and defensive magic. They are masters of wards, shields, and counterspells, able to protect themselves and their allies from magical and physical harm.

Abjurers study the theory and practice of defensive magic, learning to create magical barriers that can absorb kerusakan and deflect attacks. They are often found on the front lines, using their abilities to keep their companions safe.

features.name: Abjuration Savant
features.description: At 2nd level, the gold and time you spend to copy an abjuration sihir into your spellbook is halved.
features.summary: At 2nd level, the gold and time you spend to copy an abjuration sihir into your spellbook is halved. (action).

features.name: Arcane Ward
features.description: Also at 2nd level, kamu dapat create a magical ward.
features.summary: At 2nd level, ketika kamu cast an abjuration sihir, you create a magical ward with Hit Points equal to twice your wizard level + your Intelligence modifier. The ward takes kerusakan first and recharges ketika kamu cast an abjuration sihir.

features.name: Projected Ward
features.description: At 6th level, kamu dapat menggunakan your Arcane Ward to protect others.
features.summary: At 6th level, kamu dapat menggunakan your Arcane Ward to protect others. (action).

features.name: Improved Abjuration
features.description: At 10th level, your Arcane Ward memulihkan kembali poin kesehatan ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat singkat.
features.summary: At 10th level, your Arcane Ward memulihkan kembali poin kesehatan ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat singkat.

features.name: Spell Resistance
features.description: At 14th level, kamu memiliki keuntungan pada saving throw melawan sihir.
features.summary: At 14th level, kamu memiliki keuntungan pada saving throw melawan sihir.

subclasses.name: Bladesinging
subclasses.description: Bladesingers are elves who have learned to combine swordplay with arcane magic. They are deadly warriors who use their magic to enhance their combat prowess.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: When you choose this tradition at 2nd level, kamu mendapatkan keahlian dengan armor ringan, a one-handed melee weapon of your choice, and the Performance skill jika kamu don't already have it.
features.summary: Gain keahlian with light armor, a one-handed melee weapon of your choice, and the Performance skill jika kamu don't already have it. (action).

features.name: Training in War and Song
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, you learn to blend your magic with senjatamu work. You mendapatkan keahlian with one of the following skills of your choice: Acrobatics, Athletics, History, or Performance. You also mendapatkan keahlian with one musical instrument of your choice.
features.summary: Also mendapatkan keahlian with one musical instrument of your choice.

features.name: Bladesong
features.description:
Starting at 2nd level, kamu dapat invoke a secret elven magic called the Bladesong, provided you aren't wearing medium or heavy armor or using a shield. It graces you with supernatural speed, agility, and focus. You can use aksi bonus to start the Bladesong, which lasts for 1 minute. It ends early if kamu adalah incapacitated, jika kamu don medium or heavy armor or a shield, or jika kamu use two hands to make an attack with a weapon. You can also dismiss the Bladesong at any time you choose (no action required). While your Bladesong is active, kamu mendapatkan the following benefits:

You mendapatkan a bonus to AC-mu equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1).

Your walking speed increases by 10 feet.

You have keuntungan on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks.

You mendapatkan a bonus to any Constitution saving throw you make to maintain your konsentrasi on sihir. The bonus equals your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1).

You can use this feature a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu, and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Your walking speed increases by 10 feet. (bonus action).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Starting at 6th level, kamu dapat attack twice, instead of once, setiap kali kamu take the Attack action on giliranmu. Moreover, kamu dapat menyalurkan one of your cantrip in place of one of those attacks.
features.requirement: Only when taking the Attack action
features.scaling: Three attacks at level 11, four attacks at level 20
features.summary: Starting at 6th level, kamu dapat attack twice, instead of once, setiap kali kamu take the Attack action on giliranmu. (only when taking the attack action, permanent, scales).

features.name: Song of Defense
features.description: At 10th level, kamu dapat direct your magic to absorb kerusakan while your Bladesong is active. When you take kerusakan, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to expend one sihir slot and reduce that kerusakan to you by an amount equal to five times sihir itu slot's level.
features.summary: At 10th level, kamu dapat direct your magic to absorb kerusakan while your Bladesong is active. (reaction).

features.name: Song of Victory
features.description: At 14th level, you add your Intelligence modifier to the kerusakan of your melee weapon attacks while your Bladesong is active.
features.summary: At 14th level, you add your Intelligence modifier to the kerusakan of your melee weapon attacks while your Bladesong is active.

subclasses.name: Chronurgy Magic
subclasses.description: Chronurgy is the study of time magic. Chronurgists learn to manipulate the flow of time, slowing it down, speeding it up, or even reversing it.

features.name: Chronal Shift
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, kamu dapat magically exert limited control over the flow of time around makhluk. When you or makhluk yang kamu lihat dalam 30 feet of you makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to roll a d8 and apply it to the roll. You can choose to use this feature after the roll, but before the DM determines whether the attack roll, ability check, or saving throw succeeds or fails. The d8 roll is added to the total if the roll is for an attack roll or ability check, or subtracted from the total if the roll is for a saving throw. You can use this feature twice, and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: An ability check, or a saving throw, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to roll a d8 and apply it to the roll. (reaction).

features.name: Temporal Awareness
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, kamu mendapatkan a bonus to your initiative rolls equal to your Intelligence modifier. In addition, kamu tidak bisa surprised while kamu adalah conscious.
features.summary: Starting at 2nd level, kamu mendapatkan a bonus to your initiative rolls equal to your Intelligence modifier. (action).

features.name: Momentary Stasis
features.description: Starting at 6th level, kamu dapat menggunakan your command over time to force makhluk to slow down. As aksi, kamu dapat memilih makhluk yang kamu lihat dalam 60 feet of you. The creature must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is restrained and incapacitated until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Can choose makhluk yang kamu lihat dalam 60 feet of you. (action).

features.name: Arcane Abeyance
features.description: At 10th level, kamu dapat store sihir in a tiny, bead-like object. As aksi, kamu dapat menyalurkan sihir of 4th level or lower into the bead, which holds sihir itu until it is used. The bead is a Tiny object, and it has AC 10, 1 poin kesehatan, and immunity to all kerusakan except force kerusakan. The bead is destroyed when sihir itu is cast or ketika kamu die. You can have only one bead at a time, and kamu tidak bisa create another until sihir itu in the bead is cast. The bead can be used by anyone who holds it. To use sihir itu, the creature holding the bead must use its action to cast sihir itu, using your sihir save DC and sihir attack bonus.
features.summary: The bead is a Tiny object, and it has AC 10, 1 poin kesehatan, and immunity to all kerusakan except force kerusakan. (action).

features.name: Convergent Future
features.description: Starting at 14th level, kamu dapat peer into the future and see the outcome of a course of action. When you or makhluk yang kamu lihat dalam 30 feet of you makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to ignore the roll. Instead, kamu dapat memilih the result of the roll to be the highest or lowest possible. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: An ability check, or a saving throw, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to ignore the roll. (reaction).

subclasses.name: Conjuration
subclasses.description:
Conjurers specialize in creating objects and creatures from nothing. They can summon weapons, armor, and even living creatures to aid them in battle or perform tasks.

The study of conjuration requires precision and spatial awareness. Conjurers learn to open portals to other planes, calling forth creatures and objects to serve their needs. They are versatile spellcasters who can adapt to any situation.

features.name: Conjuration Savant
features.description: At 2nd level, the gold and time you spend to copy a conjuration sihir into your spellbook is halved.
features.summary: At 2nd level, the gold and time you spend to copy a conjuration sihir into your spellbook is halved. (action).

features.name: Minor Conjuration
features.description: Also at 2nd level, kamu dapat conjure small objects.
features.summary: At 2nd level, kamu dapat conjure a nonmagical object in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of you. The object can be no larger than 3 feet on a side and weighs no more than 10 pounds. It disappears after 1 hour or if it takes any kerusakan.

features.name: Benign Transportation
features.description: At 6th level, kamu dapat swap places with makhluk.
features.summary: At 6th level, as aksi bonus, kamu dapat teleport hingga 30 feet to an unoccupied space kamu bisa melihat. If you teleport within 5 feet of a willing creature, kamu dapat swap places with that creature.

features.name: Focused Conjuration
features.description: At 10th level, your konsentrasi on conjuration sihir is not broken ketika kamu take kerusakan.
features.summary: At 10th level, your konsentrasi on conjuration sihir is not broken ketika kamu take kerusakan.

features.name: Durable Summons
features.description: At 14th level, your summoned creatures mendapatkan poin kesehatan sementara.
features.summary: At 14th level, your summoned creatures mendapatkan poin kesehatan sementara.

subclasses.name: Divination
subclasses.description:
Diviners study the art of predicting the future. They can glimpse moments yet to come, gaining insight into the outcomes of actions and the intentions of others.

The study of divination requires keen intellect and intuition. Diviners learn to read the signs and portents that others miss, using their knowledge to guide their allies and outmaneuver their enemies.

features.name: Divination Savant
features.description: At 2nd level, the gold and time you spend to copy a divination sihir into your spellbook is halved.
features.summary: At 2nd level, the gold and time you spend to copy a divination sihir into your spellbook is halved. (action).

features.name: Portent
features.description: Also at 2nd level, kamu dapat replace any attack roll, ability check, or saving throw.
features.summary: Also at 2nd level, kamu dapat replace any attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. (action).

features.name: Expert Divination
features.description: At 6th level, kamu dapat memulihkan kembali slot sihir ketika kamu cast divination sihir.
features.summary: At 6th level, kamu dapat memulihkan kembali slot sihir ketika kamu cast divination sihir.

features.name: Third Eye
features.description: At 10th level, kamu dapat mendapatkan darkvision, see invisible creatures, etc.
features.summary: At 10th level, kamu dapat mendapatkan darkvision, see invisible creatures, etc.

features.name: Greater Portent
features.description: At 14th level, kamu dapat menyalurkan the foresight sihir once per long rest.
features.summary: At 14th level, kamu dapat menyalurkan the foresight sihir once per long rest.

subclasses.name: Enchantment
subclasses.description:
Enchanters specialize in manipulating the minds of others. They can charm, beguile, and control creatures, turning enemies into allies and bending others to their will.

The study of enchantment requires subtlety and finesse. Enchanters learn to weave sihir that influence thoughts and emotions, using their abilities to avoid conflict or mendapatkan keuntungan in social situations.

features.name: Savant
features.description: At 2nd level, the gold and time you spend to copy an enchantment sihir into your spellbook is halved.
features.summary: At 2nd level, the gold and time you spend to copy an enchantment sihir into your spellbook is halved. (action).

features.name: Hypnotic Gaze
features.description: Also at 2nd level, kamu dapat charm makhluk with a look.
features.summary: Also at 2nd level, kamu dapat charm makhluk with a look.

features.name: Instinctive Charm
features.description: At 6th level, kamu dapat divert attacks made against you.
features.summary: At 6th level, kamu dapat divert attacks made against you.

features.name: Split Enchantment
features.description: At 10th level, kamu dapat target two creatures with enchantment sihir.
features.summary: At 10th level, kamu dapat target two creatures with enchantment sihir.

features.name: Alter Memories
features.description: At 14th level, kamu dapat modify makhluk's memory.
features.summary: At 14th level, ketika kamu charm makhluk, kamu dapat modify its memory of the event. The creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have its memory altered.

subclasses.name: Evocation
subclasses.description: You focus your study on magic that creates powerful elemental effects such as bitter cold, searing flame, rolling thunder, crackling lightning, and burning acid. Some evokers find employment in military forces, serving as artillery to blast enemy armies from afar. Others use their spectacular power to protect the weak, while some seek their own mendapatkan as bandits, adventurers, or aspiring tyrants.

features.name: Evocation Savant
features.description: Beginning ketika kamu select this school at 2nd level, the gold and time kamu harus spend to copy an evocation sihir into your spellbook is halved.
features.summary: Beginning ketika kamu select this school at 2nd level, the gold and time kamu harus spend to copy an evocation sihir into your spellbook is halved. (action).

features.name: Sculpt Spells
features.description: Beginning at 2nd level, kamu dapat create pockets of relative safety within the effects of your evocation sihir. When you cast an evocation sihir that affects other creatures that kamu bisa melihat, kamu dapat memilih a number of them equal to 1 + sihir itu's level. The chosen creatures automatically succeed on their saving throws against sihir itu, and they take no kerusakan if they would normally take half kerusakan on a successful save.
features.summary: The chosen creatures automatically succeed on their saving throws against sihir itu, and they take no kerusakan if they would normally take half kerusakan on a successful save. (action).

features.name: Potent Cantrip
features.description: Starting at 6th level, your damaging cantrip affect even creatures that avoid the brunt of the effect. When makhluk succeeds on a saving throw against your cantrip, the creature takes half the cantrip's kerusakan (if any) but suffers no additional effect from the cantrip.
features.summary: The creature takes half the cantrip's kerusakan (if any) but suffers no additional effect from the cantrip.

features.name: Empowered Evocation
features.description: Beginning at 10th level, kamu dapat menambahkan Intelligence modifier to one kerusakan roll of any wizard evocation sihir you cast.
features.summary: Beginning at 10th level, kamu dapat menambahkan Intelligence modifier to one kerusakan roll of any wizard evocation sihir you cast. (action).

features.name: Overchannel
features.description:
Starting at 14th level, kamu dapat increase the power of your simpler sihir. When you cast a wizard sihir of 1st through 5th level that deals kerusakan, kamu dapat deal maximum kerusakan with that sihir.
The first time you do so, you suffer no adverse effect. If you use this feature again before you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang, you take 2d12 necrotic kerusakan for each level of sihir itu, immediately after you cast it. Each time you use this feature again before finishing istirahat panjang, the necrotic kerusakan per sihir level increases by 1d12. This kerusakan ignores resistance and immunity.
features.summary: Each time you use this feature again before finishing istirahat panjang, the necrotic kerusakan per sihir level increases by 1d12. (action).

subclasses.name: Graviturgy Magic
subclasses.description: Graviturgy is the study of gravity magic. Graviturgists learn to manipulate the force of gravity, making themselves and their allies lighter or heavier, and even creating gravitational anomalies.

features.name: Adjust Density
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, kamu dapat menggunakan your command of gravity to alter the weight of makhluk. As aksi, kamu dapat memilih makhluk yang kamu lihat dalam 30 feet of you. The creature must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature's weight is halved or doubled (your choice) for 1 minute. While the creature's weight is halved, its walking speed increases by 10 feet, and it has keuntungan on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. While the creature's weight is doubled, its walking speed decreases by 10 feet, and it has kerugian on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Its walking speed increases by 10 feet, and it has keuntungan on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. (action).

features.name: Gravity Well
features.description: Starting at 6th level, kamu dapat create a point of intense gravitational force. When you cast sihir that forces makhluk to make a saving throw, kamu dapat memilih satu makhluk that fails its saving throw. That creature is pulled 10 feet toward you, provided kamu bisa melihat it and it is within 60 feet of you.
features.summary: That creature is pulled 10 feet toward you, provided kamu bisa melihat it and it is within 60 feet of you. (action).

features.name: Violent Attraction
features.description: Starting at 10th level, kamu dapat menggunakan your command of gravity to increase the force of your attacks. When you hit makhluk with a weapon attack, kamu dapat menggunakan aksi bonus to choose satu makhluk yang kamu lihat within 30 feet of you. That creature takes force kerusakan equal to your Intelligence modifier, and kamu dapat bergerak it 10 feet toward you or away from you (your choice). You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: That creature takes force kerusakan equal to your Intelligence modifier, and kamu dapat bergerak it 10 feet toward you or away from you (your choice). (bonus action).

features.name: Gravity Sinkhole
features.description: At 14th level, kamu dapat create a devastating gravitational anomaly. As aksi, kamu dapat memilih a point kamu bisa melihat within 120 feet of you. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, makhluk takes 5d10 force kerusakan and is restrained until the start of giliranmu selanjutnya. On a successful save, makhluk takes half as much kerusakan and isn't restrained. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and kamu memulihkan kembali all expended uses ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: On a failed save, makhluk takes 5d10 force kerusakan and is restrained until the start of giliranmu selanjutnya. (action).

subclasses.name: Illusion
subclasses.description:
Illusionists create false images and manipulate perceptions. They can make things appear or disappear, create phantasmal creatures, and alter the appearance of themselves and others.

The study of illusion requires creativity and imagination. Illusionists learn to bend light and sound, creating realistic illusions that can deceive even the most perceptive observers.

features.name: Illusion Savant
features.description: At 2nd level, the gold and time you spend to copy an illusion sihir into your spellbook is halved.
features.summary: At 2nd level, the gold and time you spend to copy an illusion sihir into your spellbook is halved. (action).

features.name: Improved Minor Illusion
features.description: Also at 2nd level, kamu dapat change the nature of your illusions.
features.summary: Also at 2nd level, kamu dapat change the nature of your illusions.

features.name: Illusory Self
features.description: At 6th level, kamu dapat create an illusory duplicate of yourself.
features.summary: At 10th level, when makhluk makes an attack roll against you, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to create an illusory duplicate of yourself, causing the attack to miss you instead.

features.name: Illusory Self
features.description: At 10th level, kamu dapat membuat an illusion real.
features.summary: At 10th level, when makhluk makes an attack roll against you, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to create an illusory duplicate of yourself, causing the attack to miss you instead.

features.name: Illusory Reality
features.description: At 14th level, kamu dapat create an illusory creature.
features.summary: At 14th level, kamu dapat create an illusory creature.

subclasses.name: Necromancy
subclasses.description:
Necromancers study the forces of life and death. They can animate the dead, drain life force from living creatures, and even cheat death itself.

The study of necromancy requires a strong will and a willingness to confront the darker aspects of existence. Necromancers learn to harness the power of negative energy, using it to create undead servants and protect themselves from harm.

features.name: Savant
features.description: At 2nd level, the gold and time you spend to copy a necromancy sihir into your spellbook is halved.
features.summary: At 2nd level, the gold and time you spend to copy a necromancy sihir into your spellbook is halved. (action).

features.name: Grim Harvest
features.description: Also at 2nd level, kamu dapat memulihkan kembali poin kesehatan ketika kamu kill makhluk.
features.summary: Also at 2nd level, kamu dapat memulihkan kembali poin kesehatan ketika kamu kill makhluk.

features.name: Undead Thralls
features.description: At 6th level, kamu dapat animate undead.
features.summary: At 6th level, ketika kamu raise makhluk as an undead, it mendapatkan additional Hit Points and bonus keahlianmu to its attacks and kerusakan rolls. You can also command it as aksi bonus.

features.name: Inured to Undeath
features.description: At 10th level, kamu memiliki ketahanan terhadap necrotic kerusakan.
features.summary: At 10th level, kamu memiliki ketahanan terhadap necrotic kerusakan.

features.name: Command Undead
features.description: At 14th level, kamu dapat command undead creatures.
features.summary: At 14th level, kamu dapat menggunakan aksimu to target one undead creature within 60 feet of you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for 1 minute. You can use this feature a number of times equal to bonus keahlianmu, regaining all uses on istirahat panjang.

subclasses.name: Order of Scribes
subclasses.description: The Order of Scribes is a tradition of wizards who believe that magic is a language. They study the written word and the arcane symbols that make up sihir, and they use their knowledge to create new sihir and modify existing ones.

features.name: Wizardly Quill
features.description: At 2nd level, kamu dapat menggunakan a special quill to write sihir into your spellbook. The quill doesn't require ink. When you use the quill to copy sihir into your spellbook, kamu dapat reduce the time and cost to copy sihir itu by half. You can also use the quill to create sihir scroll. When you do so, kamu harus provide sihir itu's components, and the scroll costs half the normal amount of gold to create.
features.summary: Can also use the quill to create sihir scroll. (action).

features.name: Awakened Spellbook
features.description:
Starting at 2nd level, kamu memiliki a spellbook that has been awakened by your magic. The spellbook has the following benefits:

You can use the spellbook as a spellcasting focus for your wizard sihir.

When you cast a wizard sihir with slot sihir, kamu dapat temporarily replace its tipe kerusakan with the tipe kerusakan of another sihir in your spellbook of the same level. This replacement lasts for the duration of sihir itu.

When you cast a wizard sihir as a ritual, kamu dapat menggunakan sihir itu's normal casting time, rather than adding 10 minutes to it. Once you use this benefit, kamu tidak bisa do so again until you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.

If your spellbook is lost, kamu dapat melakukan a special ritual to create a new one. This ritual takes 8 hours to complete, and kamu harus have access to a wizard's spellbook to copy sihir from. The new spellbook becomes your awakened spellbook.
features.summary: This ritual takes 8 hours to complete, and kamu harus have access to a wizard's spellbook to copy sihir from. (action).

features.name: Manifest Mind
features.description: Starting at 6th level, kamu dapat cause your spellbook to manifest a spectral mind. As aksi bonus, kamu dapat cause the mind to appear in an unoccupied space kamu bisa melihat within 60 feet of you. The mind is a Tiny object, and it has AC 10, 1 poin kesehatan, and immunity to all kerusakan except force kerusakan. The mind is invisible, and it can't be targeted by attacks or sihir. The mind lasts for 1 hour, until you dismiss it as aksi bonus, or until you die. While the mind is present, kamu dapat menggunakan it as a spellcasting focus for your wizard sihir. In addition, kamu dapat menyalurkan sihir as jika kamu were in the mind's space, provided kamu bisa melihat the mind.
features.summary: Can cause the mind to appear in an unoccupied space kamu bisa melihat within 60 feet of you. (bonus action).

features.name: Master Scrivian
features.description: Starting at 10th level, kamu dapat create powerful scrolls. When you menyelesaikan istirahat panjang, kamu dapat create a number of sihir scrolls equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one). The scrolls must be for sihir of 5th level or lower, and the sihir must be in your spellbook. The scrolls cost half the normal amount of gold to create, and they last for 8 hours before becoming inert.
features.summary: The scrolls cost half the normal amount of gold to create, and they last for 8 hours before becoming inert. (action).

features.name: One with Words
features.description: At 14th level, your mastery of the written word allows you to cast sihir without speaking. When you cast a wizard sihir, kamu dapat menyalurkannya tanpa verbal components. Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat singkat atau panjang.
features.summary: Once you use this feature, kamu tidak bisa menggunakan it again until you menyelesaikan istirahat singkat atau panjang. (action).

subclasses.name: Transmutation
subclasses.description:
Transmuters manipulate the physical world. They can change the shape and properties of objects, transform one substance into another, and even alter their own bodies.

The study of transmutation requires a deep understanding of the natural world. Transmuters learn to reshape reality at a fundamental level, using their abilities to adapt to any situation and overcome any obstacle.

features.name: Savant
features.description: At 2nd level, the gold and time you spend to copy a transmutation sihir into your spellbook is halved.
features.summary: At 2nd level, the gold and time you spend to copy a transmutation sihir into your spellbook is halved. (action).

features.name: Minor Alchemy
features.description: Also at 2nd level, kamu dapat transmute materials.
features.summary: At 2nd level, kamu dapat transmute one object into another material of the same size and value. The effect lasts for 1 hour or until the object takes any kerusakan.

features.name: Transmuter's Stone
features.description: At 6th level, kamu dapat create a stone that grants benefits.
features.summary: At 6th level, kamu dapat create a stone that grants benefits.

features.name: Shapechanger
features.description: At 10th level, kamu dapat menyalurkan the polymorph sihir on yourself.
features.summary: At 10th level, kamu dapat menyalurkan the polymorph sihir on yourself.

features.name: Master Transmuter
features.description: At 14th level, kamu dapat transmute matter at a touch.
features.summary: At 14th level, kamu dapat transmute matter at a touch.

subclasses.name: War Magic
subclasses.description: The War Magic tradition is a school of wizardry that focuses on the practical application of magic in combat. War mages are skilled in both offensive and defensive magic, and they use their knowledge to survive on the battlefield.

features.name: Arcane Deflection
features.description: At 2nd level, you learn to weave your magic into a protective shield. When kamu adalah hit by an attack or you fail a saving throw against sihir or other magical effect, kamu dapat menggunakan reaksimu to mendapatkan a +2 bonus to AC-mu against that attack or a +4 bonus to that saving throw. If you do so, kamu tidak bisa menyalurkan sihir other than cantrip until the end of giliranmu selanjutnya.
features.summary: Can use reaksimu to mendapatkan a +2 bonus to AC-mu against that attack or a +4 bonus to that saving throw. (reaction).

features.name: Tactical Wit
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, you add your Intelligence modifier to your initiative rolls.
features.summary: Starting at 2nd level, you add your Intelligence modifier to your initiative rolls. (action).

features.name: Power Surge
features.description: Starting at 6th level, kamu dapat store magical energy inside your body to fuel your sihir. You have a pool of power surges, represented by a number of d6s equal to your wizard level. When you make an attack roll or a saving throw, kamu dapat menghabiskan one power surge to add the roll of one d6 to the total. You can use this feature only once per turn. You memulihkan kembali all expended power surges ketika kamu menyelesaikan istirahat panjang.
features.summary: Can spend one power surge to add the roll of one d6 to the total. (action).

features.name: Durable Magic
features.description: At 10th level, the sihir you cast help sustain your defenses. While kamu adalah maintaining konsentrasi on sihir, kamu mendapatkan a +2 bonus to AC and to all saving throws.
features.summary: At 10th level, while kamu adalah maintaining konsentrasi on sihir, kamu mendapatkan a +2 bonus to AC and to all saving throws.

features.name: Deflecting Shroud
features.description: At 14th level, your Arcane Deflection becomes more powerful. When you use your Arcane Deflection, kamu dapat memilih hingga tiga makhluk within 10 feet of you. The bonus kamu mendapatkan from Arcane Deflection is granted to those creatures as well.
features.summary: Can choose hingga tiga makhluk within 10 feet of you. (action).
